docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// services/session.service.ts - WHO is logged in?
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The logged-in user (or null), and what is deduced from it (is it the ADMIN?
// a patient?), in a signal-based root service (see example 20).
//
// The JWT token itself is NOT here: it is in an httpOnly cookie that
// only the browser handles. The service only keeps the DESCRIPTION of
// the user, returned by the server ({ login, name, role }).
//
// At startup (and after an F5), the service is empty: check() asks
// the server, only once, who is logged in (GET /api/auth/me).
// =========================================================================

import { computed, inject, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { RdvMedecinsApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { Role, User } from '../api/types';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SessionService {
  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly _user = signal<User | null>(null);
  // has the question "who is logged in?" already been asked to the server?
  private checking: Promise<void> | null = null;

  readonly user = this._user.asReadonly();
  readonly loggedIn = computed(() => this._user() !== null);
  readonly role = computed<Role | null>(() => this._user()?.role ?? null);
  readonly isAdmin = computed(() => this.role() === 'ADMIN');
  readonly isPatient = computed(() => this.role() === 'USER');
  // ADMIN and DOCTOR: book and cancel the appointments of any patient
  readonly isManager = computed(() => this.role() === 'ADMIN' || this.role() === 'DOCTOR');

  // the home page of each role, right after login
  readonly homePage = computed(() => (this.isPatient() ? '/my-area' : '/schedule'));

  // called by the router guard before EACH navigation; only queries
  // the server the first time (the promise is kept and reused)
  check(): Promise<void> {
    this.checking ??= this.api
      .me()
      .then((u) => this._user.set(u))
      .catch(() => this._user.set(null)); // 401: nobody; or server unreachable
    return this.checking;
  }

  async logIn(login: string, password: string, captchaId: string, captcha: string): Promise<void> {
    this._user.set(await this.api.logIn(login, password, captchaId, captcha));
  }

  // the user has changed name or login (PUT /api/my-account)
  update(u: User): void {
    this._user.set(u);
  }

  async logOut(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.api.logOut();
    } finally {
      this.forget();
    }
  }

  // without asking the server anything: session expired, account deleted
  forget(): void {
    this._user.set(null);
  }
}

已登录的用户，位于一个信号服务中（示例 20）：

  • 第 22 行：状态：用户，或[null]。令牌本身不在这里：它在只有浏览器才会处理的 Cookie 中；
  • 第 26–32 行：组件读取的内容：用户，以及由此推断出的内容（用户是否已登录？是 ADMIN 吗？是患者吗？）；
  • 第 35 行：每个角色的主页；
  • 第 39–45 行：启动时（以及按 F5 之后），服务并不知道谁已登录：它会询问服务器。[check] 在每次导航之前由路由器守卫调用，但只在第一次时查询服务器：promise 被保留下来（第 40 行，[??=]：“如果它尚不存在”），并在之后每次调用时返回。如果两次导航紧接着发生，它们会等待同一个响应；
  • 第 43 行：401（没有人登录）或服务器不可达：没有用户；
  • 第 56–62 行：登出；[finally]：即使服务器没有响应，用户也会被遗忘；
  • 第 65–67 行：在不向服务器发送请求的情况下忘记用户：这正是拦截器在遇到 401 时所做的事。

docs.title: 10.4.5.2. src/app/services/messages.service.ts
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// services/messages.service.ts - the messages displayed to the user
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Same presentation as the HTML application:
//   - a SUCCESS is displayed at the TOP of the page (green banner);
//   - an ERROR at the BOTTOM, on a light pink background ("sticky" panel).
// A message is a translation KEY (+ its parameters): it is therefore translated
// again by itself if the user changes the language.
//
// The "flash" messages: an action that ends with a change of
// page (booking, adding a doctor...) leaves its message with flash();
// it will be displayed on the NEXT page, then will disappear at the
// following navigation. The service knows it because it listens to the router events
// (end of each navigation). It was, on the server side, the role of the
// short-lived cookie "rdvmedecins_flash".
// =========================================================================

import { Injectable, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { NavigationEnd, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ApiError } from '../api/api-error';

export interface Message {
  key: string;
  params?: Record<string, string>;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class MessagesService {
  readonly success = signal<Message | null>(null);
  readonly error = signal<Message | null>(null);
  // the messages to display on the next page
  private pending: { success: Message | null; error: Message | null } | null = null;

  constructor() {
    // a new page (including when only the query changes, /schedule?...):
    // the messages of the previous page disappear, the flash messages
    // appear. A root service lives as long as the application:
    // no need to unsubscribe.
    inject(Router).events.subscribe((e) => {
      if (e instanceof NavigationEnd) {
        this.newPage();
      }
    });
  }

  showSuccess(key: string, params?: Record<string, string>): void {
    this.success.set({ key, params });
    this.error.set(null);
  }

  showError(key: string, params?: Record<string, string>): void {
    this.error.set({ key, params });
    this.success.set(null);
  }

  // an ApiError -> the message of the page; any other error is an
  // anomaly of the client, which is let through (browser console)
  showApiError(e: unknown): void {
    if (!(e instanceof ApiError)) {
      throw e;
    }
    this.showError(e.key, e.params);
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.success.set(null);
    this.error.set(null);
  }

  // for the NEXT page
  flash(type: 'success' | 'error', key: string, params?: Record<string, string>): void {
    this.pending ??= { success: null, error: null };
    this.pending[type] = { key, params };
  }

  private newPage(): void {
    this.success.set(this.pending?.success ?? null);
    this.error.set(this.pending?.error ?? null);
    this.pending = null;
  }
}

向用户显示的消息，与 HTML 应用程序中一样：页面顶部的成功消息，页面底部的错误消息。消息是一个翻译键：如果用户切换语言，它会自动重新翻译。

  • 第 29–30 行：当前页面上的两条消息；
  • 第 58–63 行：[ApiError] 会成为页面的错误消息；任何其他错误属于客户端问题，允许报告；
  • 第 71–74 行：为下一个页面准备的 flash 消息。以页面跳转结束的操作（添加了医生、返回列表）因此会显示其消息；
  • 第 39–43 行：服务监听路由器事件（示例 17）。每次导航结束时（第 76–80 行），上一页的消息消失，flash 消息出现。在服务器端，这是短期 Cookie 的作用。

docs.title: 10.4.5.3. src/app/services/confirmation.service.ts
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// services/confirmation.service.ts - "Are you sure?"
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Taken from example 16: confirm(key) opens the confirmation dialog
// (components/confirm-dialog.ts, placed once in App) and returns
// a promise resolved to true (Yes) or false (No). The message is a translation
// KEY: the dialog translates it into the current language.
//
//     if (await this.confirmation.confirm('SCHEDULE.CANCEL_CONFIRM')) { ... }
// =========================================================================

import { inject, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { MessagesService } from './messages.service';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ConfirmationService {
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly _messageKey = signal<string | null>(null); // null: dialog closed
  readonly messageKey = this._messageKey.asReadonly();
  private answer: ((yes: boolean) => void) | null = null;

  confirm(key: string): Promise<boolean> {
    this.answer?.(false); // a question still open? it counts as "no"
    // a new question: the messages of the previous action are outdated
    this.messages.clear();
    this._messageKey.set(key);
    return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
      this.answer = resolve;
    });
  }

  respond(yes: boolean): void {
    this._messageKey.set(null);
    const r = this.answer;
    this.answer = null;
    r?.(yes);
  }
}

示例 16 中的服务。消息现在是一个翻译键（第 18 行），新的提问会清除上一个操作的消息（第 25 行）。

docs.title: 10.4.5.4. src/app/services/form-submission.ts
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// services/form-submission.ts - submitting a form to the server
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// All the forms of the application follow the same pattern as
// example 25: no rule is checked in the browser (they
// live in ONE single place, the server), and in case of rejection:
//   - the error of each field (ApiError.fields) is attached to the field of the
//     signal form, which displays it outlined in red;
//   - the general message (ApiError.key) is displayed at the bottom of the page.
// This class groups these steps. A page creates one per form:
//
//     protected readonly submission = new FormSubmission(this.f);
//     if (await this.submission.submit(() => this.api.register(this.model()))) { ... }
//
// It is used in an injection context (initialization of a field
// of the component class): it gets the messages service there.
// =========================================================================

import { inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FieldTree, isFieldTree, submit, ValidationError } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { ApiError } from '../api/api-error';
import { MessagesService } from './messages.service';

export class FormSubmission<T> {
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  // the parameters of the error messages ({min}...), returned by the server
  readonly params = signal<Record<string, string>>({});

  constructor(private readonly form: FieldTree<T>) {}

  // runs the submission; returns true if it succeeded. On an ApiError, the
  // errors are displayed and false is returned.
  // ignoreValidators: submit even if the rules of the form schema
  // (if it has any) are not met
  async submit(action: () => Promise<unknown>, ignoreValidators = false): Promise<boolean> {
    this.params.set({});
    let succeeded = false;
    await submit(this.form, {
      ignoreValidators: ignoreValidators ? 'all' : 'pending',
      action: async () => {
        try {
          await action();
          succeeded = true;
          return null; // no error
        } catch (e) {
          this.messages.showApiError(e); // (rethrows any error that is not an ApiError)
          const error = e as ApiError;
          this.params.set(error.params);
          return this.fieldErrors(error);
        }
      },
    });
    return succeeded;
  }

  // { lastName: 'ERRORS.LASTNAME_REQUIRED' } -> an error attached to the field f.lastName
  private fieldErrors(e: ApiError): ValidationError.WithOptionalFieldTree[] {
    const fields = this.form as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    return Object.entries(e.fields)
      .filter(([name]) => isFieldTree(fields[name]))
      .map(([name, key]) => ({ kind: 'server', message: key, fieldTree: fields[name] as FieldTree<unknown> }));
  }
}

应用程序中的所有表单都遵循示例 25 所示的模式：规则由服务器验证，如果表单被拒绝，每个字段的错误会显示在该字段下方，页面底部显示一条通用错误消息。该类把这些操作集中在一起，这样就不必在每个页面上重复：

  • 第 24 行：一个 泛型类：[T] 是表单模型类型；
  • 第 25 行：[inject] 位于字段初始化中：该类必须在注入上下文中创建，即在组件字段初始化期间（第 12 行）；
  • 第 27 行：错误消息的参数（[{{min}}]……），由服务器返回；
  • 第 35–54 行：提交。[submit]（示例 25）执行操作；该方法返回 [true] 表示操作成功；
  • 第 39 行：[ignoreValidators]：默认情况下（['pending']），[submit] 在表单存在验证错误时不执行操作（登录页面有一个包含两个必填字段的模式）。['all']：仍然发送请求（见登录页面）；
  • 第 46 行：通用消息；
  • 第 57–62 行：字段错误。[isFieldTree] 验证表单确实有该名称的字段：服务器可能报告表单并未显示的字段的错误。

docs.title: 10.4.6.1. src/app/pipes/formatting.ts
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pipes/formatting.ts - the display of persons, times and days
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The server sends RAW data (startHour: 8, startMinute: 0; day:
// "2026-10-05"); the formatting, which depends on the language, is the business
// of the client. Functions, used by the code, and pipes (file
// formatting.pipes.ts), used by the templates.
// =========================================================================

import { Slot, Identity } from '../api/types';

// "Mme Alice DURAND"
export function label(p: Identity): string {
  return `${p.title} ${p.firstName} ${p.lastName}`;
}

// "8:05" rather than "8:5"
export function time(h: number, m: number): string {
  return `${h}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

// "8:00 - 8:20"
export function timeRange(s: Slot): string {
  return `${time(s.startHour, s.startMinute)} - ${time(s.endHour, s.endMinute)}`;
}

// today's date, in the "yyyy-MM-dd" format (that of <input type="date"> and of the API)
export function today(): string {
  const d = new Date();
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

// true if [day] is a date that exists, in the yyyy-MM-dd format
export function isValidDate(day: unknown): day is string {
  if (typeof day !== 'string' || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(day)) {
    return false;
  }
  const date = new Date(`${day}T00:00:00Z`);
  return !isNaN(date.getTime()) && date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) === day;
}

// "lundi 5 octobre 2026" / "Monday 5 October 2026"
export function longDate(day: string, language: string | null): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(language === 'en' ? 'en-GB' : 'fr-FR', {
    dateStyle: 'full',
    timeZone: 'UTC', // "2026-10-05T00:00:00Z" must remain the 5th, whatever the time zone
  }).format(new Date(`${day}T00:00:00Z`));
}

服务器发送原始数据（[startHour: 8, startMinute: 0]；[day: "2026-10-05"]）；格式化取决于语言，由客户端负责：

  • 第 34–40 行：这是有效日期吗？[2026-02-30] 格式正确，但并不存在：[new Date] 会把它转换为 3 月 2 日。因此我们验证它读回后是否相同。[day is string]：如果函数返回 true，[TypeScript] 就知道 [day] 是字符串；
  • 第 43–48 行：[Intl.DateTimeFormat]由浏览器提供，以所请求的语言书写日期。UTC 时区可避免位于格林尼治以西的浏览器显示前一天。

docs.title: 10.4.6.2. src/app/pipes/formatting.pipes.ts
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pipes/formatting.pipes.ts - the functions of formatting.ts, as pipes
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//     {{ doctor | label }}                 "Mme Marie PELISSIER"
//     {{ slot | timeRange }}               "8:00 - 8:20"
//     {{ day | longDate: language() }}     "Monday 5 October 2026"
// longDate receives the language as a parameter: a pure pipe is recomputed only
// if one of its arguments changes - changing the language therefore recomputes it.
// =========================================================================

import { Pipe, PipeTransform } from '@angular/core';
import { Slot, Identity } from '../api/types';
import { timeRange, longDate, label } from './formatting';

@Pipe({ name: 'label' })
export class LabelPipe implements PipeTransform {
  transform(p: Identity): string {
    return label(p);
  }
}

@Pipe({ name: 'timeRange' })
export class TimeRangePipe implements PipeTransform {
  transform(s: Slot): string {
    return timeRange(s);
  }
}

@Pipe({ name: 'longDate' })
export class LongDatePipe implements PipeTransform {
  transform(day: string, language: string | null): string {
    return longDate(day, language);
  }
}

同样的函数，以管道的形式用于模板。[longDate] 接收语言作为参数：纯管道（示例 09）只有在其某个参数改变时才会重新计算；因此，更改语言会触发重新计算。

docs.title: 10.4.7.1. src/app/app.routes.ts
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// app.routes.ts - the pages of the application and their access rights
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The SAME addresses as the HTML application (/login, /schedule, /doctors,
// /my-area...), but they are now routes of the CLIENT. The
// browser sends a request to the server only for the very first
// page; then, the router changes the address and the displayed component.
//
// The flip side: if the user reloads /schedule (F5), the
// browser does request /schedule from the server, which must then
// return index.html (ng serve does it in development; in production,
// see web/client-spa.ts of the JSON server).
//
// All the pages are the CHILDREN of a route without a component,
// which carries the sessionGuard guard (canActivateChild): it thus applies
// to each of them. Each route declares:
//   - title: translation key of the tab title (see i18n/title.strategy.ts);
//   - data : public (accessible without being logged in), roles (the
//             allowed roles), type ('doctors' or 'clients'), code (403, 404).
// Thanks to withComponentInputBinding (app.config.ts), the parameters of
// the address (:id, ?day=...) AND the data (type, code) arrive in the
// INPUTS of the components of the pages.
// =========================================================================

import { Routes } from '@angular/router';
import { PersonType } from './api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { Role } from './api/types';
import { registrationGuard, sessionGuard, numericId } from './guards';
import { LoginPage } from './pages/login/login';
import { SchedulePage } from './pages/schedule/schedule';

// the routes managing the doctors AND the clients (ADMIN), on the same
// model; the pages are loaded on demand (loadComponent)
function personRoutes(type: PersonType, title: string, addTitle: string, editTitle: string): Routes {
  const data = { roles: ['ADMIN'] as Role[], type };
  return [
    { path: type, loadComponent: () => import('./pages/persons/persons'), title: title, data },
    { path: `${type}/add`, loadComponent: () => import('./pages/person-form/person-form'), title: addTitle, data },
    {
      path: `${type}/:id/edit`,
      canMatch: [numericId],
      loadComponent: () => import('./pages/person-form/person-form'),
      title: editTitle,
      data,
    },
  ];
}

export const routes: Routes = [
  {
    path: '',
    canActivateChild: [sessionGuard],
    children: [
      // "/": to /login, which itself goes to the home page of the role if logged in
      { path: '', pathMatch: 'full', redirectTo: 'login' },
      { path: 'login', component: LoginPage, title: 'LOGIN.TITLE', data: { public: true } },
      { path: 'schedule', component: SchedulePage, title: 'SCHEDULE.PAGE_TITLE' },
      ...personRoutes('doctors', 'DOCTORS.TITLE', 'DOCTORS.ADD', 'DOCTORS.EDIT'),
      ...personRoutes('clients', 'CLIENTS.TITLE', 'CLIENTS.ADD', 'CLIENTS.EDIT'),
      {
        path: 'register',
        loadComponent: () => import('./pages/register/register'),
        title: 'REGISTRATION.TITLE',
        data: { public: true },
        canActivate: [registrationGuard],
      },
      {
        path: 'my-area',
        loadComponent: () => import('./pages/patient-area/patient-area'),
        title: 'AREA.TITLE',
        data: { roles: ['USER'] },
      },
      {
        path: 'my-account',
        loadComponent: () => import('./pages/my-account/my-account'),
        title: 'MY_ACCOUNT.TITLE',
        data: { roles: ['USER'] },
      },
      { path: 'forbidden', loadComponent: () => import('./pages/error/error'), title: 'ERROR_PAGE.TITLE', data: { code: 403 } },
      {
        path: '**',
        loadComponent: () => import('./pages/error/error'),
        title: 'ERROR_PAGE.TITLE',
        data: { code: 404, public: true },
      },
    ],
  },
];

与 HTML 应用程序相同的 URL（/login、/schedule、/doctors、/my-area……），但它们现在是客户端路由：

  • 第 50–53 行：所有页面都是某个无组件路由的子路由（[children]），该路由带有守卫[sessionGuard]：[canActivateChild] 将其应用于每个子路由，无需重复；
  • 第 55 行：地址 / 指向登录页面，如果用户已登录，登录页面再重定向到该角色的主页；
  • 第 56–57 行：两个访问量最大的页面包含在主文件中；其余页面按需加载（[loadComponent]）；
  • [title]：标签页标题的翻译键；
  • [data]：[public]（无需登录即可访问），[roles]（授权角色；缺省：所有已登录角色），[type]（['doctors'] 或 ['clients']），[code]（403、404）。得益于 [withComponentInputBinding]，路由数据也会传入页面组件的 输入，例如地址参数；
  • 第 34–47 行：医生管理系统的三个路由和客户管理系统的路由由同一个函数生成：两个系统使用相同的页面，只是 [type] 不同；
  • 第 41 行：[canMatch]：一个判断路由是否匹配地址的守卫。如果失败，路由器会尝试后续路由：因此 /doctors/abc/edit 会指向 404 页面；
  • 第 65 行：账户创建页面专用的守卫；
  • 第 79 行：403 页面，守卫将用户重定向到该页面；
  • 第 80–85 行：任何其他地址：404 页面。

docs.title: 10.4.7.2. src/app/guards.ts
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// guards.ts - the guards of the router
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// sessionGuard: the guard of ALL the pages (see app.routes.ts). Before
// each navigation:
//   1. the first time (startup, F5), it asks the server who is
//      logged in (SessionService.check);
//   2. it checks the rights described in the data of the route:
//        - public: accessible without being logged in;
//        - roles : the allowed roles (absent = all logged-in roles).
//
// REMINDER: these checks are only a CONVENIENCE (not displaying a useless
// page). The protection of the data is ensured by the server, which
// checks the token and the role again on EACH request.
//
// WARNING: inject() is only allowed at the START of a guard, before any
// await (after it, the "injection context" is lost).
// =========================================================================

import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { CanActivateChildFn, CanActivateFn, CanMatchFn, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Role } from './api/types';
import { RdvMedecinsApi } from './api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { SessionService } from './services/session.service';
import { MessagesService } from './services/messages.service';

export const sessionGuard: CanActivateChildFn = async (route, state) => {
  const session = inject(SessionService);
  const router = inject(Router);
  await session.check();

  if (route.data['public']) {
    // already logged in: the login page no longer makes sense
    if (route.routeConfig?.path === 'login' && session.loggedIn()) {
      return router.parseUrl(session.homePage());
    }
    return true;
  }
  if (!session.loggedIn()) {
    // the requested page is remembered, to come back to it after login
    return router.createUrlTree(['/login'], { queryParams: { redirect: state.url } });
  }
  const roles = route.data['roles'] as Role[] | undefined;
  if (roles && !roles.includes(session.role()!)) {
    return router.createUrlTree(['/forbidden']);
  }
  return true;
};

// a guard SPECIFIC to the /register route: without a pass (captcha
// solved on the login page), back to the login page
export const registrationGuard: CanActivateFn = async () => {
  const api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  const messages = inject(MessagesService);
  const router = inject(Router);
  const { valid } = await api.registrationAccessStatus().catch(() => ({ valid: false }));
  if (!valid) {
    messages.flash('error', 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT');
    return router.createUrlTree(['/login']);
  }
  return true;
};

// /doctors/3/edit: the route MATCHES only if the 2nd segment of
// the address is a number (/doctors/abc/edit leads to the 404 page)
export const numericId: CanMatchFn = (_route, segments) => /^\d+$/.test(segments[1]?.path ?? '');
  • 第 27 行：守卫可以是 [async]：路由器会等待其响应；
  • 第 28–30 行：注意：[inject] 只允许出现在守卫的开头，即在任何 [await] 之前；此后注入上下文就丢失了；
  • 第 30 行：第一次时，向服务器询问当前登录的是谁；
  • 第 32–38 行：公共页面；但登录页面对已登录用户不再有意义（第 34 行）。[parseUrl] 将地址转换为 [UrlTree]，这是触发重定向的值；
  • 第 39–42 行：未登录：跳转到登录页面，同时保留所请求的页面；
  • 第 43–46 行：无效角色：重定向到 403 页面；
  • 第 52–62 行：创建账户需要一张“通行证”，通过在登录页面解决验证码（CAPTCHA）获得。没有它，用户会被带回登录页面并收到一条消息；
  • 第 66 行：守卫 [canMatch] 接收地址段：[['doctors', '3', 'edit']]。

这些守卫只是为了方便：数据保护由服务器保证，服务器在每次请求时都会重新验证令牌和角色。

  protected async logOut(): Promise<void> {
