docs.title: 10.4.8.3. src/app/components/confirm-dialog
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// components/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The "Are you sure?" dialog of example 16, completed for the keyboard
// like public/js/app.js of the HTML application:
//   - on opening, the focus goes to "No, go back": an absent-minded press on
//     Enter deletes nothing;
//   - Escape closes the dialog (= No);
//   - Tab and Shift+Tab stay INSIDE the dialog (otherwise the focus would go to
//     the greyed-out page, behind);
//   - on closing, the focus goes back to the element that had it (the
//     "Delete" button clicked, for example).
// "No, go back" rather than "Cancel": the question is sometimes "Cancel this
// appointment?", and a "Cancel" button would be ambiguous there.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, effect, ElementRef, inject, untracked, viewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { ConfirmationService } from '../../services/confirmation.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-confirm-dialog',
  imports: [TranslatePipe],
  templateUrl: './confirm-dialog.html',
})
export class ConfirmDialog {
  protected readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);
  private readonly dialog = viewChild<ElementRef<HTMLElement>>('dialog');
  private readonly noButton = viewChild<ElementRef<HTMLButtonElement>>('noButton');
  private previousFocus: HTMLElement | null = null;

  constructor() {
    // the dialog opens (the "No" button appears) or closes
    effect(() => {
      const button = this.noButton();
      untracked(() => {
        if (button) {
          this.previousFocus = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
          button.nativeElement.focus();
        } else {
          this.previousFocus?.focus();
          this.previousFocus = null;
        }
      });
    });
  }

  protected onKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const dialog = this.dialog()?.nativeElement;
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      this.confirmation.respond(false);
    } else if (e.key === 'Tab' && dialog) {
      const buttons = [...dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button')];
      const first = buttons[0];
      const last = buttons[buttons.length - 1];
      if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
        e.preventDefault();
        last?.focus();
      } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
        e.preventDefault();
        first?.focus();
      }
    }
  }

  // a click on the greyed-out background (and not in the dialog itself) = No
  protected onBackdropClick(e: MouseEvent): void {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
      this.confirmation.respond(false);
    }
  }
}

示例 16 中的窗口，增加了键盘支持：

  • 第 34–45 行：一个跟踪“否”按钮出现和消失的 effect。打开时，保留原本拥有焦点的元素，并把焦点交给“否”按钮；关闭时，焦点回到保留的元素（例如被点击的“删除”按钮）。[untracked]：在该函数中读取的信号不会成为 effect 的依赖项；
  • 第 48–64 行：键盘。Esc 回答“否”；Tab 和 Shift+Tab 停留在窗口内：从最后一个按钮回到第一个，反之亦然。否则，焦点会移到后面变灰的页面上；
  • 第 67–71 行：点击变灰的背景会回答“否”。
@if (confirmation.messageKey(); as key) {
  <div (keydown)="onKeydown($event)">
    <div class="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
    <div #dialog class="modal fade show d-block" tabindex="-1" role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true"
         aria-labelledby="confirmation-title" aria-describedby="confirmation-message" (click)="onBackdropClick($event)">
      <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
        <div class="modal-content">
          <div class="modal-header">
            <h5 id="confirmation-title" class="modal-title">{{ 'CONFIRMATION.TITLE' | translate }}</h5>
            <button type="button" class="btn-close" [attr.aria-label]="'BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA' | translate"
                    (click)="confirmation.respond(false)"></button>
          </div>
          <div class="modal-body">
            <p id="confirmation-message" class="mb-0">{{ key | translate }}</p>
          </div>
          <div class="modal-footer">
            <button #noButton type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" (click)="confirmation.respond(false)">
              {{ 'CONFIRMATION.NO' | translate }}
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger" (click)="confirmation.respond(true)">{{ 'CONFIRMATION.YES' | translate }}</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
}
  • 第 2 行：在包含窗口的元素上监听按键；
  • 第 14 行：消息，一个翻译键。

docs.title: 10.4.8.4. src/app/components/input-field.ts
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// components/input-field.ts - a complete form field
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Label + field + help message OR error message. All the
// forms of the application use it, with a signal form:
//
//   <app-input-field [formField]="f.lastName" fieldId="lastName" label="PERSONS.LASTNAME_LABEL" [maxChars]="20" />
//
// It is a "HOME-MADE" FORM CONTROL: by implementing the interface
// FormValueControl, it accepts [formField] like an ordinary <input>.
// The contract is simple:
//   - value (a model()): the value of the field, read AND written by the
//     form;
//   - errors (an optional input of the contract): if the component
//     declares it, the [formField] directive puts the errors of the field in it -
//     here, those returned by the SERVER (see pages/person-form.ts).
// label, help and the message of the errors are translation KEYS.
// =========================================================================

import { booleanAttribute, Component, computed, input, model } from '@angular/core';
import { FormValueControl, ValidationError } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-input-field',
  imports: [TranslatePipe],
  // a component is displayed "inline" by default: we make it a block,
  // so that the classes set by the parent (mb-3, col-sm-6) apply
  styles: `
    :host {
      display: block;
    }
  `,
  template: `
    <label class="form-label" [for]="fieldId()">{{ label() | translate }}</label>
    <input class="form-control" [id]="fieldId()" [type]="type()" [value]="value()" (input)="onInput($event)"
           [class.is-invalid]="error()" [attr.maxlength]="maxChars() ?? null" [autocomplete]="autocomplete()"
           [required]="mandatory()" [attr.aria-invalid]="error() ? 'true' : null" [attr.aria-describedby]="fieldId() + '-message'">
    @if (error(); as e) {
      <div class="invalid-feedback" [id]="fieldId() + '-message'">{{ e | translate: params() }}</div>
    } @else if (help(); as h) {
      <div class="form-text" [id]="fieldId() + '-message'">{{ h | translate: params() }}</div>
    }
  `,
})
export class InputField implements FormValueControl<string> {
  // the FormValueControl contract
  readonly value = model('');
  readonly errors = input<readonly ValidationError.WithOptionalFieldTree[]>([]);

  // our own inputs
  // the id of the <input> (not "id": an id attribute would ALSO remain on
  // <app-input-field>, and the page would have two elements with the same id)
  readonly fieldId = input.required<string>();
  readonly label = input.required<string>(); // translation key
  readonly type = input<'text' | 'password'>('text');
  readonly help = input<string>(); // key of the help message
  readonly params = input<Record<string, string>>({}); // parameters of the messages ({min}...)
  readonly maxChars = input<number>();
  readonly autocomplete = input('off');
  readonly mandatory = input(false, { transform: booleanAttribute });

  // the first error of the field (its translation key), if there is one
  protected readonly error = computed(() => this.errors()[0]?.message);

  protected onInput(event: Event): void {
    this.value.set((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
  }
}

一个完整的表单字段：标签、字段、提示或错误消息。应用程序中的所有表单都使用它。它是一个 自定义表单控件：遵循 [FormValueControl] 契约，它接受 [[formField]] 指令，就像接受普通的 [<input>] 一样：

  • 第 46 行：该类实现 [FormValueControl<string>] 接口：编译器会验证它是否符合契约；
  • 第 48 行：[value]，一个 [model()]（示例 11）：字段的值，[[formField]] 指令对其既读又写；
  • 第 49 行：[errors]，契约的一个可选输入：如果组件声明了它，指令会把字段的错误存放在那里；
  • 第 54–61 行：组件专有的输入。元素 [<input>] 的标识符命名为 [fieldId]，而不是 [id]：因为 [id] 属性如果设置在 [<app-input-field>] 上，也会保留在该元素上，页面就会有两个具有相同标识符的元素；
  • 第 61 行：[booleanAttribute] 将属性的存在（[mandatory]，不带值） 转换为 [true]；
  • 第 64 行：字段的第一个错误：其翻译键；
  • 第 36–38 行：[<input>] 元素显示值，并在每次按键时返回它（第 66–68 行）。[aria-invalid] 和 [aria-describedby] 为屏幕阅读器将字段与其消息关联起来；
  • 第 39–43 行：错误消息，否则为帮助消息，连同其参数一起翻译；
  • 第 29–33 行：[:host] 指组件元素本身（[<app-input-field>]）。浏览器不认识的元素按“内联”显示：把它转换为块级元素，这样父级应用的类（[col-sm-6]）才能生效。

docs.title: 10.4.8.5. src/app/components/person-fields.ts
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// components/person-fields.ts - title, first name, last name
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The identity fields, common to three forms: doctor / client of the
// ADMIN, "Create a patient account" and "Manage my account" (the equivalent of the
// partial views/partials/personFields.hbs). The parent passes it the three
// FIELDS of its signal form:
//     <app-person-fields [title]="f.title" [firstName]="f.firstName" [lastName]="f.lastName" />
// A field (FieldTree) is a value like any other: it can be passed
// as an input of a component, which binds it to its own HTML elements.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, input } from '@angular/core';
import { FieldTree, FormField } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { InputField } from './input-field';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-person-fields',
  imports: [FormField, TranslatePipe, InputField],
  template: `
    <div class="mb-3">
      <label class="form-label" for="title">{{ 'PERSONS.TITLE_LABEL' | translate }}</label>
      <!-- title(): the field received as input; title()(): its state -->
      @let titleError = title()().errors()[0]?.message;
      <select id="title" class="form-select" [formField]="title()" [class.is-invalid]="titleError">
        @for (t of TITLES; track t) {
          <option [value]="t">{{ t }}</option>
        }
      </select>
      @if (titleError) {
        <div class="invalid-feedback">{{ titleError | translate }}</div>
      }
    </div>
    <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
      <app-input-field class="col-sm-6" fieldId="firstName" label="PERSONS.FIRSTNAME_LABEL" [formField]="firstName()" [maxChars]="20" mandatory />
      <app-input-field class="col-sm-6" fieldId="lastName" label="PERSONS.LASTNAME_LABEL" [formField]="lastName()" [maxChars]="20" mandatory />
    </div>
  `,
})
export class PersonFields {
  readonly title = input.required<FieldTree<string>>();
  readonly firstName = input.required<FieldTree<string>>();
  readonly lastName = input.required<FieldTree<string>>();
  protected readonly TITLES = ['Mr', 'Mme', 'Melle'];
}

称谓、名和姓字段，三个表单共用。父级把基于信号的表单中的这三个 字段 传递给该组件：

  • 第 42–44 行：字段（[FieldTree]）和其他值一样，是一个值：可以作为输入接收；
  • 第 25 行：[title()] 是作为输入接收的字段；[title()()] 是它的状态；
  • 第 26 行：称谓列表通过 [[formField]] 与字段绑定；
  • 第 36–37 行：另外两个字段传递给 [InputField] 组件。

docs.title: 10.4.8.6. src/app/components/captcha-field.ts
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// components/captcha-field.ts - the captcha image and the input field
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A "home-made" form control (FormValueControl, see input-field.ts)
// that loads a captcha (GET /api/captcha) as soon as it is created. The parent:
//   - binds the input to its form: [formField]="f.captcha";
//   - gets the component itself with viewChild(CaptchaField), to
//     call its PUBLIC methods: captchaId(), and reload() after
//     each attempt, because an image can be used only ONCE (the server
//     forgets it as soon as it has checked it).
//
// [innerHTML] + bypassSecurityTrustHtml: the SVG image is inserted as
// is. Harmless HERE because it is generated by our server
// (svg-captcha library) and contains nothing that comes from a
// user - see example 22.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, input, model, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { DomSanitizer } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { FormValueControl, ValidationError } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { RdvMedecinsApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { Captcha } from '../api/types';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-captcha-field',
  imports: [TranslatePipe],
  styles: `
    :host {
      display: block;
    }
  `,
  template: `
    <div class="mb-3">
      <label class="form-label" for="captcha">{{ 'CAPTCHA.LABEL' | translate }}</label>
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mb-2">
        <div class="captcha-image" role="img" [attr.aria-label]="'CAPTCHA.IMAGE_ALT' | translate" [innerHTML]="svg()"></div>
        <a href="#" class="small" (click)="$event.preventDefault(); reload()">{{ 'CAPTCHA.NEW_IMAGE' | translate }}</a>
      </div>
      <input id="captcha" type="text" maxlength="10" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false"
             class="form-control" [class.is-invalid]="error()" [value]="value()" (input)="onInput($event)">
      @if (error(); as e) {
        <div class="invalid-feedback">{{ e | translate }}</div>
      } @else {
        <div class="form-text">{{ 'CAPTCHA.HELP' | translate }}</div>
      }
    </div>
  `,
})
export class CaptchaField implements FormValueControl<string> {
  readonly value = model('');
  readonly errors = input<readonly ValidationError.WithOptionalFieldTree[]>([]);

  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly sanitizer = inject(DomSanitizer);
  private readonly captcha = signal<Captcha | null>(null);
  protected readonly svg = computed(() => this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustHtml(this.captcha()?.svg ?? ''));
  protected readonly error = computed(() => this.errors()[0]?.message);

  constructor() {
    this.reload();
  }

  // a new image, and an empty field
  async reload(): Promise<void> {
    this.value.set('');
    try {
      this.captcha.set(await this.api.captcha());
    } catch {
      this.captcha.set(null); // unreachable server: the login will fail with a clear message
    }
  }

  // the identifier of the displayed image, to be sent with the answer
  captchaId(): string {
    return this.captcha()?.id ?? '';
  }

  protected onInput(event: Event): void {
    this.value.set((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
  }
}

验证码（CAPTCHA）图片及其输入字段：另一个自定义表单控件。

  • 第 61 行：组件创建后立即加载一张图片；
  • 第 65–72 行：[reload] 是 public：登录页面在每次尝试后调用它，因为每张图片只使用一次；
  • 第 75–77 行：所显示图片的 ID，随答案一起发送；
  • 第 37 行：SVG 图片（示例 22），带有供屏幕阅读器使用的替代文本；
  • 第 40 行：[autocapitalize] 和 [spellcheck]：在手机上不自动大写，也不进行拼写检查。

父页面通过 [viewChild(CaptchaField)]（示例 13）获取该组件，以调用其公共方法。

docs.title: 10.4.8.7. src/app/components/booking-dialog
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// components/booking-dialog/booking-dialog.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The dialog to book a slot. Same dialog as
// views/partials/booking.hbs of the HTML application: the Bootstrap
// classes of a modal dialog, displayed "hard-coded" (show d-block).
//
// The component does not talk to the server: it emits
//   - confirm, with the chosen patient (null for a patient who books
//     for themselves);
//   - close.
// It is the schedule page that decides what to do with it (pages/schedule.ts).
// =========================================================================

import { afterNextRender, Component, ElementRef, input, output, signal, viewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { Person } from '../../api/types';
import { LabelPipe } from '../../pipes/formatting.pipes';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-booking-dialog',
  imports: [FormsModule, TranslatePipe, LabelPipe],
  // Escape, anywhere in the page: we close
  host: { '(document:keydown.escape)': 'close.emit()' },
  templateUrl: './booking-dialog.html',
})
export class BookingDialog {
  readonly time = input.required<string>(); // "8:00 - 8:20"
  readonly clients = input<readonly Person[]>([]); // ADMIN / DOCTOR: the patients to choose from
  readonly patient = input<string | null>(null); // USER: the patient is themselves
  readonly submitting = input(false);

  readonly confirm = output<number | null>();
  readonly close = output<void>();

  protected readonly clientId = signal<number | null>(null);
  private readonly list = viewChild<ElementRef<HTMLSelectElement>>('list');
  private readonly confirmButton = viewChild.required<ElementRef<HTMLButtonElement>>('confirmButton');

  constructor() {
    // when displayed, the focus on the first useful element of the dialog
    afterNextRender(() => (this.list() ?? this.confirmButton()).nativeElement.focus());
  }

  // a click on the greyed-out background (and not in the dialog itself) closes the dialog
  protected onBackdropClick(e: MouseEvent): void {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
      this.close.emit();
    }
  }
}

预订时段窗口。它不与服务器通信：它接收要显示的内容，并发送用户的决定；执行操作的是日历页面。

  • 第 29–32 行：输入：时间段、可供选择的患者（ADMIN、DOCTOR），或患者本人（USER），以及一个“正在发送”指示器；
  • 第 34–35 行：输出：确认（携带所选患者）；关闭；
  • 第 25 行：Esc 关闭窗口；
  • 第 43 行：[afterNextRender]（示例 13）：窗口显示后，焦点移到患者列表，否则移到确认按钮。
<div class="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
<div class="modal fade show d-block" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="booking-title"
     (click)="onBackdropClick($event)">
  <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
    <form class="modal-content" (ngSubmit)="confirm.emit(clientId())">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h5 id="booking-title" class="modal-title">{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.TITLE' | translate }}</h5>
        <button type="button" class="btn-close" [attr.aria-label]="'BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA' | translate"
                (click)="close.emit()"></button>
      </div>

      <div class="modal-body">
        <p>{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.SLOT' | translate: { time: time() } }}</p>
        <!-- a patient books for themselves: no list (and the server
             would ignore a possible clientId anyway) -->
        @if (patient() !== null) {
          <p class="mb-0">{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL' | translate }}: <strong>{{ patient() }}</strong></p>
        } @else {
          <label class="form-label" for="clientId">{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL' | translate }}</label>
          <select #list id="clientId" name="clientId" class="form-select" [(ngModel)]="clientId">
            <option [ngValue]="null">{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CHOOSE_PATIENT' | translate }}</option>
            @for (c of clients(); track c.id) {
              <option [ngValue]="c.id">{{ c | label }}</option>
            }
          </select>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="modal-footer">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" (click)="close.emit()">{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CANCEL' | translate }}</button>
        <button #confirmButton type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" [disabled]="submitting()">
          {{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CONFIRM' | translate }}
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>
</div>
  • 第 5 行：一个表单：Enter 键确认；
  • 第 16–26 行：患者为自己预订：没有列表；
  • 第 21–24 行：[[ngValue]]（示例 05）：每个选项的值是一个数字，或 [null]；
  • 第 31 行：提交期间按钮被禁用：双击不会导致重复预订。

docs.title: 10.4.9.1. src/app/pages/login
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/login/login.ts - the login page (/login)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Same page as views/login.hbs of the HTML application: login, password,
// captcha, and a second button "Create a patient account" which checks
// the SAME captcha before opening the account creation.
//
// /login?login=jbernard: the login field is pre-filled (right after the
// creation of an account).
// /login?redirect=/doctors: after the login, this page is opened
// (put there by the router guard) rather than the home page of the role.
// These two parameters arrive as INPUTS of the component.
// =========================================================================

import { afterNextRender, Component, inject, input, signal, viewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { form, FormField, required } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { RdvMedecinsApi } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { SessionService } from '../../services/session.service';
import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { FormSubmission } from '../../services/form-submission';
import { CaptchaField } from '../../components/captcha-field';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-login',
  imports: [FormField, TranslatePipe, CaptchaField],
  templateUrl: './login.html',
})
export class LoginPage {
  readonly login = input<string>(); // ?login=...
  readonly redirect = input<string>(); // ?redirect=...

  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly session = inject(SessionService);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  protected readonly model = signal({ login: '', password: '', captcha: '' });
  // two rules: login and password required. [formField] then sets
  // the HTML required attribute on both fields, and the browser refuses
  // to submit the form as long as they are empty
  protected readonly f = form(this.model, (p) => {
    required(p.login);
    required(p.password);
  });
  private readonly submission = new FormSubmission(this.f);
  // the captcha component, to call its captchaId() and reload() methods
  private readonly captchaField = viewChild.required(CaptchaField);

  constructor() {
    afterNextRender(() => {
      // the inputs are now known: the login of the URL, if there is one
      const login = (this.login() ?? '').slice(0, 30);
      this.model.update((m) => ({ ...m, login }));
      // the focus: on the password if the login is already filled in
      (login ? this.f.password : this.f.login)().focusBoundControl();
    });
  }

  // both buttons share this flow: submission, then, on failure,
  // error message and NEW image (each one can be used only once)
  private async attempt(action: () => Promise<unknown>, ignoreValidators = false): Promise<void> {
    this.messages.clear();
    await this.submission.submit(async () => {
      try {
        await action();
      } catch (e) {
        // the new image BEFORE the error is attached to the field:
        // reload() empties the field, which would clear the error
        await this.captchaField().reload();
        throw e;
      }
    }, ignoreValidators);
  }

  protected async logIn(event: Event): Promise<void> {
    event.preventDefault();
    const { login, password, captcha } = this.model();
    await this.attempt(async () => {
      await this.session.logIn(login.trim(), password, this.captchaField().captchaId(), captcha);
      const redirect = this.redirect();
      // only an INTERNAL path: never a redirection to another site
      const internal = redirect !== undefined && redirect.startsWith('/') && !redirect.startsWith('//');
      await this.router.navigateByUrl(internal ? redirect : this.session.homePage());
    });
  }

  protected async createAccount(): Promise<void> {
    await this.attempt(async () => {
      await this.api.registrationAccess(this.captchaField().captchaId(), this.model().captcha);
      await this.router.navigate(['/register']);
    }, true); // login and password are not used here: their rules are ignored
  }
}

登录页面：用户名、密码、验证码（CAPTCHA），以及第二个“创建患者账户”按钮，它在允许创建账户之前验证同一个验证码。

  • 第 31–32 行：两个 URL 参数：/login?login=jbernard 预填用户名（紧接在创建账户之后）；由守卫设置的 /login?redirect=/doctors 指定登录后要打开的页面；
  • 第 43–46 行：应用程序中唯一带有 模式的表单：用户名和密码为必填。于是 [[formField]] 指令会在两个字段上设置 HTML 属性 [required]，只要它们为空，浏览器就拒绝提交表单；
  • 第 47 行：提交表单（services/form-submission.ts）；
  • 第 49 行：验证码组件，用于调用其方法；
  • 第 52–58 行：[afterNextRender]：页面显示后，输入已知。URL 中的登录名被复制到表单中（限 30 个字符），焦点设置在第一个空字段上。[focusBoundControl()] 把焦点设置到由 [[formField]] 与字段关联的元素上；
  • 第 63–75 行：两个按钮都遵循这个顺序：提交，然后如果失败，就换一张新图片（每张只使用一次）。顺序很重要：[reload] 会清空验证码字段，这会移除与该字段关联的错误；因此我们要“先”重新加载图片，以便再次触发该错误，[FormSubmission] 随后会把它与字段关联起来；
  • 第 77–87 行：登录，随后导航到所请求的页面或该角色的主页。与示例 18 一样，只接受内部路径（第 84 行）；
  • 第 89–94 行：第二个按钮。服务器验证验证码并设置一张“通行证”（一个 Cookie）；随后打开账户创建页面。这里不使用用户名和密码：模式规则被忽略（第 93 行）。
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-sm-8 col-md-6 col-lg-5">
    <div class="card p-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ 'LOGIN.TITLE' | translate }}</h5>

      <form (submit)="logIn($event)">
        <div class="mb-3">
          <label class="form-label" for="login">{{ 'LOGIN.LOGIN_LABEL' | translate }}</label>
          <input id="login" type="text" class="form-control" autocomplete="username" [formField]="f.login">
        </div>
        <div class="mb-3">
          <label class="form-label" for="password">{{ 'LOGIN.PASSWORD_LABEL' | translate }}</label>
          <input id="password" type="password" class="form-control" autocomplete="current-password"
                 [formField]="f.password">
        </div>

        <!-- a "home-made" control, bound to the captcha field of the form -->
        <app-captcha-field [formField]="f.captcha" />

        <!-- type="submit": Enter in a field triggers "Log in" -->
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100" [disabled]="f().submitting()">{{ 'LOGIN.SUBMIT' | translate }}</button>

        <!-- type="button": this button does not submit the form (no
             required check on login and password, useless here) -->
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary w-100 mt-3" [disabled]="f().submitting()" (click)="createAccount()">
          {{ 'LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT' | translate }}
        </button>
        <div class="form-text text-center">{{ 'LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT_HELP' | translate }}</div>
      </form>

      <div class="text-muted small mt-3">
        {{ 'LOGIN.DEMO_ACCOUNTS' | translate }}
        <ul class="mb-0 mt-1">
          <li><code>admin</code> - {{ 'LOGIN.DEMO_ADMIN' | translate }}</li>
          <li><code>pelissier</code>, <code>tatou</code>, <code>dupont</code> - {{ 'LOGIN.DEMO_DOCTOR' | translate }}</li>
          <li><code>martin</code>, <code>durand</code>, <code>bistrou</code>, <code>german</code> - {{ 'LOGIN.DEMO_USER' | translate }}</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
  • 第 6 行：这里没有 [novalidate]：浏览器会提示用户名或密码为空；
  • 第 18 行：自定义验证码控件，与表单中的 [captcha] 字段关联；
  • 第 21 行：提交期间按钮被禁用（[submitting()]）；
  • 第 25 行：[type="button"]：该按钮不提交表单，因此浏览器不要求填写用户名和密码。

docs.title: 10.4.9.2. src/app/pages/schedule
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/schedule/schedule.ts - the schedule page (/schedule)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Three blocks, like views/schedule.hbs of the HTML application:
//   1. the choice of the doctor and of the day;
//   2. the schedule of this doctor on that day;
//   3. the dialog to book a slot.
//
// As in the HTML application, ALL the state of the page is in its URL:
//     /schedule?doctorId=1&day=2026-10-05           the schedule
//     /schedule?doctorId=1&day=2026-10-05&book=7    + the booking dialog
// The page can therefore be reloaded, bookmarked, and the Back / Forward
// buttons of the browser work. The page FOLLOWS its URL: the three
// parameters arrive as INPUTS (signals), and an effect reloads
// the schedule when the doctor or the day changes; the actions of
// the user, for their part, change the URL (router.navigate).
//
// What each one sees and can do is decided by the SERVER (fields
// patient, mine, bookable, appointmentId of each slot): the page merely
// displays it. A patient does not even receive the name of the other patients.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, effect, inject, input, signal, untracked } from '@angular/core';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { ApiError } from '../../api/api-error';
import { RdvMedecinsApi } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { Schedule, ScheduleSlot, Person } from '../../api/types';
import { today, isValidDate, timeRange } from '../../pipes/formatting';
import { TimeRangePipe, LongDatePipe, LabelPipe } from '../../pipes/formatting.pipes';
import { LanguageService } from '../../i18n/language.service';
import { SessionService } from '../../services/session.service';
import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { ConfirmationService } from '../../services/confirmation.service';
import { BookingDialog } from '../../components/booking-dialog/booking-dialog';

// "3" -> 3; "", "abc", "-2", absent -> null
function positiveInteger(value: string | undefined): number | null {
  const n = Number(value);
  return value !== undefined && value !== '' && Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0 ? n : null;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-schedule',
  imports: [FormsModule, RouterLink, TranslatePipe, TimeRangePipe, LongDatePipe, LabelPipe, BookingDialog],
  templateUrl: './schedule.html',
})
export class SchedulePage {
  // the parameters of the URL (undefined if they are absent)
  readonly doctorId = input<string>();
  readonly day = input<string>();
  readonly book = input<string>();

  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  protected readonly session = inject(SessionService);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);
  protected readonly language = inject(LanguageService).language;

  protected readonly doctors = signal<Person[]>([]);
  protected readonly clients = signal<Person[]>([]); // ADMIN / DOCTOR: for the booking dialog
  protected readonly schedule = signal<Schedule | null>(null);
  protected readonly loading = signal(false);
  protected readonly submitting = signal(false);

  // the values of the "doctor + day" form, copied from the URL
  protected readonly doctorChoice = signal<number | null>(null);
  protected readonly dayChoice = signal(today());

  // the displayed schedule, without booking dialog: the "back" query
  protected readonly scheduleQuery = computed(() => ({ doctorId: String(this.doctorChoice() ?? ''), day: this.dayChoice() }));

  // the slot whose booking dialog is open (?book=7),
  // only if it is bookable by this user
  protected readonly slotToBook = computed<ScheduleSlot | null>(() => {
    const id = positiveInteger(this.book());
    return this.schedule()?.slots.find((c) => c.id === id && c.bookable) ?? null;
  });

  // the name of the logged-in patient (USER), or null for ADMIN and DOCTOR
  protected readonly patient = computed(() => (this.session.isPatient() ? (this.session.user()?.name ?? '') : null));

  constructor() {
    this.loadLists();
    // the schedule follows the URL (doctor and day): the effect READS both inputs,
    // and the loading is done untracked
    effect(() => {
      const doctorId = this.doctorId();
      const day = this.day();
      untracked(() => this.loadSchedule(doctorId, day));
    });
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // loading
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  private async loadLists(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.doctors.set(await this.api.list('doctors'));
      // the list of the patients: only for those who are allowed to read it
      if (this.session.isManager()) {
        this.clients.set(await this.api.list('clients'));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      this.messages.showApiError(e);
    }
  }

  private async loadSchedule(urlDoctorId: string | undefined, urlDay: string | undefined): Promise<void> {
    // the day: that of the URL if it is valid, otherwise today
    this.dayChoice.set(today());
    if (urlDay !== undefined) {
      if (!isValidDate(urlDay)) {
        this.schedule.set(null);
        this.messages.showError('ERRORS.INVALID_DATE');
        return;
      }
      this.dayChoice.set(urlDay);
    }
    // the doctor: that of the URL; without a doctor, a DOCTOR sees HIS OR HER schedule
    // (the server finds it from the token)
    const doctorId = positiveInteger(urlDoctorId);
    this.doctorChoice.set(doctorId);
    if (doctorId === null && this.session.role() !== 'DOCTOR') {
      this.schedule.set(null);
      return;
    }
    this.loading.set(true);
    try {
      const schedule = await this.api.schedule(doctorId, this.dayChoice());
      this.schedule.set(schedule);
      this.doctorChoice.set(schedule.doctor.id);
    } catch (e) {
      this.schedule.set(null);
      this.messages.showApiError(e);
    } finally {
      this.loading.set(false);
    }
  }

  // the schedule of the current URL, read again (after a booking, a cancellation)
  private reload(): Promise<void> {
    return this.loadSchedule(this.doctorId(), this.day());
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // actions
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  // "View schedule": the URL is changed, the schedule follows (effect above)
  protected viewSchedule(): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/schedule'], { queryParams: this.scheduleQuery() });
  }

  protected closeBooking(): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/schedule'], { queryParams: this.scheduleQuery() });
  }

  protected async confirmBooking(clientId: number | null): Promise<void> {
    const slot = this.slotToBook();
    if (slot === null) {
      return;
    }
    this.submitting.set(true);
    try {
      await this.api.book(this.dayChoice(), slot.id, this.session.isManager() ? clientId : null);
      this.messages.flash('success', 'SCHEDULE.BOOKED');
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof ApiError && e.key === 'ERRORS.CHOOSE_PATIENT') {
        // no patient chosen: the dialog stays open
        this.messages.showError(e.key);
        return; // (finally runs anyway)
      }
      if (!(e instanceof ApiError)) {
        throw e;
      }
      // slot taken in the meantime, patient who already has an appointment...:
      // the message will be displayed on the schedule, dialog closed
      this.messages.flash('error', e.key, e.params);
    } finally {
      this.submitting.set(false);
    }
    await this.router.navigate(['/schedule'], { queryParams: this.scheduleQuery() });
    await this.reload(); // the server is the reference: the schedule is read again
  }

  protected async cancel(c: ScheduleSlot): Promise<void> {
    if (c.appointmentId === null || !(await this.confirmation.confirm('SCHEDULE.CANCEL_CONFIRM'))) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await this.api.cancelAppointment(c.appointmentId);
      this.messages.showSuccess('SCHEDULE.CANCELLED');
    } catch (e) {
      this.messages.showApiError(e);
    }
    await this.reload();
  }

  protected timeRange(c: ScheduleSlot): string {
    return timeRange(c);
  }
}

应用程序中功能最丰富的页面。与 HTML 应用程序一样，页面的全部状态都包含在其 URL 中：/schedule?doctorId=1&day=2026-10-05 显示一个日历，&book=7 则加上预订窗口。因此可以重新加载页面、将其加入书签，并使用后退/前进按钮。原则是：页面跟随其 URL，而用户的操作改变URL。

  • 第 51–53 行：三个 URL 参数，作为输入；
  • 第 39–42 行：地址参数可以包含任何内容；要对其进行验证；
  • 第 69–70 行：“医生 + 日期”表单的值，从 URL 复制而来；
  • 第 73 行：所显示日历的参数，不含预订窗口；
  • 第 77–80 行：预订窗口所打开的时间段，根据地址（[?book=7]）和日历计算得出：仅当该用户可预订时才有。这是一个 [computed]：地址变化时，窗口自动打开或关闭；
  • 第 89–93 行：一个依赖于两个输入 [doctorId] 和 [day] 的 effect：其中任何一个变化时，日历都会重新加载。重新加载在 [untracked] 中执行：其中读取和修改的信号不会成为该 effect 的依赖项。输入 [book] 不会被读取：打开或关闭窗口不会重新加载日历；
  • 第 99–109 行：医生，以及对有权查看患者的用户显示的患者；
  • 第 111–141 行：加载日历。无效日期会被报告（第 115–118 行）；没有指定医生时，DOCTOR 看到的是他自己的日历：服务器从令牌中获取（第 126–129 行）；
  • 第 153–159 行：“查看日程”和关闭窗口会改变地址；日历随之更新；
  • 第 161–187 行：预约预订。如果成功，会准备一条 flash 消息（第 169 行）；它将在第 185 行之后显示，该行关闭窗口。如果没有选择患者，窗口保持打开（第 171–175 行）。任何其他错误（时间段在此期间被占用等）都会显示在日历上，同时窗口关闭。在所有情况下，都会重新读取日历：以服务器的记录为准（第 186 行）；
  • 第 189–200 行：取消，需经确认。
<!-- 1. the choice of the doctor and of the day -->
<form class="card p-3 mb-3" (ngSubmit)="viewSchedule()">
  <div class="row g-2 align-items-end">
    <div class="col-sm-5">
      <label class="form-label" for="doctorId">{{ 'DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DOCTOR_LABEL' | translate }}</label>
      <select id="doctorId" name="doctorId" class="form-select" required [(ngModel)]="doctorChoice">
        <option [ngValue]="null">{{ 'DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.CHOOSE_DOCTOR' | translate }}</option>
        @for (d of doctors(); track d.id) {
          <option [ngValue]="d.id">{{ d | label }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="col-sm-4">
      <label class="form-label" for="day">{{ 'DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DAY_LABEL' | translate }}</label>
      <input id="day" name="day" type="date" class="form-control" required [(ngModel)]="dayChoice">
    </div>
    <div class="col-sm-3">
      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100">{{ 'DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.VIEW_SCHEDULE' | translate }}</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</form>

@let s = schedule();

<!-- patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no "Book" button -->
@if (s?.info; as info) {
  <div class="alert alert-info">
    {{ info | translate }} <a routerLink="/my-area" class="alert-link">{{ 'APP.MENU_MY_AREA' | translate }}</a>
  </div>
}

<!-- 2. the schedule -->
@if (loading() && !s) {
  <p class="text-muted">{{ 'APP.LOADING' | translate }}</p>
} @else if (s) {
  <div class="card p-3">
    <h5>{{ 'SCHEDULE.TITLE_PREFIX' | translate }} {{ s.day | longDate: language() }} - {{ s.doctor | label }}</h5>
    @if (s.slots.length > 0) {
      <table class="table table-hover align-middle">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>{{ 'SCHEDULE.COLUMN_SLOT' | translate }}</th>
            <th>{{ 'SCHEDULE.COLUMN_STATUS' | translate }}</th>
            <th></th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          @for (c of s.slots; track c.id) {
            <tr [class.free-slot]="c.bookable">
              <td>{{ c | timeRange }}</td>
              <td>
                @if (c.free) {
                  <span class="badge text-bg-success">{{ 'SCHEDULE.FREE' | translate }}</span>
                } @else if (c.patient; as p) {
                  <span class="badge" [class]="c.mine ? 'text-bg-primary' : 'text-bg-secondary'">{{ p | label }}</span>
                } @else {
                  <span class="badge text-bg-secondary">{{ 'SCHEDULE.BOOKED_BY_OTHER' | translate }}</span>
                }
              </td>
              <td class="text-end">
                <!-- "Book" is a LINK: it adds &book=... to the URL, which
                     opens the booking dialog -->
                @if (c.bookable) {
                  <a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success" routerLink="/schedule" [queryParams]="{ doctorId: scheduleQuery().doctorId, day: scheduleQuery().day, book: c.id }">
                    {{ 'SCHEDULE.BOOK' | translate }}
                  </a>
                }
                @if (c.appointmentId !== null) {
                  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" (click)="cancel(c)">
                    {{ 'SCHEDULE.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT' | translate }}
                  </button>
                }
              </td>
            </tr>
          }
        </tbody>
      </table>
    } @else {
      <p class="text-muted mb-0">{{ 'SCHEDULE.NO_SLOTS' | translate }}</p>
    }
  </div>
} @else {
  <p class="text-muted">{{ 'SCHEDULE.EMPTY_STATE' | translate }}</p>
}

<!-- 3. the booking dialog, only if the URL contains &book=... -->
@if (slotToBook(); as c) {
  <app-booking-dialog [time]="timeRange(c)" [clients]="clients()" [patient]="patient()"
                           [submitting]="submitting()" (confirm)="confirmBooking($event)"
                           (close)="closeBooking()" />
}
  • 第 2–21 行：选择医生和日期，使用 [ngModel]（示例 05）；
  • 第 23 行：[@let]：日历，只读取一次；
  • 第 26–30 行：已经有一个即将到来的预约的患者：服务器发送一条消息，解释为什么没有“预订”按钮；
  • 第 37 行：以本地语言完整拼写的日期；
  • 第 52–58 行：时间段的状态：可用、患者（以蓝色显示），或在服务器没有发送患者姓名时显示“已预订”；
  • 第 63–67 行：“预订”是一个 链接：它在 URL 中加上 &book=...，从而打开预订窗口；
  • 第 87–91 行：预订窗口，仅当 URL 包含 &book=... 且该时间段可预订时才显示。

docs.title: 10.4.9.3. src/app/pages/persons/persons.config.ts
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/persons/persons.config.ts - doctors or clients?
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The pages managing the doctors and the clients are IDENTICAL: same
// list, same form. As in the HTML application (abstract class
// PersonsController), they are written ONCE (persons.ts,
// person-form.ts); only the address of the API and the keys of the labels
// change, described here. The router gives the type in the
// data of each route (see app.routes.ts).
// =========================================================================

import { PersonType } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';

export interface PersonKeys {
  title: string; // "Doctors"
  add: string; // "Add a doctor"
  edit: string; // "Edit a doctor"
  empty: string; // "No doctor."
  confirmDelete: string;
  added: string; // "Doctor {{name}} has been added (login: {{login}})."
  edited: string;
  deleted: string;
}

export const PERSON_KEYS: Record<PersonType, PersonKeys> = {
  doctors: {
    title: 'DOCTORS.TITLE',
    add: 'DOCTORS.ADD',
    edit: 'DOCTORS.EDIT',
    empty: 'DOCTORS.EMPTY',
    confirmDelete: 'DOCTORS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
    added: 'DOCTORS.ADDED',
    edited: 'DOCTORS.UPDATED',
    deleted: 'DOCTORS.DELETED',
  },
  clients: {
    title: 'CLIENTS.TITLE',
    add: 'CLIENTS.ADD',
    edit: 'CLIENTS.EDIT',
    empty: 'CLIENTS.EMPTY',
    confirmDelete: 'CLIENTS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
    added: 'CLIENTS.ADDED',
    edited: 'CLIENTS.UPDATED',
    deleted: 'CLIENTS.DELETED',
  },
};

// {{name}} and {{login}} of the "added / updated / deleted" messages
export function messageParams(p: { firstName: string; lastName: string; login?: string }): Record<string, string> {
  return { name: `${p.firstName} ${p.lastName}`, login: p.login ?? '' };
}

管理医生和客户的页面是相同的：同样的列表，同样的表单。与 HTML 应用程序一样（抽象类 [PersonsController]），它们只写一次；唯一变化的是 API 地址和标签键，这里对此进行了描述：

  • 第 25 行：[Record<PersonType, PersonKeys>]：编译器要求每种类型恰好有一个条目，不多也不少；
  • 第 49–51 行：“已添加 / 已修改 / 已删除”消息的参数。

docs.title: 10.4.9.4. src/app/pages/persons
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/persons/persons.ts - the list of the doctors OR of the clients (ADMIN)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A single page for both: the type ('doctors' or 'clients') is in
// the data of the route (data.type, see app.routes.ts) and arrives as an
// INPUT of the component; the labels specific to each one are in
// persons.config.ts. Equivalent of views/persons/list.hbs of
// the HTML application.
// "export default": the route loads the page on demand (loadComponent).
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, input, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { RdvMedecinsApi, PersonType } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { Person } from '../../api/types';
import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { ConfirmationService } from '../../services/confirmation.service';
import { PERSON_KEYS, messageParams } from './persons.config';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-persons',
  imports: [RouterLink, TranslatePipe],
  templateUrl: './persons.html',
})
export default class PersonsPage implements OnInit {
  readonly type = input.required<PersonType>(); // data.type of the route

  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);

  protected readonly keys = computed(() => PERSON_KEYS[this.type()]);
  protected readonly persons = signal<Person[] | null>(null); // null: not loaded yet

  // ngOnInit rather than the constructor: the inputs (type) are then known
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  private async load(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.persons.set(await this.api.list(this.type()));
    } catch (e) {
      this.messages.showApiError(e);
    }
  }

  protected async remove(p: Person): Promise<void> {
    if (!(await this.confirmation.confirm(this.keys().confirmDelete))) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await this.api.remove(this.type(), p.id);
      this.messages.showSuccess(this.keys().deleted, messageParams(p));
    } catch (e) {
      // a doctor who still has appointments: 409 ERRORS.DOCTOR_HAS_APPOINTMENTS
      this.messages.showApiError(e);
    }
    await this.load();
  }
}
  • 第 26 行：[export default]：路由按需加载该页面（示例 17）；
  • 第 27 行：类型（['doctors'] 或 ['clients']） 来自路由的输入数据；
  • 第 33 行：此类型的标签键；
  • 第 34 行：[null]：列表尚未加载；
  • 第 37–39 行：[ngOnInit]（示例 13）而不是构造函数：此时输入已经可用；
  • 第 49–61 行：删除，需经确认。仍有预约的医生不能被删除：服务器返回 409 响应，并显示其消息。
<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">
  <h4 class="mb-0">{{ keys().title | translate }}</h4>
  <a class="btn btn-primary" [routerLink]="['/', type(), 'add']">{{ keys().add | translate }}</a>
</div>

<div class="card p-3">
  @let list = persons();
  @if (list === null) {
    <p class="text-muted mb-0">{{ 'APP.LOADING' | translate }}</p>
  } @else if (list.length === 0) {
    <p class="text-muted mb-0">{{ keys().empty | translate }}</p>
  } @else {
    <table class="table table-hover align-middle mb-0">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>{{ 'PERSONS.COLUMN_TITLE' | translate }}</th>
          <th>{{ 'PERSONS.COLUMN_FIRSTNAME' | translate }}</th>
          <th>{{ 'PERSONS.COLUMN_LASTNAME' | translate }}</th>
          <th>{{ 'PERSONS.COLUMN_LOGIN' | translate }}</th>
          <th></th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        @for (p of list; track p.id) {
          <tr>
            <td>{{ p.title }}</td>
            <td>{{ p.firstName }}</td>
            <td>{{ p.lastName }}</td>
            <td><code>{{ p.login }}</code></td>
            <td class="text-end">
              <div class="d-inline-flex gap-2">
                <a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" [routerLink]="['/', type(), p.id, 'edit']">{{ 'PERSONS.EDIT' | translate }}</a>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" (click)="remove(p)">{{ 'PERSONS.DELETE' | translate }}</button>
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        }
      </tbody>
    </table>
  }
</div>
  • 第 3 行：[['/', type(), 'add']]：/doctors/add 或 /clients/add；
  • 第 8–12 行：加载期间、空列表、列表；
  • 第 32 行：/doctors/3/edit。

docs.title: 10.4.9.5. src/app/pages/person-form
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/person-form/person-form.ts - creation OR update
// of a doctor or of a client (ADMIN)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//     /doctors/add               -> creation (no id input)
//     /doctors/3/edit            -> update (input id = 3)
// (and the same addresses under /clients). Equivalent of
// views/persons/form.hbs of the HTML application.
//
// No rule is checked here: the server validates everything, and its errors
// are displayed under the fields (see services/form-submission.ts).
// The VERSION read with the record goes back with the update: if another
// ADMIN has updated it in the meantime, the server responds 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, input, numberAttribute, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { form, FormField } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { ApiError } from '../../api/api-error';
import { RdvMedecinsApi, PersonType } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { PersonData } from '../../api/types';
import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { FormSubmission } from '../../services/form-submission';
import { PersonFields } from '../../components/person-fields';
import { InputField } from '../../components/input-field';
import { PERSON_KEYS, messageParams } from '../persons/persons.config';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-person-form',
  imports: [RouterLink, FormField, TranslatePipe, PersonFields, InputField],
  templateUrl: './person-form.html',
})
export default class PersonFormPage implements OnInit {
  readonly type = input.required<PersonType>(); // data.type of the route
  // the :id parameter of the address, converted to a number; absent for a creation
  readonly id = input(undefined, { transform: (v: string | undefined) => (v === undefined ? undefined : numberAttribute(v)) });

  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  protected readonly keys = computed(() => PERSON_KEYS[this.type()]);
  protected readonly creating = computed(() => this.id() === undefined);

  protected readonly model = signal<PersonData>({ title: 'Mr', firstName: '', lastName: '', login: '', password: '', version: undefined });
  protected readonly f = form(this.model); // no validator: the server validates
  protected readonly submission = new FormSubmission(this.f);

  // update: the record is read (including its version)
  async ngOnInit(): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.id();
    if (id === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      const p = await this.api.read(this.type(), id);
      this.model.set({ title: p.title, firstName: p.firstName, lastName: p.lastName, login: p.login ?? '', password: '', version: p.version });
    } catch (e) {
      // record that does not exist (deleted in the meantime...): back to the list
      if (!(e instanceof ApiError)) {
        throw e;
      }
      this.messages.flash('error', e.key, e.params);
      this.router.navigate(['/', this.type()]);
    }
  }

  protected async save(event: Event): Promise<void> {
    event.preventDefault();
    const id = this.id();
    const succeeded = await this.submission.submit(async () => {
      const data = this.model();
      const p = id === undefined ? await this.api.add(this.type(), data) : await this.api.edit(this.type(), id, data);
      this.messages.flash('success', this.creating() ? this.keys().added : this.keys().edited, messageParams(p));
    });
    const key = this.messages.error()?.key;
    if (succeeded) {
      this.router.navigate(['/', this.type()]);
    } else if (key === 'ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND' || key === 'ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND') {
      // deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: back to the list
      this.messages.flash('error', key);
      this.router.navigate(['/', this.type()]);
    }
  }
}

创建（/doctors/add）或修改（/doctors/3/edit）医生或客户：

  • 第 37 行：地址参数 [:id]，创建时不存在。选项 [transform] 将其转换为数字（[numberAttribute]）；
  • 第 44 行：是创建还是修改？
  • 第 46–48 行：没有验证器的表单（服务器验证一切），及其提交；
  • 第 51–67 行：对于更新，会读取记录，包括 其版本；将用这些修改对其进行更新（乐观锁）。不存在的记录（/doctors/999/edit）会重定向到列表并显示一条消息；
  • 第 69–85 行：保存。成功后会闪现一条消息，用户被重定向到列表（第 75 行和第 78–79 行）。如果记录在此期间已被另一位管理员删除，用户同样被重定向到列表（第 80–84 行）；任何其他错误都会使表单继续显示，并附带其错误信息。
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
    <div class="card p-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ (creating() ? keys().add : keys().edit) | translate }}</h5>
      <!-- novalidate: it is the SERVER that validates (it is the reference) -->
      <form novalidate (submit)="save($event)">
        <app-person-fields [title]="f.title" [firstName]="f.firstName" [lastName]="f.lastName" />

        <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{ 'PERSONS.ACCOUNT_SECTION' | translate }}</h6>
        <app-input-field class="mb-3" fieldId="login" label="PERSONS.LOGIN_LABEL" [maxChars]="30" [formField]="f.login"
                          [help]="creating() ? 'PERSONS.LOGIN_HELP_CREATE' : 'PERSONS.LOGIN_HELP_EDIT'" />
        <!-- never pre-filled: the password never comes back from the server -->
        <app-input-field class="mb-4" fieldId="password" type="password" label="PERSONS.PASSWORD_LABEL" [maxChars]="72"
                          autocomplete="new-password" [formField]="f.password" [params]="submission.params()"
                          [help]="creating() ? 'PERSONS.PASSWORD_HELP_CREATE' : 'PERSONS.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT'" />

        <div class="d-flex gap-2">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" [disabled]="f().submitting()">{{ 'PERSONS.SAVE' | translate }}</button>
          <a class="btn btn-secondary" [routerLink]="['/', type()]">{{ 'PERSONS.BACK' | translate }}</a>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
  • 第 6 行：[novalidate]：由服务器验证表单；
  • 第 7 行：称谓、名和姓，位于同一个组件中；
  • 第 10–15 行：用户名和密码，创建和修改时使用不同的帮助消息。密码从不预填：服务器从不返回它；
  • 第 14 行：服务器返回的错误消息所用的参数（例如密码的最小长度）。

docs.title: 10.4.9.6. src/app/pages/register
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/register/register.ts - "Create a patient account" (/register)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// One only gets here after copying the captcha of the login page
// ("Create a patient account" button): the server then issued a
// pass, which the guard of the route has checked (see guards.ts).
// Same fields as the ADMIN form, but the login and the password
// are required, with confirmation. Equivalent of
// views/account/registration.hbs of the HTML application.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { form, FormField } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { RdvMedecinsApi } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { Registration } from '../../api/types';
import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { FormSubmission } from '../../services/form-submission';
import { PersonFields } from '../../components/person-fields';
import { InputField } from '../../components/input-field';

// minimum length of a password chosen by a patient: same value
// as the server (which also returns {min} with the PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT error)
const PASSWORD_MIN = '6';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-register',
  imports: [RouterLink, FormField, TranslatePipe, PersonFields, InputField],
  templateUrl: './register.html',
})
export default class RegisterPage {
  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  protected readonly model = signal<Registration>({ title: 'Mr', firstName: '', lastName: '', login: '', password: '', confirmation: '' });
  protected readonly f = form(this.model);
  protected readonly submission = new FormSubmission(this.f);
  // the parameters of the help message AND of the errors of the password
  protected readonly passwordParams = computed(() => ({ min: PASSWORD_MIN, ...this.submission.params() }));

  protected async create(event: Event): Promise<void> {
    event.preventDefault();
    let login = '';
    const succeeded = await this.submission.submit(async () => {
      login = (await this.api.register(this.model())).login;
    });
    if (succeeded) {
      // back to the login page, login pre-filled
      this.messages.flash('success', 'REGISTRATION.DONE', { login });
      this.router.navigate(['/login'], { queryParams: { login } });
    } else if (this.messages.error()?.key === 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT') {
      // expired pass (15 minutes): back to the captcha
      this.messages.flash('error', 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT');
      this.router.navigate(['/login']);
    }
  }
}

创建患者账户。只有持有服务器在验证码（CAPTCHA）通过后颁发的令牌，才能继续（guards.ts）：

  • 第 25 行：密码的最小长度；用于帮助消息：与服务器的值相同；
  • 第 41 行：帮助消息和密码错误消息的参数。如果服务器返回了参数，则以服务器的参数为准（它们被放在最后）；
  • 第 46–48 行：提交；服务器返回所创建账户的用户名；
  • 第 49–52 行：返回登录页面，并预填用户名；
  • 第 53–57 行：令牌已过期（15 分钟）：返回验证码页面。
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
    <div class="card p-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-1">{{ 'REGISTRATION.TITLE' | translate }}</h5>
      <p class="text-muted small mb-3">{{ 'REGISTRATION.INTRO' | translate }}</p>

                          mandatory [formField]="f.login" help="REGISTRATION.LOGIN_HELP" />
        <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
          <app-input-field class="col-sm-6" fieldId="password" type="password" label="PERSONS.PASSWORD_LABEL" [maxChars]="72"
                            autocomplete="new-password" mandatory [formField]="f.password" [params]="passwordParams()"
                            help="REGISTRATION.PASSWORD_HELP" />
          <app-input-field class="col-sm-6" fieldId="confirmation" type="password" label="ACCOUNT.CONFIRMATION_LABEL"
                            [maxChars]="72" autocomplete="new-password" mandatory [formField]="f.confirmation" />

          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" [disabled]="f().submitting()">{{ 'REGISTRATION.SUBMIT' | translate }}</button>

  • 第 7 行：称谓、名、姓；
  • 第 10–17 行：用户名、密码和确认密码——这次为必填（[mandatory] 属性只是提示：由服务器决定）。

// =========================================================================
// pages/patient-area/patient-area.ts - "My area" (/my-area, role USER)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The home page of the patient, right after login:
//   - two options: [Manage my account] and [View a schedule];
//   - his or her upcoming appointment, if any, with the means to cancel it.
// Equivalent of views/patient/area.hbs of the HTML application.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { RdvMedecinsApi } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { MyArea } from '../../api/types';
import { TimeRangePipe, LongDatePipe, LabelPipe } from '../../pipes/formatting.pipes';
import { LanguageService } from '../../i18n/language.service';
import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { ConfirmationService } from '../../services/confirmation.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-patient-area',
  imports: [RouterLink, TranslatePipe, TimeRangePipe, LongDatePipe, LabelPipe],
  templateUrl: './patient-area.html',
})
export default class PatientAreaPage {
  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);
  protected readonly language = inject(LanguageService).language;

  protected readonly area = signal<MyArea | null>(null);

  constructor() {
    this.load();
  }

  private async load(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.area.set(await this.api.myArea());
    } catch (e) {
      this.messages.showApiError(e);
    }
  }

  protected async cancel(appointmentId: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!(await this.confirmation.confirm('SCHEDULE.CANCEL_CONFIRM'))) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await this.api.cancelAppointment(appointmentId);
      this.messages.showSuccess('SCHEDULE.CANCELLED');
    } catch (e) {
      this.messages.showApiError(e);
    }
    await this.load();
  }
}

患者的主页：两个选项（“管理我的账户”“查看日程”）以及其即将到来的预约，患者可以取消该预约（第 45–56 行）。

docs.title: 10.4.9.8. src/app/pages/my-account
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/my-account/my-account.ts - "Manage my account" (/my-account, role USER)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Two independent forms, like views/patient/account.hbs:
//   1. the update (identity, login, optional new password);
//   2. the deletion of the account - which also cancels its appointments.
// Both require the CURRENT password (checked by the server).
// Two forms, hence two models, two field trees and two
// FormSubmission objects (two sets of errors).
// =========================================================================

import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { form, FormField } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { RdvMedecinsApi } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { MyAccountUpdate } from '../../api/types';
import { SessionService } from '../../services/session.service';
import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { ConfirmationService } from '../../services/confirmation.service';
import { FormSubmission } from '../../services/form-submission';
import { PersonFields } from '../../components/person-fields';
import { InputField } from '../../components/input-field';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-my-account',
  imports: [RouterLink, FormField, TranslatePipe, PersonFields, InputField],
  templateUrl: './my-account.html',
})
export default class MyAccountPage {
  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly session = inject(SessionService);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  // 1. the update
  protected readonly model = signal<MyAccountUpdate>({
    title: 'Mr',
    firstName: '',
    lastName: '',
    login: '',
    password: '',
    confirmation: '',
    currentPassword: '',
    version: 0,
  });
  protected readonly f = form(this.model);
  protected readonly update = new FormSubmission(this.f);

  // 2. the deletion: a form with a single field
  protected readonly deletionModel = signal({ currentPassword: '' });
  protected readonly fs = form(this.deletionModel);
  protected readonly deletion = new FormSubmission(this.fs);

  constructor() {
    this.load();
  }

  private async load(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const account = await this.api.myAccount();
      this.model.update((m) => ({ ...m, ...account }));
    } catch (e) {
      this.messages.showApiError(e);
    }
  }

  protected async save(event: Event): Promise<void> {
    event.preventDefault();
    const succeeded = await this.update.submit(async () => {
      // the server has issued a NEW token (name, login): the navigation
      // bar must follow
      this.session.update(await this.api.editMyAccount(this.model()));
      this.messages.flash('success', 'MY_ACCOUNT.UPDATED');
    });
    if (succeeded) {
      this.router.navigate(['/my-area']);
    } else {
      // never a password left in the field after a rejected submission;
      // the field itself (and not the model) is changed so as not to clear
      // the errors that the server has just attached to it... except its own
      this.f.currentPassword().value.set('');
    }
  }

  protected async deleteAccount(event: Event): Promise<void> {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!(await this.confirmation.confirm('MY_ACCOUNT.DELETE_CONFIRM'))) {
      return;
    }
    const succeeded = await this.deletion.submit(() => this.api.deleteMyAccount(this.deletionModel().currentPassword));
    if (succeeded) {
      this.session.forget(); // the server has cleared the cookie of the token
      this.messages.flash('success', 'MY_ACCOUNT.DELETED');
      this.router.navigate(['/login']);
    }
  }
}

两个相互独立的表单：账户修改和账户删除。两者都需要当前密码，由服务器验证。两个表单，因此有两个模型、两棵字段树，以及两个[FormSubmission]：一个表单中的错误不会出现在另一个表单中。

  • 第 60–67 行：读取账户，并将其值复制到模型中（包括版本号）；
  • 第 74 行：修改之后，服务器返回更新后的用户（并已颁发新的令牌）：导航栏必须随之更新；
  • 第 83 行：提交被拒绝后，清除当前密码。我们更新的是字段（而不是整个表单）：只有该字段的错误消失；其他错误仍然显示；
  • 第 87–98 行：确认后删除账户。服务器已删除令牌 Cookie：用户被遗忘，页面返回登录页面。
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
    <!-- 1. update -->
    <div class="card p-4 mb-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ 'MY_ACCOUNT.TITLE' | translate }}</h5>
      <form novalidate (submit)="save($event)">
        <app-person-fields [title]="f.title" [firstName]="f.firstName" [lastName]="f.lastName" />

        <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{ 'PERSONS.ACCOUNT_SECTION' | translate }}</h6>
        <app-input-field class="mb-3" fieldId="login" label="PERSONS.LOGIN_LABEL" [maxChars]="30" autocomplete="username"
                          mandatory [formField]="f.login" />
        <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
          <app-input-field class="col-sm-6" fieldId="password" type="password" label="MY_ACCOUNT.NEW_PASSWORD_LABEL"
                            [maxChars]="72" autocomplete="new-password" [formField]="f.password"
                            [params]="update.params()" help="PERSONS.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT" />
          <app-input-field class="col-sm-6" fieldId="confirmation" type="password" label="ACCOUNT.CONFIRMATION_LABEL"
                            [maxChars]="72" autocomplete="new-password" [formField]="f.confirmation" />
        </div>
        <app-input-field class="mb-4" fieldId="currentPassword" type="password" label="MY_ACCOUNT.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL"
                          [maxChars]="72" autocomplete="current-password" mandatory [formField]="f.currentPassword"
                          help="MY_ACCOUNT.CURRENT_PASSWORD_HELP" />
        <div class="d-flex gap-2">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" [disabled]="f().submitting()">{{ 'PERSONS.SAVE' | translate }}</button>
          <a class="btn btn-secondary" routerLink="/my-area">{{ 'MY_ACCOUNT.BACK' | translate }}</a>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>

    <!-- 2. deletion -->
    <div class="card p-4 border-danger">
      <h5 class="card-title text-danger mb-1">{{ 'MY_ACCOUNT.DELETE_TITLE' | translate }}</h5>
      <p class="text-muted small">{{ 'MY_ACCOUNT.DELETE_HELP' | translate }}</p>
      <form class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 align-items-end" novalidate (submit)="deleteAccount($event)">
        <app-input-field class="flex-grow-1" fieldId="deletePassword" type="password" label="MY_ACCOUNT.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL"
                          [maxChars]="72" autocomplete="current-password" mandatory [formField]="fs.currentPassword" />
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-danger" [disabled]="fs().submitting()">{{ 'MY_ACCOUNT.DELETE_SUBMIT' | translate }}</button>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

docs.title: 7. RdvMedecins 服务器，一个黑盒
docs.text:
示例 22 至 25 以及案例研究都与一个服务器交互：即[RdvMedecins]应用的 JSON 服务器。它就是上一课中的[NestJS]服务器，其控制器不再生成 HTML 页面，而是生成 JSON 响应。它的业务层和数据访问层保持不变。

在本课程中，这个服务器是一个黑盒：我们无需知道它是如何编写的。重要的只是它的API——也就是它接受的 HTTP 请求列表以及它返回的响应。这是客户端开发人员的典型处境：API 是一份契约，服务器团队可以在这份契约背后随意更改任何内容。对于好奇的读者，我们提供了它的源代码（[rdvmedecins-nestjs-json]文件夹），并附有详尽的注释。

本章说明如何安装该服务器，描述其 API，并使用[curl]对其进行查询。

docs.title: 7.1. RdvMedecins 应用
docs.text:
该应用用于管理一家医疗诊所的预约。它有三种角色：

角色对象可执行的操作[ADMIN]管理员（[admin]）为所有患者安排和取消预约；管理医生和客户[DOCTOR]医生（[pelissier]、[tatou]、[dupont]）为所有患者安排和取消预约；在日历中查看所有姓名[USER]患者（[martin]、[durand]、[bistrou]、[german]）为自己预约；取消自己的预约；管理自己的账户。在日历中，他们看不到其他患者的姓名

演示账户使用其登录名作为密码。管理规则由服务器验证，与客户端无关：

  • 不允许预约过去的时间；
  • 每位患者只能有一个即将到来的预约；
  • 同一时间段每天只能被预约一次；
  • 两位医生（或两位客户）不能拥有相同的姓和名；一个登录名只属于一个账户；
  • 有预约的医生不能被删除；
  • 在此期间已被他人修改的记录不能被覆盖（乐观锁）；
  • 患者绝不会被分配到另一位患者的姓名。

docs.title: 7.2. 安装
docs.text:
你需要[Node.js] 以及一个[MySQL] （或[MariaDB]）服务器：附录中介绍了它们的安装方法。

1. 数据库。脚本[database/dbrdvmedecins2.sql] 会创建数据库[dbrdvmedecins2]、它的表以及示例数据。使用[Laragon]时，在[HeidiSQL] 中运行它（“文件”菜单 / 运行 SQL 文件）；在命令行中：

mysql -u root -p < database/dbrdvmedecins2.sql

该脚本总是从一个空数据库开始：你可以重新运行它来恢复初始数据。

2. 库。在打开到[rdvmedecins-nestjs-json]文件夹的控制台窗口中：

npm install

3. 配置。将文件[.env.example] 复制为[.env] （在[Windows]下：[copy .env.example .env]），然后修改它：

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sample configuration file.
# Copy this file to [.env] then adapt the values to your machine.
# The [.env] file must never be shared or committed (passwords).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# listening port of the JSON server (the Angular client reaches it through the ng serve proxy)
PORT=8080

# connection parameters for the MySQL database [dbrdvmedecins2]
# (script: database/dbrdvmedecins2.sql)
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=3306
DB_USERNAME=root
DB_PASSWORD=
DB_DATABASE=dbrdvmedecins2
# true: displays in the console the SQL queries sent to MySQL
DB_LOGGING=false

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# authentication
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# secret key used to sign/verify JWT tokens - MUST be changed
# in production (a long random string, never committed).
JWT_SECRET=change-me-to-a-long-random-string
# validity of a JWT token, in seconds (7200 s = 2 h). The cookie
# that carries the token has the same lifetime.
JWT_EXPIRES_IN_SECONDS=7200
# set to true in production (site served over HTTPS): the authentication
# cookie will then never be sent over an unencrypted connection.
COOKIE_SECURE=false

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# protection against bots
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# login: number of failures (wrong captcha or password) allowed for
# the same login from the same IP address, before this pair is blocked...
LOGIN_MAX_FAILURES=5
# ... for this duration (an IP address is also blocked if it accumulates
# 5 times more failures, all logins combined)
LOGIN_BLOCK_MINUTES=15
# client account creation: maximum number of accounts created per hour
# from the same IP address. In a classroom, all computers often go out
# through the same address: increase if needed.
REGISTRATION_MAX_PER_HOUR=10

# captcha TEST MODE: if this variable has a value, that value is
# accepted as the answer to ANY captcha. Handy to query
# the API with curl (you cannot "read" the image in a console).
# Leave EMPTY in production.
CAPTCHA_TEST=

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# production
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# folder of the compiled Angular client, served by this server (default: client/)
# CLIENT_DIR=client
# set to true if the server is behind a proxy (nginx...)
TRUST_PROXY=false
  • 第 8 行：服务器监听 8080 端口；
  • 第 12–16 行：与[MySQL]的连接。使用[Laragon]时，用户[root] 没有密码：默认值即可；
  • 第 25 行：用于签署身份验证令牌的密钥；
  • 第 38–45 行：反机器人保护（多次登录失败后锁定、每小时创建的账户数量）；
  • 第 51 行：验证码（CAPTCHA）测试模式。登录页面要求用户重新输入图片中的字符，这在控制台中是无法做到的。如果该变量有值，则该值会被接受为任何验证码的答案，类似于[Google] 为其[reCAPTCHA]提供的“测试密钥”。对于本章中使用[curl] 进行的测试，请输入[CAPTCHA_TEST=test]。在生产环境中请将其保持为空；
  • 第 57–59 行：两项生产环境的设置（参见“部署”一章）。

4. 启动。

npm run start:dev

控制台显示（节选）：

[Nest] LOG [NestFactory] Starting Nest application...
[Nest] WARN [RdvMedecins] captcha TEST MODE active (CAPTCHA_TEST in .env): never use it in production
[Nest] LOG [RoutesResolver] ScheduleController {/api/schedule}:
[Nest] LOG [RouterExplorer] Mapped {/api/schedule, GET} route
[Nest] LOG [RoutesResolver] AppointmentsController {/api/appointments}:
...
[Nest] LOG [NestApplication] Nest application successfully started
[Nest] LOG [RdvMedecins] JSON server started: http://localhost:8080/api

如果数据库无法访问（[MySQL]服务器已停止、密码错误），服务器会立即停止，并显示连接错误消息。

docs.title: 7.3. 响应格式
docs.text:
所有 URL 都以[/api]开头。成功的请求会收到 2xx 状态码，并在响应体中收到 JSON 格式的所请求数据。被拒绝的请求会收到 4xx 或 5xx 状态码，并在响应体中收到同样格式的数据：

{
  "statusCode": 400,
  "key": "ERRORS.INVALID_FORM",
  "params": { "min": "6" },
  "fields": { "lastName": "ERRORS.LASTNAME_REQUIRED", "password": "ERRORS.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT" }
}
  • [statusCode]：HTTP 状态码，在响应体中重复出现；
  • [key]：消息的翻译键。服务器从不返回要显示的文本：它不再知道用户的语言。由客户端使用其字典翻译该键（参见示例 21）；
  • [params] （可选）：消息参数（[At least {min} characters], [Try again in {minutes} minute(s)]）；
  • [fields] （可选）：对于被拒绝的表单，给出每个字段的错误。

使用的状态码：

状态码含义键的示例400无效请求[ERRORS.INVALID_FORM] （+ fields）、[ERRORS.INVALID_DATE]、[ERRORS.WRONG_CAPTCHA]、[ERRORS.CHOOSE_PATIENT]、[ERRORS.WRONG_CURRENT_PASSWORD]、[ERRORS.BAD_REQUEST]……401未通过身份验证[ERRORS.AUTH_REQUIRED] （无令牌）、[ERRORS.SESSION_EXPIRED] （令牌无效或已过期）、[LOGIN.ERROR]403拒绝访问[ERRORS.FORBIDDEN] （角色权限不足）、[ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT] （没有通行令牌）404未找到[ERRORS.NOT_FOUND]、[ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND]、[ERRORS.APPOINTMENT_NOT_FOUND]……409违反业务规则[ERRORS.PAST_DATE]、[ERRORS.SLOT_ALREADY_BOOKED]、[ERRORS.LOGIN_TAKEN]、[ERRORS.CONCURRENT_UPDATE]……415非 JSON 格式的 POST[ERRORS.JSON_REQUIRED]429尝试次数过多[ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS]、[ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ACCOUNTS] （+ params.minutes）500服务器错误[ERRORS.SERVER_ERROR]

docs.title: 7.4. 身份验证
docs.text:
客户端使用[POST /api/auth/login]进行身份验证，提交用户名、密码和验证码答案。作为回应，服务器会在浏览器中放置一个Cookie，其中包含已签名的 JWT 令牌：

Set-Cookie: rdvmedecins_jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...; Max-Age=7200; Path=/api; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict

它的属性对安全性很重要：

  • [HttpOnly]：页面的[JavaScript]代码无法读取此 Cookie。因此，注入页面的恶意脚本无法窃取令牌。对客户端的影响是：它无法自行判断是否已登录，而要询问服务器（[GET /api/auth/me]）；
  • [Path=/api]：浏览器仅在发往 API 的请求中携带它；
  • [SameSite=Strict]：浏览器仅在从此站点的页面发出的请求中携带该令牌。另一个站点上的恶意页面无法让浏览器代表用户执行操作（即所谓的 CSRF 攻击）；
  • [Max-Age=7200]：它在两小时后过期，与令牌的过期时间一致。

此后，浏览器会在发往[/api]的每个请求中自动发送这个 Cookie。因此，只要页面和 API 共享[Angular] 客户端的同源 （相同的协议、相同的机器、相同的端口），客户端就无需做任何事情来验证自己的身份。这就是[Angular]开发服务器上代理的作用（参见示例 22），在生产环境中则由服务器自身承担（参见“部署”一章）。

针对 CSRF 攻击的第二重保护：服务器会拒绝（415）任何请求体不是 JSON 的 POST 请求。其他站点上被篡改的 HTML 表单无法发送 JSON。

docs.title: 7.5. API
docs.text:
方法地址角色发送的/响应的请求体GET[/api/captcha]公开响应：[{ id, svg }]POST[/api/auth/login]公开[{ login, password, captchaId, captcha }]；响应：[{ login, name, role }] + CookiePOST[/api/auth/logout]公开[{}]；删除 CookieGET[/api/auth/me]已登录响应：[{ login, name, role }]GET[/api/schedule?doctorId=&day=]全部响应：日程（未指定 doctorId 时：对 DOCTOR 而言，返回其本人的日程）POST[/api/appointments]全部[{ day, slotId, clientId }]（对于 USER，clientId 会被忽略）；201DELETE[/api/appointments/:id]全部USER 只能取消自己的预约GET[/api/doctors]全部列表（对 ADMIN 包含 login）GET[/api/clients]ADMIN, DOCTOR列表（对 ADMIN 包含 login）GET[/api/doctors/:id]、[/api/clients/:id]ADMIN一条记录POST[/api/doctors]、[/api/clients]ADMIN[{ title, firstName, lastName, login?, password? }]；201PUT[/api/doctors/:id]、[/api/clients/:id]ADMIN[{ title, firstName, lastName, login?, password?, version }]DELETE[/api/doctors/:id]、[/api/clients/:id]ADMIN响应：[{}]POST[/api/register/access]公开[{ captchaId, captcha }]；颁发令牌（Cookie）GET[/api/register/access]公开响应：[{ valid }]POST[/api/register]公开 + 通行令牌[{ title, firstName, lastName, login, password, confirmation }]；201GET[/api/my-area]USER响应：[{ patient, appointments }]GET[/api/my-account]USER响应：[{ title, firstName, lastName, login, version }]PUT[/api/my-account]USER[{ title, firstName, lastName, login, password?, confirmation?, currentPassword, version }]DELETE[/api/my-account]USER[{ currentPassword }]；删除账户及其预约

日程条目（[GET /api/schedule]）描述一个时间段，以及已登录用户被授权对它执行的操作：

{ "id": 3, "startHour": 8, "startMinute": 40, "endHour": 9, "endMinute": 0,
  "free": false,
  "patient": { "title": "Mme", "firstName": "Alice", "lastName": "DURAND" },
  "mine": false, "bookable": false, "appointmentId": 2 }
  • [free]：该时间段在当天是否可用？
  • [patient]：该预约的患者。对于已登录的患者，该值等于 [null]，但他们自己的预约除外：绝不会发送其他患者的姓名；
  • [mine]：这是已登录患者自己的预约；
  • [bookable]：用户能否预订该时间段（可用、不在过去，并且对患者而言没有未来的预约）？
  • [appointmentId]：如果用户可以取消该预约，则会设置该值。

服务器负责决定，客户端负责显示。即使客户端作弊（在不应显示时显示“预订”按钮），服务器在预订时也会再次核实一切。

docs.title: 7.6. 使用 curl 查询 API
docs.text:
服务器上的 [curl] 文件夹包含本章使用的 JSON 请求体，每个请求一个文件。例如 [curl/login-admin.json]：

{ "login": "admin", "password": "admin", "captchaId": "-", "captcha": "test" }

命令在打开于 [rdvmedecins-nestjs-json] 目录的控制台中输入。[curl] 的一些选项：

  • [-i]：同时显示响应头；[-s]：不显示进度条；
  • [--json @file]：以 POST 方式发送文件内容，并带有请求头 [Content-Type: application/json] （curl 7.82 及更高版本；如果是旧版本，请使用 [-H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @file]）；
  • [-X PUT]、[-X DELETE]：HTTP 方法；
  • [-c cookies.txt]：将收到的 Cookie 保存到该文件；[-b cookies.txt]：将它们发回。[curl] 就是这样在一条命令到下一条命令之间“保持登录”的，和浏览器的做法一样。

在 [PowerShell] 下，必须输入 [curl.exe] 而不是 [curl] （在那里它指的是另一条命令）。为便于阅读，本文档对较长的 JSON 响应做了格式化，并去掉了 [Date]、[ETag]、[Connection]、和 [Keep-Alive] 这几个响应头。

docs.title: 7.6.1. 登录
docs.text:
首先是验证码（CAPTCHA，图像已裁剪）：

$ curl -i http://localhost:8080/api/captcha
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Cache-Control: no-store
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 11304

{"id": "e33886ae-1a8b-4302-8cbc-cd7015e82f1f", "svg": "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"150..."}

没有令牌时，受保护的 URL 会返回 401 响应：

$ curl -i http://localhost:8080/api/doctors
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 47

{"statusCode": 401, "key": "ERRORS.AUTH_REQUIRED"}

错误的验证码，随后是错误的密码：

$ curl -i --json @curl/login-wrong-captcha.json http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 91

{"statusCode": 400, "key": "ERRORS.WRONG_CAPTCHA", "fields": {"captcha": "ERRORS.WRONG_CAPTCHA"}}

$ curl -i --json @curl/login-wrong-password.json http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 38

{"statusCode": 401, "key": "LOGIN.ERROR"}

登录成功会设置 Cookie，[curl] 将其存储在 [cookies.txt] 中：

$ curl -i -c cookies.txt --json @curl/login-admin.json http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Set-Cookie: rdvmedecins_jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...; Max-Age=7200; Path=/api; Expires=Mon, 28 Sep 2026 12:49:12 GMT; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 55

{"login": "admin", "name": "Administrator", "role": "ADMIN"}

有了这个 Cookie，服务器就知道我们是谁：

$ curl -i -b cookies.txt http://localhost:8080/api/auth/me
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 55

{"login": "admin", "name": "Administrator", "role": "ADMIN"}

伪造的（或已过期的）令牌会导致会话过期，服务器会指示浏览器删除该 Cookie：

$ curl -i -b "rdvmedecins_jwt=abc.def.ghi" http://localhost:8080/api/auth/me
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Set-Cookie: rdvmedecins_jwt=; Path=/api; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 49

{"statusCode": 401, "key": "ERRORS.SESSION_EXPIRED"}
