Content-Length: 55

{"statusCode": 404, "key": "ERRORS.APPOINTMENT_NOT_FOUND"}

他自己的预约则可以：

$ curl -i -b cookies-martin.txt -X DELETE http://localhost:8080/api/appointments/3
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 2

{}

docs.title: 7.6.5. 医生的视角
docs.text:
不带 [doctorId] 时，已登录的医生会收到他自己的日程，其中包含所有姓名：

$ curl -s -b cookies-pelissier.txt "http://localhost:8080/api/schedule?day=2030-01-15"
{
  "doctor": {"id": 1, "version": 0, "title": "Mme", "firstName": "Marie", "lastName": "PELISSIER"},
  "day": "2030-01-15",
  "slots": [
    {"id": 1, "startHour": 8, "startMinute": 0, "endHour": 8, "endMinute": 20, "free": true, "patient": null, "mine": false, "bookable": true, "appointmentId": null},
    {"id": 2, "startHour": 8, "startMinute": 20, "endHour": 8, "endMinute": 40, "free": true, "patient": null, "mine": false, "bookable": true, "appointmentId": null},
    {"id": 3, "startHour": 8, "startMinute": 40, "endHour": 9, "endMinute": 0, "free": false, "patient": {"title": "Mme", "firstName": "Alice", "lastName": "DURAND"}, "mine": false, "bookable": false, "appointmentId": 2},
    {"id": 4, "startHour": 9, "startMinute": 0, "endHour": 9, "endMinute": 20, "free": true, "patient": null, "mine": false, "bookable": true, "appointmentId": null},
    {"id": 5, "startHour": 9, "startMinute": 20, "endHour": 9, "endMinute": 40, "free": false, "patient": {"title": "Mr", "firstName": "Jean", "lastName": "MARTIN"}, "mine": false, "bookable": false, "appointmentId": 3},
    {"id": 6, "startHour": 9, "startMinute": 40, "endHour": 10, "endMinute": 0, "free": true, "patient": null, "mine": false, "bookable": true, "appointmentId": null},
    {"id": 7, "startHour": 10, "startMinute": 0, "endHour": 10, "endMinute": 20, "free": true, "patient": null, "mine": false, "bookable": true, "appointmentId": null},
    {"id": 8, "startHour": 10, "startMinute": 20, "endHour": 10, "endMinute": 40, "free": true, "patient": null, "mine": false, "bookable": true, "appointmentId": null},
    {"id": 9, "startHour": 10, "startMinute": 40, "endHour": 11, "endMinute": 0, "free": true, "patient": null, "mine": false, "bookable": true, "appointmentId": null},
    {"id": 10, "startHour": 11, "startMinute": 0, "endHour": 11, "endMinute": 20, "free": true, "patient": null, "mine": false, "bookable": true, "appointmentId": null},
    {"id": 11, "startHour": 11, "startMinute": 20, "endHour": 11, "endMinute": 40, "free": true, "patient": null, "mine": false, "bookable": true, "appointmentId": null},
    {"id": 12, "startHour": 11, "startMinute": 40, "endHour": 12, "endMinute": 0, "free": true, "patient": null, "mine": false, "bookable": true, "appointmentId": null}
  ],
  "info": null
}

他不能管理医生：

$ curl -i -b cookies-pelissier.txt --json @curl/doctor-add.json http://localhost:8080/api/doctors
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 43

{"statusCode": 403, "key": "ERRORS.FORBIDDEN"}

docs.title: 7.6.6. 管理医生和客户（ADMIN）
docs.text:
添加。如果缺少用户名，默认使用小写的姓名；密码即用户名：

{ "title": "Mme", "firstName": "Claire", "lastName": "LEROY" }

$ curl -i -b cookies.txt --json @curl/doctor-add.json http://localhost:8080/api/doctors
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 90

{"id": 4, "version": 1, "title": "Mme", "firstName": "Claire", "lastName": "LEROY", "login": "leroy"}

无效的请求体：响应会列出每个字段的错误：

{ "title": "Dr", "firstName": "", "lastName": "A-LAST-NAME-FAR-TOO-LONG-FOR-THE-DB", "login": "Claire L" }

$ curl -i -b cookies.txt --json @curl/doctor-invalid.json http://localhost:8080/api/doctors
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 218

{
  "statusCode": 400,
  "key": "ERRORS.INVALID_FORM",
  "params": {"min": "6"},
  "fields": {"login": "ERRORS.INVALID_LOGIN", "title": "ERRORS.INVALID_TITLE", "firstName": "ERRORS.FIRSTNAME_REQUIRED", "lastName": "ERRORS.LASTNAME_TOO_LONG"}
}

同名情况：两个相关字段都会被标记：

$ curl -i -b cookies.txt --json @curl/doctor-duplicate.json http://localhost:8080/api/doctors
HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 151

{"statusCode": 409, "key": "ERRORS.DOCTOR_ALREADY_EXISTS", "fields": {"firstName": "ERRORS.DOCTOR_ALREADY_EXISTS", "lastName": "ERRORS.DOCTOR_ALREADY_EXISTS"}}

修改。[version] 是从记录中读取的版本（此处为 1）：

{ "title": "Mme", "firstName": "Claire", "lastName": "LEROY-MARTIN", "version": 1 }

$ curl -i -b cookies.txt -X PUT --json @curl/doctor-edit.json http://localhost:8080/api/doctors/4
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 97

{"id": 4, "version": 2, "title": "Mme", "firstName": "Claire", "lastName": "LEROY-MARTIN", "login": "leroy"}

记录现在是版本 2。如果再次提交同一修改（带有版本 1），就会覆盖已被他人修改过的记录：乐观锁 可以防止这种情况：

$ curl -i -b cookies.txt -X PUT --json @curl/doctor-edit.json http://localhost:8080/api/doctors/4
HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 51

{"statusCode": 409, "key": "ERRORS.CONCURRENT_UPDATE"}

有预约的医生不能被删除；其他医生可以：

$ curl -i -b cookies.txt -X DELETE http://localhost:8080/api/doctors/1
HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 57

{"statusCode": 409, "key": "ERRORS.DOCTOR_HAS_APPOINTMENTS"}

$ curl -i -b cookies.txt -X DELETE http://localhost:8080/api/doctors/4
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 2

{}

docs.title: 7.6.7. 创建账户
docs.text:
没有通行码，就无法创建：

$ curl -i --json @curl/registration.json http://localhost:8080/api/register
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 56

{"statusCode": 403, "key": "ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT"}

首先，你要解答一个验证码（CAPTCHA）；服务器会签发一个有效期为 15 分钟的令牌，存放在 Cookie 中：

$ curl -i -c cookies-registration.txt --json @curl/captcha-test.json http://localhost:8080/api/register/access
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Set-Cookie: rdvmedecins_registration=73a037d1-78f2-4e8e-a3a5-b6660a4f7fd5; Max-Age=900; Path=/api/register; Expires=Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:04:12 GMT; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 2

{}

$ curl -s -b cookies-registration.txt http://localhost:8080/api/register/access
{"valid": true}

确认密码必须与密码一致：

$ curl -i -b cookies-registration.txt --json @curl/registration-confirmation.json http://localhost:8080/api/register
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 98

{"statusCode": 400, "key": "ERRORS.INVALID_FORM", "fields": {"confirmation": "ERRORS.PASSWORDS_DIFFER"}}

{ "title": "Mme", "firstName": "Julie", "lastName": "BERNARD", "login": "jbernard", "password": "secret1", "confirmation": "secret1" }

$ curl -i -b cookies-registration.txt -c cookies-registration.txt --json @curl/registration.json http://localhost:8080/api/register
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Set-Cookie: rdvmedecins_registration=; Path=/api/register; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 20

{"login": "jbernard"}

该通行码已被使用：不能再用它创建第二个账户：

$ curl -i -b cookies-registration.txt --json @curl/registration.json http://localhost:8080/api/register
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 56

{"statusCode": 403, "key": "ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT"}

docs.title: 7.6.8. 管理你的账户
docs.text:
新患者登录并读取她的账户记录：

$ curl -s -b cookies-jbernard.txt http://localhost:8080/api/my-account
{"title": "Mme", "firstName": "Julie", "lastName": "BERNARD", "login": "jbernard", "version": 1}

修改需要提供当前密码。服务器会签发一个包含新姓名的新令牌：

{ "title": "Mme", "firstName": "Julie", "lastName": "BERNARD-DUVAL", "login": "jbernard", "currentPassword": "secret1", "version": 1 }

$ curl -i -b cookies-jbernard.txt -c cookies-jbernard.txt -X PUT --json @curl/my-account.json http://localhost:8080/api/my-account
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Set-Cookie: rdvmedecins_jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...; Max-Age=7200; Path=/api; Expires=Mon, 28 Sep 2026 12:49:13 GMT; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 63

{"login": "jbernard", "name": "Julie BERNARD-DUVAL", "role": "USER"}

删除账户的同时也会删除 Cookie：

$ curl -i -b cookies-jbernard.txt -c cookies-jbernard.txt -X DELETE --json @curl/my-account-delete.json http://localhost:8080/api/my-account
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Set-Cookie: rdvmedecins_jwt=; Path=/api; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 2

{}

$ curl -i -b cookies-jbernard.txt http://localhost:8080/api/auth/me
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 47

{"statusCode": 401, "key": "ERRORS.AUTH_REQUIRED"}

docs.title: 7.6.9. 一些错误
docs.text:
未知的路由，以及不是有效 JSON 的请求体：

$ curl -i -b cookies-martin.txt http://localhost:8080/api/does-not-exist
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 43

{"statusCode": 404, "key": "ERRORS.NOT_FOUND"}

$ curl -i -b cookies.txt -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{not json" http://localhost:8080/api/appointments
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 45

{"statusCode": 400, "key": "ERRORS.BAD_REQUEST"}

关于服务器，我们现在已经掌握了编写客户端所需知道的一切。

docs.title: 11. 部署
docs.text:
在开发阶段，有两个服务器协同工作：[Angular] 开发服务器（客户端）和 JSON 服务器（API）。在生产环境中，只有一个：

1. 构建客户端。在 [rdvmedecins-angular] 文件夹中：

npm run build

控制台显示：

> rdvmedecins-angular@1.0.0 build
> ng build

✔ Building...
Initial chunk files | Names         |  Raw size | Estimated transfer size
chunk-BruCX3rK.js   | -             | 296.78 kB |                80.48 kB
styles-XPRPA6EW.css | styles        | 231.34 kB |                22.81 kB
main-3NXKYGU5.js    | main          | 126.90 kB |                31.26 kB

                    | Initial total | 655.02 kB |               134.55 kB

Lazy chunk files    | Names         |  Raw size | Estimated transfer size
chunk-B1I-NpSr.js   | my-account    |   4.57 kB |                 1.57 kB
chunk-D5fQy4dw.js   | -             |   3.58 kB |                 1.35 kB
chunk-BQacMvxR.js   | person-form   |   3.40 kB |                 1.42 kB
chunk-DQ2njJU7.js   | patient-area  |   3.37 kB |                 1.40 kB
chunk-1j2zX3Jb.js   | persons       |   3.21 kB |                 1.32 kB
chunk-Cg9nGEEi.js   | register      |   3.13 kB |                 1.27 kB
chunk-C7lHBFC2.js   | error         | 841 bytes |               841 bytes
chunk-DXwhrlsA.js   | -             | 514 bytes |               514 bytes

Application bundle generation complete. [7.124 seconds]

Output location: .../rdvmedecins-angular/dist/rdvmedecins-angular

[dist/rdvmedecins-angular/browser/] 文件夹包含整个应用程序：一个 [index.html] 页面、一个样式表，以及经过优化的 [JavaScript] 文件（[Angular] 的代码、路由器、[ngx-translate]……以及我们自己的代码）：

  • 初始文件在启动时下载：经服务器压缩后约 135 KB；
  • 每个按需加载的页面（[loadComponent]）都有自己的文件，在首次访问时下载；
  • 每个文件的名称都包含其内容的哈希值（[main-3NXKYGU5.js]）：新版本将具有不同的名称，因此浏览器永远不会缓存过时的版本；
  • 编译器已检查在 [angular.json] 中设置的预算：出现警告则表示应用程序已变得过大。

2. 上传到服务器。将 [dist/rdvmedecins-angular/browser/] 文件夹的全部内容复制到 JSON 服务器根目录下的 [client/] 文件夹中（[rdvmedecins-nestjs-json/client/index.html]、[rdvmedecins-nestjs-json/client/main-3NXKYGU5.js]……），然后重启服务器。它显示：

[Nest] LOG [RdvMedecins] Angular client served from .../rdvmedecins-nestjs-json/client
[Nest] LOG [RdvMedecins] JSON server started: http://localhost:8080/api

完整的应用程序现在可以通过 http://localhost:8080 访问。服务器提供客户端的文件，并对 /api 之外的任何其他 URL 返回 [index.html] ：重新加载 /schedule 页面也能正常工作（该页面是由客户端的浏览器显示的）。对此好奇的读者可以看看，执行这项任务的是服务器上的 [src/web/client-spa.ts] 文件。

3. 在真实的生产环境中，不要忘记服务器上的 [.env] 文件：

  • 一个长且随机的 [JWT_SECRET]；
  • 一个空的 [CAPTCHA_TEST]；
  • [COOKIE_SECURE=true] 如果站点通过 HTTPS 提供服务（必须如此：因为要传输密码）；
  • [TRUST_PROXY=true] 如果服务器位于代理（[nginx]……）之后，以便尝试次数限制能看到客户端的真实 IP 地址。

然后启动已编译的服务器：[npm run build]，接着执行 [npm run start:prod]。

docs.title: 3.1. 示例 10：组件及其输入
docs.text:
组件是界面中可复用的一部分。本示例显示医生的简介：一个名为[DoctorCard]（子组件）的组件，被组件[App]（父组件）多次使用。

组件的文件通常存放在以组件命名的文件夹中：

10-components/src/app/
├── doctor-card/
│   ├── doctor-card.ts     the class of the component
│   ├── doctor-card.html   its template
│   └── doctor-card.css    its style
├── doctor.ts             the Doctor type
├── app.ts
└── app.html

父组件和子组件共享的数据类型：

// the data type shared by the parent (App) and the child (DoctorCard)
export interface Doctor {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  specialty: string;
  available: boolean;
}

docs.title: 3.1.1. 子组件
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 10-components/src/app/doctor-card/doctor-card.ts - a CHILD component
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// It receives its data from its parent through INPUTS, declared
// with input(): each input is a read-only SIGNAL, which follows the
// value passed by the parent. Their type is checked at compile time:
// <app-doctor-card [doctor]="42"> would be rejected.
//
// Golden rule: a component NEVER MODIFIES its inputs. The data
// goes down from the parent to the child; to request a change,
// the child emits an event (see example 11).
// =========================================================================

import { booleanAttribute, Component, computed, input } from '@angular/core';
import { Doctor } from '../doctor';

@Component({
  // the selector: the tag that represents this component in its parent
  selector: 'app-doctor-card',
  templateUrl: './doctor-card.html',
  styleUrl: './doctor-card.css',
})
export class DoctorCard {
  // input.required: the parent MUST provide this input
  readonly doctor = input.required<Doctor>();
  readonly rank = input.required<number>();
  // input(default value): an optional input. booleanAttribute
  // allows simply writing <app-doctor-card compact> for true
  readonly compact = input(false, { transform: booleanAttribute });

  // a computed based on an input: recomputed if the parent changes it
  protected readonly initials = computed(() => `${this.doctor().firstName[0]}${this.doctor().lastName[0]}`);
}
  • 第 19 行：选择器：父组件将写[<app-doctor-card>]；
  • 第 25–29 行：组件的输入（[inputs]）——由其父组件传递给它的数据。[input()]创建一个只读信号，用于跟踪父组件传入的值：
    • 第 25–26 行：[input.required<T>()]：必需的输入。如果父组件的模板中省略了[[doctor]]，将导致编译错误；
    • 第 29 行：[input(default value)]：可选的输入。[transform]选项用于转换接收到的值：[booleanAttribute]将属性的存在（[<app-doctor-card compact>]，没有值）转换为[true]，就像 HTML 属性[disabled]一样；
  • 第 32 行：一个基于输入的 [computed]：如果父组件改变了输入，就会重新计算。

输入不是[protected]的：它们是组件公共接口的一部分，也就是其父组件所使用的接口。

黄金法则：组件绝不修改自己的输入（无论如何它们都是只读的）。数据从父组件流向子组件；若要请求更改，子组件会发出事件（示例 11）。

<div class="card h-100" [class.border-success]="doctor().available">
  <div class="card-body d-flex gap-3 align-items-center">
    <div class="initials">{{ initials() }}</div>
    <div>
      <!-- the inputs are signals: they are read by calling them -->
      <h2 class="h6 mb-1">{{ rank() }}. {{ doctor().title }} {{ doctor().firstName }} {{ doctor().lastName }}</h2>
      @if (!compact()) {
        <p class="mb-0 text-muted small">{{ doctor().specialty }}</p>
      }
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
  • 第 1、6、8 行：输入是信号：通过调用它们来读取；
  • 第 7–9 行：专业仅在卡片的普通版本中显示。
/* the style of the component: it only applies to ITS elements */
.initials {
  width: 2.5rem;
  height: 2.5rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: #dd0031;
  color: white;
  font-weight: bold;
}

类[initials]仅作用于此组件：另一个组件可以有自己的类[initials]，而不会产生任何冲突。

docs.title: 3.1.2. 父组件
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 10-components/src/app/app.ts - the PARENT component
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// It imports the DoctorCard component (imports array) and uses it as
// a new HTML tag, <app-doctor-card>, as many times as
// needed: a component is a REUSABLE piece of interface, with its
// own data, its template and its style.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { DoctorCard } from './doctor-card/doctor-card';
import { Doctor } from './doctor';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [FormsModule, DoctorCard],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  protected readonly doctors = signal<Doctor[]>([
    { id: 1, title: 'Mme', firstName: 'Marie', lastName: 'PELISSIER', specialty: 'general practitioner', available: true },
    { id: 2, title: 'Mr', firstName: 'Paul', lastName: 'TATOU', specialty: 'pediatrician', available: false },
    { id: 3, title: 'Melle', firstName: 'Sophie', lastName: 'DUPONT', specialty: 'general practitioner', available: true },
  ]);
  protected readonly compact = signal(false);

  // the parent modifies ITS data: the children concerned are updated
  protected toggleAvailability(): void {
    this.doctors.update((list) => list.map((m) => ({ ...m, available: !m.available })));
  }
}
  • 第 17 行：父组件导入子组件；否则，[<app-doctor-card>]将是一个未知标签，编译会失败；
  • 第 29–31 行：父组件修改它自己的数据。它将每位医生替换为一个修改后的副本：传给每张卡片的[m]对象发生变化，卡片随之更新。
<div class="container py-4">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 10 - components and their inputs</h1>
  <div class="d-flex gap-3 mb-3">
    <label class="form-check-label">
      <input type="checkbox" class="form-check-input" [(ngModel)]="compact"> compact display
    </label>
    <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" (click)="toggleAvailability()">Toggle availability</button>
  </div>
  <div class="row g-3">
    @for (m of doctors(); track m.id; let i = $index) {
      <div class="col-md-4">
        <!-- [doctor]="m" passes the OBJECT m (an expression);
             doctor="m", without brackets, would pass the STRING "m" -->
        <app-doctor-card [doctor]="m" [rank]="i + 1" [compact]="compact()" />
      </div>
    }
  </div>
  <p class="mt-3 mb-1 small text-muted">The same card, in compact version, through an attribute without a value:</p>
  <div class="w-50">
    <app-doctor-card [doctor]="doctors()[0]" [rank]="1" compact />
  </div>
</div>
  • 第 14 行：子组件被用作 HTML 标签。[[doctor]="m"]是对输入 [doctor]的属性绑定：它传递的是对象 [m]。如果没有方括号，[doctor="m"]传递的将是字符串 ["m"]，编译器会拒绝它。没有内容的组件可以使用自闭合标签来书写（[/>]）；
  • 第 20 行：[compact]，没有值：得益于 [booleanAttribute]，输入接收到 [true]。

[npm start 10-components]；点击“Toggle availability”：

docs.title: 3.2. 示例 11：组件的输出与 model()
docs.text:
子组件有两种方式将信息发回给父组件：

  1. 发出一个事件（即输出，[output]），父组件像监听 HTML 事件一样监听它；2. 在 [model()] 上建立双向连接，[[( )]]。

docs.title: 3.2.1. 发送事件
docs.text:
一个计数器，每次点击以及达到上限时都会通知其父组件：

// =========================================================================
// 11-outputs-model/src/app/counter/counter.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A child that NOTIFIES its parent: output() declares an event that the
// component can emit, with the type of its data. The parent listens to it
// like an HTML event: <app-counter (incremented)="..." (limit)="...">.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, input, output, signal } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-counter',
  template: `
    <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 mb-2">
      <span class="w-25">{{ label() }}</span>
      <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" (click)="plus()">+1</button>
      <span class="badge text-bg-secondary">{{ value() }} / {{ max() }}</span>
    </div>
  `,
})
export class Counter {
  readonly label = input.required<string>();
  readonly max = input.required<number>();

  // two events: incremented (with the new value) and limit (without data)
  readonly incremented = output<number>();
  readonly limit = output<void>();

  protected readonly value = signal(0);

  protected plus(): void {
    if (this.value() >= this.max()) {
      this.limit.emit();
      return;
    }
    this.value.update((v) => v + 1);
    this.incremented.emit(this.value());
  }
}
  • 第 13–19 行：组件的模板，写在装饰器中（属性 [template]，用反引号括起来）；
  • 第 26–27 行：[output<T>()] 声明一个输出：组件可以发出的事件，以及其数据的类型。[limit] 没有数据（[void]）；
  • 第 33 行和第 37 行：[emit(data)] 发出事件；父组件接收数据。

避免以浏览器事件命名输出（[change]、[click]……）：组件内部元素发出的浏览器事件会向上冒泡到其宿主元素，父组件也会接收到它们。

docs.title: 3.2.2. 双向绑定
docs.text:
一个“自定义”表单字段（标签、字段、提示、字符计数器），与父组件的数据（例如 [ngModel]）相关联：

// =========================================================================
// 11-outputs-model/src/app/text-field/text-field.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A "home-made" form field (label + field + help + character
// counter) that accepts a TWO-way binding, like ngModel:
//     <app-text-field [(value)]="lastName" label="Last name" [max]="20" />
//
// model() creates a WRITABLE signal linked to the parent: READING it gives the
// parent's value, WRITING it (set) emits the valueChange event, which the
// [( )] syntax turns into an update of the parent's signal. The data
// thus really remains the property of the parent.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, input, model } from '@angular/core';

// a counter shared by all the instances: a unique identifier per
// field, to link <label for> and <input id>
let nextNumber = 0;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-text-field',
  template: `
    <div class="mb-3">
      <label class="form-label" [for]="id">{{ label() }}</label>
      <!-- [value]: the value of the parent; (input): each keystroke replaces it -->
      <input class="form-control" [id]="id" [value]="value()" [attr.maxlength]="max()"
             [class.is-invalid]="value().length === max()" (input)="onInput($event)">
      <div class="form-text">{{ help() }} ({{ value().length }} / {{ max() }})</div>
    </div>
  `,
})
export class TextField {
  readonly value = model.required<string>();
  readonly label = input.required<string>();
  readonly max = input.required<number>();
  readonly help = input('');

  protected readonly id = `text-field-${++nextNumber}`;

  protected onInput(event: Event): void {
    this.value.set((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
  }
}
  • 第 33 行：[model()] 创建一个可写信号，并与父组件关联。读取它会返回父组件的值；写入它（[set]，第 41 行）会修改该值并发出事件 [valueChange]（模型名称后加 [Change]）。因此，使用 [[(value)]="signal"] 进行写入的父组件，其信号会被更新；
  • 第 18 行：一个模块变量（位于类之外）由组件的所有实例共享：一个为每个字段分配唯一标识符的计数器（第 38 行），用于关联 [<label for>] 和 [<input id>]；
  • 第 26–27 行：[[value]] 显示父组件的值；[(input)] 在每次按键时替换它（第 41 行）。[[attr.maxlength]] 是对 HTML 的 attribute 绑定（attribute [maxlength]），而不是 property 绑定。

docs.title: 3.2.3. 父组件
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 11-outputs-model/src/app/app.ts - the parent listens to its children
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Two ways for a child to pass information up:
//   1. emitting an event (output), which the parent listens to with ( );
//   2. a two-way binding [( )] on a model(): a shortcut
//      for the input [value] + the event (valueChange).
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { Counter } from './counter/counter';
import { TextField } from './text-field/text-field';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [Counter, TextField],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  protected readonly total = signal(0);
  protected readonly message = signal('');
  protected readonly firstName = signal('Marie');
  protected readonly lastName = signal('PELISSIER');
  protected readonly fullName = computed(() => `${this.firstName()} ${this.lastName().toUpperCase()}`);

  // the handler of the incremented event: it receives the emitted data ($event)
  protected onChange(label: string, value: number): void {
    this.total.update((t) => t + 1);
    this.message.set(`${label} is now ${value}`);
  }

  protected clear(): void {
    this.firstName.set('');
    this.lastName.set('');
  }
}

<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 640px">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 11 - the outputs of a component and model()</h1>

  <div class="card p-3 mb-4">
    <h2 class="h6">1. Events emitted by the children</h2>
    <!-- $event: the data emitted by the child (here, the new value) -->
    <app-counter label="Coffees" [max]="3" (incremented)="onChange('Coffees', $event)"
                  (limit)="message.set('No more than 3 coffees!')" />
    <app-counter label="Glasses of water" [max]="8" (incremented)="onChange('Glasses of water', $event)"
                  (limit)="message.set('Enough drinking.')" />
    <p class="mb-0">Total clicks: {{ total() }} - <em>{{ message() }}</em></p>
  </div>

  <div class="card p-3">
    <h2 class="h6">2. A two-way binding with model()</h2>
    <!-- [(value)]="firstName": the firstName signal of the parent, read AND modified by the child -->
    <app-text-field [(value)]="firstName" label="First name" [max]="20" help="Required" />
    <app-text-field [(value)]="lastName" label="Last name" [max]="20" help="Displayed in upper case" />
    <p class="mb-0">Data of the parent: <strong>{{ fullName() }}</strong></p>
    <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary mt-2 align-self-start" (click)="clear()">Clear (from the parent)</button>
  </div>
</div>
  • 第 7 行：[(incremented)="..."] 监听来自计数器的输出 [incremented] ；[$event] 是输出的数据（新值）。[label="Coffees"]，不带方括号：字符串类型的输入可以接收常量值；
  • 第 8 行：[(limit)]：信号的方法（[set]）可以直接在模板中调用；
  • 第 9 行：第二个计数器，有自己的标签、上限和消息；
  • 第 17 行：[[(value)]="firstName"]：父组件的信号 [firstName] （不带括号：指定的是信号本身），由子组件读取并修改。这是 [[value]="firstName()" (valueChange)="firstName.set($event)"] 的简写；
  • 第 20 行：父组件修改自己的数据：两个字段随之更新。

[npm start 11-outputs-model]；点击咖啡四次，点击水一次，然后输入姓名：

docs.title: 3.3. 示例 12：内容投影
docs.text: 输入传递数据；内容投影传递内容（来自 HTML 和其他组件），由父组件写在组件标签之间。这相当于 [layout.hbs] 模板在 [NestJS] 课程中的客户端对应物，以及其 [{{{body}}}]。

docs.title: 3.3.1. 卡片
docs.text:
一个可复用的框架（边框、页眉、页脚），其内容由父组件提供：

// =========================================================================
// 12-projection/src/app/card/card.ts - a reusable TEMPLATE
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The inputs pass DATA; content PROJECTION passes
// CONTENT (HTML, other components), written by the parent BETWEEN the
// <app-card> and </app-card> tags. The card sets the frame (border,
// header, footer), the parent provides what goes inside:
//   - <ng-content />                   : the "main" content;
//   - <ng-content select="[header]" /> : only the elements that have
//                                        the header attribute;
//   - the content placed BETWEEN <ng-content> and </ng-content> is displayed if
//     the parent provides nothing (default content).
// It is the client-side equivalent of the layout.hbs template and its {{{body}}}
// in the NestJS course.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, input } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-card',
  template: `
    <div class="card mb-3" [class]="color() ? 'border-' + color() : ''">
      <div class="card-header" [class]="color() ? 'text-bg-' + color() : ''">
        <ng-content select="[header]">Untitled</ng-content>
      </div>
      <div class="card-body">
        <ng-content />
      </div>
      <!-- an empty footer (the parent provided nothing) is hidden by the CSS :empty -->
      <div class="card-footer text-muted small"><ng-content select="[footer]" /></div>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: `
    .card-footer:empty {
      display: none;
    }
  `,
})
export class Card {
  readonly color = input<'primary' | 'success' | 'danger'>();
}
  • 第 27 行：[<ng-content />]：[Angular] 放置父组件写在 [<app-card>] 和 [</app-card>] 之间的内容的位置；
  • 第 24 行：[<ng-content select="[header]">]：仅限具有 [header] 属性的内容元素。[select] 接受 CSS 选择器（标签、类或属性）。[<ng-content>] 和 [</ng-content>] 之间的文本会在父元素未提供任何内容时显示：这就是默认内容；
  • 第 30 行：页脚：具有 [footer] 属性的元素；
  • 第 33–37 行：空的页脚（父元素未提供任何内容）会被隐藏：CSS 伪类 [:empty] 表示没有内容的元素；
  • 第 40 行：一个可选输入，只能取三个值；如果未指定默认值，则默认为 [undefined]。

docs.title: 3.3.2. 泛型数组
docs.text:
一个知道如何遍历各行、但不知道如何显示某一行的数组：其父组件通过向它传递行模板来告诉它如何显示。

// =========================================================================
// 12-projection/src/app/data-table/data-table.ts - a GENERIC table
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// DataTable<T> is a generic class: it displays rows of any
// type T. It knows how to iterate over the rows, but not how to display ONE
// row: the parent tells it, by passing it a row TEMPLATE
// (an <ng-template #row>, a piece of HTML that is not displayed as
// is, but that can be displayed on demand, as many times as needed).
//
// contentChild('row'): the <ng-template #row> placed by the parent between
// <app-data-table> and </app-data-table>. The table displays it for each row
// with ngTemplateOutlet, passing it a CONTEXT: the row ($implicit)
// and its rank (index). The content provided by the parent thus uses
// data that belongs to the child.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, contentChild, input, TemplateRef } from '@angular/core';
import { NgTemplateOutlet } from '@angular/common';

// what the table passes to the template of each row
export interface RowContext<T> {
  $implicit: T; // the value retrieved by let-row
  index: number; // retrieved by let-i="index"
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-data-table',
  imports: [NgTemplateOutlet],
  template: `
    <table class="table table-sm align-middle mb-0">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          @for (c of columns(); track c) {
            <th>{{ c }}</th>
          }
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        @for (l of rows(); track l.id; let i = $index) {
          <tr>
            <ng-container [ngTemplateOutlet]="rowTemplate() ?? null" [ngTemplateOutletContext]="{ $implicit: l, index: i }" />
          </tr>
        } @empty {
          <tr>
            <td class="text-muted" [attr.colspan]="columns().length">
              <ng-content select="[empty]">No data.</ng-content>
            </td>
          </tr>
        }
      </tbody>
    </table>
  `,
})
export class DataTable<T extends { id: number }> {
  readonly rows = input.required<T[]>();
  readonly columns = input.required<string[]>();
  protected readonly rowTemplate = contentChild<TemplateRef<RowContext<T>>>('row');
}
  • 第 54 行：[DataTable<T>] 是一个泛型类：它可以显示任意类型 [T] 的行，前提是它们具有 [id] （用于 [track]，第 39 行）；
  • 第 57 行：[contentChild('row')]：一个信号，引用投影内容中标记为 [#row] 的元素。它将是一个 [<ng-template>]：一段不会按原样显示、但可以按需显示任意多次的 HTML（一个 [TemplateRef]）；
  • 第 41 行：[ngTemplateOutlet] 指令通过向模板传递一个上下文来显示它——上下文是一个对象，其属性会成为模板中的变量。[$implicit] 是默认值（第 21–24 行）；
  • 第 43–49 行：如果列表为空，则显示块 [@empty]，包含投影内容（[[empty]]）和默认内容；
  • 第 45 行：[[attr.colspan]]：attribute 绑定，因为 [colspan] 不是 [<td>] 元素的 property。

docs.title: 3.3.3. 父组件
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 12-projection/src/app/app.ts - using the Card and DataTable templates
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { Card } from './card/card';
import { DataTable } from './data-table/data-table';

interface Slot {
  id: number;
  time: string;
  patient: string | null;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [Card, DataTable],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  protected readonly slots = signal<Slot[]>([
    { id: 1, time: '8:00 - 8:20', patient: null },
    { id: 2, time: '8:20 - 8:40', patient: 'Mme Alice DURAND' },
    { id: 3, time: '8:40 - 9:00', patient: null },
  ]);
  protected readonly free = computed(() => this.slots().filter((c) => c.patient === null).length);
  protected readonly nobody: { id: number; name: string }[] = [];
}

<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 720px">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 12 - content projection</h1>

  <app-card color="primary">
    <!-- the header attribute: this <span> will go into the <ng-content select="[header]"> -->
    <span header>Schedule of Mme PELISSIER</span>
    <!-- everything that has neither header nor footer goes into the main <ng-content /> -->
    <app-data-table [rows]="slots()" [columns]="['#', 'Slot', 'Status']">
      <!-- the template of a row: let-c receives the row, let-i its rank -->
      <ng-template #row let-c let-i="index">
        <td>{{ i + 1 }}</td>
        <td>{{ c.time }}</td>
        <td>
          @if (c.patient) {
            <span class="badge text-bg-secondary">{{ c.patient }}</span>
          } @else {
            <span class="badge text-bg-success">Free</span>
          }
        </td>
      </ng-template>
    </app-data-table>
    <span footer>{{ free() }} free slot(s)</span>
  </app-card>

  <app-card color="success">
    <span header>A card without a footer</span>
    <p class="mb-0">The footer is not provided: the card does not display it.</p>
  </app-card>

  <app-card>
    <!-- no header provided: the default content, "Untitled" -->
    <app-data-table [rows]="nobody" [columns]="['Name']">
      <span empty>Nobody for now.</span>
    </app-data-table>
  </app-card>
</div>
  • 第 4–23 行：一张蓝色卡片。其内容由卡片分配：[<span header>] （第 6 行）进入页眉，[<span footer>] （第 22 行）进入页脚，其余部分（表格）进入主体；
  • 第 10–20 行：行的模板。[let-c] 从上下文（该行）中获取值 [$implicit] ，而 [let-i="index"] 获取 其属性 [index]。因此，父组件提供的内容使用的是属于子组件的数据；
  • 第 25–28 行：没有页脚的卡片；
  • 第 30–35 行：没有页眉的卡片（默认内容“Untitled”），以及一个空表格。

[npm start 12-projection]：

编译器无法识别模板中 [c] 的类型（第 10–20 行）：它将其视为 [any]。这可以补救（通过声明上下文类型的指令），代价是多写一点代码；这是该技术的局限。

docs.title: 3.4. 示例 13：组件的生命周期
docs.text: 组件会被创建、显示、存在，然后消失。[Angular] 允许你在每个阶段采取行动：这就是组件的生命周期。

docs.title: 3.4.1. 时钟
docs.text:
时钟在创建时启动一个定时器……并且必须在它消失时停止该定时器：否则，定时器会无故继续运行（内存泄漏）。

// =========================================================================
// 13-lifecycle/src/app/clock/clock.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The lifecycle of a component:
//   1. constructor      : the class is created; the inputs are not
//                         available yet;
//   2. ngOnInit         : the inputs have received their first value;
//   3. afterNextRender  : the component is DISPLAYED, its HTML elements
//                         exist in the page;
//   4. ngOnDestroy      : the component is about to be REMOVED from the page.
// A clock starts a timer (setInterval) at startup... and must
// absolutely stop it when it disappears: otherwise the timer would
// keep running for nothing (memory leak).
// =========================================================================

import { afterNextRender, Component, OnDestroy, OnInit, output, signal } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-clock',
  template: `<div class="display-6 font-monospace">{{ time() }}</div>`,
})
// implements OnInit, OnDestroy: TypeScript checks that the methods exist
export class Clock implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  readonly log = output<string>();
  protected readonly time = signal(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
  private timer: number | undefined;

  constructor() {
    console.log('Clock: constructor'); // the parent does not listen to log yet
    // afterNextRender is registered in the constructor; the function is
    // called once, just after the first display of the component
    afterNextRender(() => this.log.emit('Clock: afterNextRender - displayed'));
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.log.emit('Clock: ngOnInit - starting the timer');
    this.timer = window.setInterval(() => this.time.set(new Date().toLocaleTimeString()), 1000);
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    window.clearInterval(this.timer);
    this.log.emit('Clock: ngOnDestroy - timer stopped');
  }
}

步骤：

  • 第 28–33 行：构造函数：类被创建。输入尚未被赋值，父组件也尚未监听输出（因此第 29 行使用 [console.log] ，而不是 [emit]）；
  • 第 35–38 行：[ngOnInit()]：输入已收到其第一个值。这是触发依赖它们的操作的常用位置：加载、定时器；
  • 第 32 行：[afterNextRender(function)]，在构造函数中调用，注册一个只执行一次的函数，在组件被首次显示后立即执行：其 HTML 元素此时已存在于页面上；
  • 第 40–43 行：[ngOnDestroy()]：组件即将从页面移除。定时器被停止。

[implements OnInit, OnDestroy] （第 23 行）不是必需的：[Angular] 会调用 [ngOnInit] （如果存在）。但 [TypeScript] 随后会验证这些方法是否书写正确。

[Angular] 提供了其他阶段，自从引入信号以来，它们的用处变小了：[ngOnChanges]（某个输入发生了变化；对于该输入，我们更倾向于使用 [computed] 或 [effect] ）、[ngAfterViewInit]……以及 [ngOnDestroy]的一种替代方式：[inject(DestroyRef).onDestroy(function)]，示例 14 将使用它。

docs.title: 3.4.2. 父组件
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 13-lifecycle/src/app/app.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//   - @if around <app-clock>: checking / unchecking the box creates / destroys
//     the component (ngOnInit / ngOnDestroy, see clock.ts);
//   - viewChild('field'): a signal that gives the HTML element marked #field
//     in the template (undefined as long as it is not displayed);
//   - effect: executed a first time, then on each change of the
//     signals it reads. Here, to give the focus to the field as soon as it
//     appears, and so that the title of the tab follows what is typed.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, effect, ElementRef, OnInit, signal, viewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Clock } from './clock/clock';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [FormsModule, Clock],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App implements OnInit {
  protected readonly withClock = signal(true);
  protected readonly log = signal<string[]>([]);
  protected readonly search = signal('');
  protected readonly showSearch = signal(false);

  // the <input #field> element of the template; ElementRef.nativeElement: the HTML element
  private readonly field = viewChild<ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>>('field');

  constructor() {
    // the field appears (viewChild changes): we give it the focus
    effect(() => this.field()?.nativeElement.focus());
    // the title of the tab follows what is typed, from the start
    effect(() => {
      const text = this.search();
      document.title = text ? `Search: ${text}` : 'Example 13';
    });
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.trace('App: ngOnInit');
  }

  protected trace(message: string): void {
    this.log.update((j) => [...j, `${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()} ${message}`]);
  }
}
  • 第 29 行：[viewChild('field')]：一个信号，引用标记为 [#field] 的模板元素。它被设置为 [undefined] ，只要该元素不存在（该字段仅在点击后才出现）。[ElementRef] 包装 HTML 元素，可通过其属性 [nativeElement]访问；
  • 第 33 行：一个 [effect] 读取该信号：当字段出现时，effect 会再次触发并使其获得焦点。无需“等待”页面刷新：只有在元素创建之后，信号才会改变；
  • 第 35–38 行：第二个 effect：随着文本输入，标签页标题会更新，从一开始就是如此（effect 总是在开始时运行一次）；
  • 第 41–43 行：父元素也有它自己的 [ngOnInit]。
<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 720px">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 13 - the lifecycle of a component</h1>

  <div class="card p-3 mb-3">
    <label class="form-check-label mb-2">
      <input type="checkbox" class="form-check-input" [(ngModel)]="withClock"> show the clock
    </label>
    @if (withClock()) {
      <app-clock (log)="trace($event)" />
    }
  </div>

  <div class="card p-3 mb-3">
    @if (!showSearch()) {
      <button class="btn btn-outline-primary align-self-start" (click)="showSearch.set(true)">Search...</button>
    } @else {
      <!-- #field: the element designated by viewChild('field') -->
      <input #field class="form-control" placeholder="the tab title follows what you type" [(ngModel)]="search">
    }
  </div>

  <h2 class="h6">Log</h2>
  <ol class="small">
    @for (line of log(); track $index) {
      <li>{{ line }}</li>
    }
  </ol>
</div>
  • 第 8–10 行：勾选或取消勾选复选框会创建或销毁时钟：[@if] 实际上是在页面中添加或移除该组件；
  • 第 18 行：[#field]，即 [viewChild('field')] 所引用的元素。

[npm start 13-lifecycle]；取消勾选再重新勾选复选框，然后点击“Search...”：

日志显示了各步骤的顺序：首先是父组件（[App: ngOnInit]），然后是时钟（[ngOnInit]、[afterNextRender]），接着是它的销毁（[ngOnDestroy]），以及一个新的时钟。搜索字段获得了焦点。

docs.title: 3.5. 示例 14：服务与依赖注入
docs.text:
一个服务 是将多个组件共享的数据和代码组合在一起的类：服务器访问、已登录用户、购物车等。组件不会创建服务（绝不要 [new CartService()]）：它们会请求这些服务，请求对象是 [Angular]，方式是使用 [inject()] 函数。这就是 依赖注入，即 [NestJS] 课程在服务器端介绍过的机制。

当组件请求某个服务时，[Angular] 会查找谁提供了它：先是组件本身，然后是它的父组件，父组件的父组件……一直向上到应用程序。因此，根据提供位置的不同，服务的共享范围有大有小。此示例展示了三个层级。

docs.title: 3.5.1. 根服务
docs.text:
import { Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class LogService {
  private readonly _lines = signal<string[]>([]);
  // asReadonly(): the components READ the lines; only the service modifies them
  readonly lines = this._lines.asReadonly();

  trace(message: string): void {
    this._lines.update((l) => [`${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()} ${message}`, ...l].slice(0, 6));
  }
}
  • 第 14 行：[@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })]：该服务在应用程序的根 级别提供。[Angular] 在首次请求时创建唯一的实例，所有请求它的组件都会收到该实例；
  • 第 16–18 行：行数据是私有的；[asReadonly()] 提供其公开的只读版本。组件读取这些行；只有服务才会修改它们（第 21 行）。这是维护状态的服务的标准组织方式。

docs.title: 3.5.2. 由组件提供的服务
docs.text:
import { computed, inject, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { LogService } from './log.service';

export interface Item {
  label: string;
  price: number;
}

@Injectable()
export class CartService {
  // a service can itself request other services
  private readonly log = inject(LogService);

  private readonly _items = signal<Item[]>([]);
  readonly items = this._items.asReadonly();
  readonly total = computed(() => this._items().reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.price, 0));

  add(item: Item): void {
    this._items.update((a) => [...a, item]);
    this.log.trace(`cart: + ${item.label}`);
  }

  remove(index: number): void {
    this.log.trace(`cart: - ${this._items()[index].label}`);
    this._items.update((a) => a.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  }
}
  • 第 19 行：[@Injectable()] 不带 [providedIn]：该服务默认不在任何地方提供。组件会在其[providers] 数组中提供它；
  • 第 22 行：服务本身也可以请求其他服务：购物车会被记录日志；
  • 第 24–26 行：购物车的状态（私有）、其只读版本及其总额；
  • 第 28–36 行：修改状态的两个操作。

docs.title: 3.5.3. 已配置的服务
docs.text:
import { DestroyRef, inject, Injectable, InjectionToken, signal } from '@angular/core';

// factory: the value used if nobody provides this token
export const CLOCK_PERIOD = new InjectionToken<number>('period of the clock', { factory: () => 1000 });

@Injectable()
export class ClockService {
  private readonly period = inject(CLOCK_PERIOD);
  readonly now = signal(new Date());

  constructor() {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => this.now.set(new Date()), this.period);
    inject(DestroyRef).onDestroy(() => window.clearInterval(timer));
  }
}
  • 第 15 行：注入令牌 （[InjectionToken]）指代并非类的值：此处是一个数字——时钟周期。[factory] 提供在无人提供此令牌时使用的值；
  • 第 19 行：令牌值的请求方式与服务的请求方式相同；
  • 第 24 行：[DestroyRef] 表示提供该服务的组件的“生命周期”；[onDestroy] 注册一个在其被销毁时执行的函数：定时器会随提供该时钟的组件一同停止。

[inject()] 只能在注入上下文中调用：即在初始化由 [Angular] 创建的类（组件、服务、指令、管道）的属性时，或在其构造函数中。之后不能在普通方法内调用它。

docs.title: 3.5.4. 组件
docs.text:
一个向购物车添加商品的目录：

// 14-services/src/app/catalog/catalog.ts - a descendant that INJECTS the cart
import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { Item, CartService } from '../services/cart.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-catalog',
  template: `
    <ul class="list-group">
      @for (a of catalog; track a.label) {
        <li class="list-group-item d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
          {{ a.label }} (€{{ a.price }})
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" (click)="cart.add(a)">Add</button>
        </li>
      }
    </ul>
  `,
})
export class Catalog {
  // the cart provided by App (error at runtime if nobody provides it)
  protected readonly cart = inject(CartService);

  protected readonly catalog: Item[] = [
    { label: 'Consultation', price: 30 },
    { label: 'Vaccine', price: 12.5 },
    { label: 'Certificate', price: 5 },
  ];
}
  • 第 20 行：[inject(CartService)]：由父组件（[App]）提供的购物车。如果无人提供，[Angular] 将报告运行时错误；
  • 第 12 行：模板直接调用服务的方法。

购物车摘要：

import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { CartService } from '../services/cart.service';
import { ClockService, CLOCK_PERIOD } from '../services/clock.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-cart-summary',
  imports: [DatePipe],
  // a new instance of ClockService for THIS component, with another
  // period: { provide: token, useValue: value }
  providers: [ClockService, { provide: CLOCK_PERIOD, useValue: 5000 }],
  template: `
    <div class="card p-3">
      <h2 class="h6">Cart ({{ cart.items().length }} item(s)) - {{ clock.now() | date: 'HH:mm:ss' }}</h2>
      <ul class="mb-2">
        @for (a of cart.items(); track $index) {
          <li>{{ a.label }} <a href="#" (click)="$event.preventDefault(); cart.remove($index)">remove</a></li>
        }
      </ul>
      <strong>Total: €{{ cart.total() }}</strong>
    </div>
  `,
})
export class CartSummary {
  protected readonly cart = inject(CartService);
  protected readonly clock = inject(ClockService);
}
  • 第 18 行：组件提供自己的时钟（[ClockService] 的新实例）和另一个时间周期：[{ provide: token, useValue: value }]；
  • 第 32–33 行：购物车是 [App] 的购物车（与目录中的相同）；时钟则是它自己的。

根组件：

import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Catalog } from './catalog/catalog';
import { CartSummary } from './cart-summary/cart-summary';
import { ClockService } from './services/clock.service';
import { LogService } from './services/log.service';
import { CartService } from './services/cart.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [DatePipe, Catalog, CartSummary],
  providers: [CartService, ClockService],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  protected readonly clock = inject(ClockService);
  protected readonly log = inject(LogService);
}
  • 第 23 行：[App] 提供一个购物车（由它及其所有后代共享）和一个时钟（默认周期：一秒）；
  • 第 28 行：日志，根服务。
<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 720px">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 14 - services and dependency injection</h1>
  <p class="text-muted">Clock of App: {{ clock.now() | date: 'HH:mm:ss' }}</p>
  <div class="row g-3">
    <div class="col-md-6"><app-catalog /></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><app-cart-summary /></div>
  </div>
  <h2 class="h6 mt-3">Log (LogService)</h2>
  <ul class="small">
    @for (line of log.lines(); track $index) {
      <li>{{ line }}</li>
    }
  </ul>
</div>

[npm start 14-services]；添加三件商品，移除一件：

两个定时器的前进速度不同：每个组件收到的是离它最近的实例。而购物车则由目录和摘要两者共享。

在 [Angular] 中，服务是在组件之间共享逻辑和数据的手段（相当于“组合式函数”以及 [provide] / [inject] 在 [Vue.js] 中所起的作用）。示例 20 会把它变成由整个应用程序共享的状态。

docs.title: 3.6. 示例 15：编写自己的指令
docs.text: 组件是一种带有模板的指令 。“单独”的指令没有模板：它附加到现有元素（其宿主）上，以修改其外观或行为。[Angular] 提供了一些指令（[ngModel]、[routerLink]、[ngTemplateOutlet]……）；你也可以编写自己的指令。下面是三个示例。

docs.title: 3.6.1. 鼠标悬停时高亮元素
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 15-directives/src/app/directives/highlight.directive.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// An ATTRIBUTE DIRECTIVE adds a behavior to an existing element,
// without a template of its own: <li appHighlight="gold">. Its selector is a
// CSS attribute selector ([appHighlight]).
// host: the bindings that the directive sets on the element that carries it
// (its "host"):
//   - '[style.background-color]' : a property of the element;
//   - '(mouseenter)'             : an event of the element.
// =========================================================================

import { Directive, input, signal } from '@angular/core';

@Directive({
  selector: '[appHighlight]',
  host: {
    '[style.background-color]': 'hovered() ? color() : null',
    '[style.transition]': '"background-color 0.2s"',
    '(mouseenter)': 'hovered.set(true)',
    '(mouseleave)': 'hovered.set(false)',
  },
})
export class HighlightDirective {
  // the input has the name of the selector: <li appHighlight="gold"> sets it
  readonly color = input('#fff3cd', { alias: 'appHighlight', transform: (c: string) => c || '#fff3cd' });
  protected readonly hovered = signal(false);
}
  • 第 15 行：[@Directive] 而不是 [@Component]：没有模板；
  • 第 16 行：选择器是一个 CSS attribute 选择器：该指令应用于任何具有 attribute [appHighlight] 的元素；
  • 第 17–22 行：[host]：指令应用于其宿主的绑定，写法与模板中相同：
    • 第 18 行：property 绑定：鼠标悬停时宿主的背景颜色（[null]：无颜色）；
    • 第 20–21 行：事件绑定：鼠标进入和离开；
  • 第 26 行：以选择器命名的输入（选项 [alias]）：[<li appHighlight="gold">] 同时填充选择器和输入。 其函数 [transform] 会把空字符串替换为默认颜色。

docs.title: 3.6.2. 设置焦点
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 15-directives/src/app/directives/autofocus.directive.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// <input appAutofocus>: the field receives the focus as soon as it is displayed.
// inject(ElementRef) gives the host HTML element (nativeElement).
// (The HTML autofocus attribute only works when the page loads;
// in a single-page application, the fields appear later.)
// =========================================================================

import { afterNextRender, Directive, ElementRef, inject } from '@angular/core';

@Directive({ selector: '[appAutofocus]' })
export class AutofocusDirective {
  constructor() {
    const element = inject<ElementRef<HTMLElement>>(ElementRef).nativeElement;
    afterNextRender(() => element.focus());
  }
}
  • 第 15 行：[inject(ElementRef)] 指定宿主元素；
  • 第 16 行：元素一显示就会获得焦点。HTML attribute [autofocus] 仅在页面加载时有效；在单页应用中，字段是稍后才出现的。

docs.title: 3.6.3. 长按
docs.text:
指令还可以触发事件。这个指令仅在宿主被按住一秒钟时才触发其事件：这是防止误点击的保护措施。

// =========================================================================
// 15-directives/src/app/directives/long-press.directive.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A directive can also EMIT events (output):
//     <button (appLongPress)="remove()">
// The event is only emitted if the button is held down for one second:
// a protection against unfortunate clicks. During the press, the CSS
// class "pressed" is set on the button.
// =========================================================================

import { DestroyRef, Directive, inject, input, output, signal } from '@angular/core';

@Directive({
  selector: '[appLongPress]',
  host: {
    '[class.pressed]': 'pressing()',
    '(pointerdown)': 'start()',
    '(pointerup)': 'stop()',
    '(pointerleave)': 'stop()',
  },
})
export class LongPressDirective {
  readonly duration = input(1000); // in milliseconds
  readonly appLongPress = output<void>();
  protected readonly pressing = signal(false);
  private timer: number | undefined;

  constructor() {
    inject(DestroyRef).onDestroy(() => window.clearTimeout(this.timer));
  }

  protected start(): void {
    this.pressing.set(true);
    this.timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.pressing.set(false);
      this.appLongPress.emit();
    }, this.duration());
  }

  protected stop(): void {
    window.clearTimeout(this.timer);
    this.pressing.set(false);
  }
}
  • 第 16 行：当宿主被按下时，类 [pressed] 会应用于宿主；
  • 第 17–19 行：指针事件（鼠标、手指、触控笔）：按下、释放、离开元素；
  • 第 24 行：以选择器名称命名的输出：我们写 [(appLongPress)="..."]，在监听其事件的同时应用该指令；
  • 第 29 行：如果宿主消失，定时器就会停止。

docs.title: 3.6.4. 用法
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 15-directives/src/app/app.ts - writing your own directives
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A component is a directive WITH a template. A "plain" directive
// has no template: it attaches itself to an existing element to
// modify its appearance or its behavior. Like a component, it must
// be imported by the component that uses it.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { AutofocusDirective } from './directives/autofocus.directive';
import { LongPressDirective } from './directives/long-press.directive';
import { HighlightDirective } from './directives/highlight.directive';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [AutofocusDirective, LongPressDirective, HighlightDirective],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
  styles: `
    .pressed {
      outline: 4px solid #dc3545;
    }
  `,
})
export class App {
  protected readonly doctors = signal(['Mme Marie PELISSIER', 'Mr Paul TATOU', 'Melle Sophie DUPONT']);
  protected readonly message = signal('');

  protected remove(name: string): void {
    this.doctors.update((m) => m.filter((x) => x !== name));
    this.message.set(`${name} has been deleted.`);
  }
}
  • 第 17 行：与组件一样，指令必须由使用它的组件导入；
  • 第 19–23 行：[pressed] 类的样式，由长按指令设置。
<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 640px">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 15 - writing your own directives</h1>
  <!-- appAutofocus: the field has the focus as soon as the page is displayed -->
  <input appAutofocus class="form-control mb-3" placeholder="this field received the focus by itself">

  <p class="small text-muted">Hover over the rows; hold a button down for one second to delete.</p>
  <ul class="list-group mb-3">
    @for (m of doctors(); track m; let even = $even) {
      <!-- appHighlight: without a value, the default color; with one, the given color -->
      <li class="list-group-item d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center"
          [appHighlight]="even ? '' : '#d1e7dd'">
        {{ m }}
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" (appLongPress)="remove(m)">Delete (long press)</button>
      </li>
    }
  </ul>
  @if (message()) {
    <p class="alert alert-info">{{ message() }}</p>
  }
</div>
  • 第 4 行：字段一显示就会获得焦点；
  • 第 8 行：[let even = $even]：行号是偶数吗？
  • 第 11 行：每隔一行以默认颜色高亮，其余行为绿色；
  • 第 13 行：长按会删除该医生。

[npm start 15-directives]；按住第二个按钮，然后将鼠标悬停在第一行上：

docs.title: 3.7. 示例 16：可复用的确认窗口
docs.text:
在删除某一项之前，会请用户确认。浏览器提供了 [window.confirm()]，但它的窗口无法设置格式或翻译。本示例用 [Bootstrap] 窗口取代它，综合了前面示例所演示的内容：一个服务 （示例 14），用信号携带窗口的状态；以及一个组件 ，用来显示它。案例研究将使用完全相同的机制。

16-confirmation/src/app/
├── confirmation/
│   ├── confirmation.service.ts   the service: the question asked, the answer
│   └── confirm-dialog.ts         the modal dialog
├── app.ts
└── app.html

docs.title: 3.7.1. 服务
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 16-confirmation/src/app/confirmation/confirmation.service.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// "Are you sure?": window.confirm() exists, but it can neither be
// styled, nor can its buttons be translated. We replace it with a Bootstrap
// dialog (confirm-dialog.ts), driven by this service.
//
// The trick: confirm(message) returns a PROMISE, resolved to true (Yes)
// or false (No) when the user answers. The calling code is
// then written as simply as with window.confirm:
//
//     if (await this.confirmation.confirm('Delete this doctor?')) { ... }
//
// providedIn: 'root': only one service for the whole application, hence only one
// dialog, placed once in the root component.
// =========================================================================

import { Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ConfirmationService {
  private readonly _message = signal<string | null>(null); // null: dialog closed
  readonly message = this._message.asReadonly();
  private answer: ((yes: boolean) => void) | null = null;

  confirm(text: string): Promise<boolean> {
    this.answer?.(false); // a question still open? it counts as "no"
    this._message.set(text);
    return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
      this.answer = resolve;
    });
  }

  respond(yes: boolean): void {
    this._message.set(null);
    const r = this.answer;
    this.answer = null;
    r?.(yes);
  }
}
  • 第 20 行：整个应用程序只有一个服务；因此只会有一个窗口，一次性放置在根组件中；
  • 第 22 行：显示的消息；[null] 表示窗口已关闭；
  • 第 23 行：[asReadonly()]：组件可以读取消息，但只有服务才能修改它；
  • 第 24 行：用于解决当前 promise 的函数，该 promise 正在等待响应；
  • 第 26–32 行：[confirm] 打开窗口（第 28 行）并返回一个 promise。它的 [resolve] 函数被保存起来（第 30 行）：直到稍后用户点击按钮时，该 promise 才会被解决；
  • 第 27 行：如果还有未关闭的问题，它会被回答为“否”：其 promise 不会永远处于挂起状态；
  • 第 34–39 行：[respond] 由窗口调用：它关闭窗口（第 35 行），然后用用户的响应解决 promise（第 38 行）。

这就是 promise 的好处：提出问题的代码把它写成对 [window.confirm()] 的调用，等待响应时使用 [await]，无需回调函数。

docs.title: 3.7.2. 窗口
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 16-confirmation/src/app/confirmation/confirm-dialog.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The modal dialog, placed ONCE in the root component:
//   - same Bootstrap classes as a real modal (.modal, .modal-backdrop),
//     displayed "statically" (show d-block): no need for the JavaScript of
//     Bootstrap;
//   - keyboard: Escape = No; the focus is put on the "No" button (the
//     least dangerous choice) on opening.
// '(document:keydown.escape)' in host: an event listened to on the whole
// DOCUMENT, and not on the element of the component.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, effect, ElementRef, inject, viewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { ConfirmationService } from './confirmation.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-confirm-dialog',
  host: { '(document:keydown.escape)': 'confirmation.message() !== null && confirmation.respond(false)' },
  template: `
    @if (confirmation.message(); as message) {
      <div class="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
      <div class="modal fade show d-block" tabindex="-1" role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true"
           (click)="$event.target === $event.currentTarget && confirmation.respond(false)">
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
          <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">
              <h5 class="modal-title">Confirmation</h5>
              <button type="button" class="btn-close" aria-label="Close" (click)="confirmation.respond(false)"></button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
              <p class="mb-0">{{ message }}</p>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer">
              <button #noButton type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" (click)="confirmation.respond(false)">No, go back</button>
              <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger" (click)="confirmation.respond(true)">Yes, confirm</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    }
  `,
})
export class ConfirmDialog {
  protected readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);
  private readonly noButton = viewChild<ElementRef<HTMLButtonElement>>('noButton');

  constructor() {
    // on opening, the "No" button appears: it receives the focus
    effect(() => this.noButton()?.nativeElement.focus());
  }
}
  • 第 19 行：[document:keydown.escape]：事件是在整个document上监听的，而不是在组件的元素上。如果有待回答的问题，按 Esc 键会回答“否”；
  • 第 21 行：只有需要显示消息时窗口才会出现；[as message] 为信号的值指定一个名称；
  • 第 22–23 行：真正的 [Bootstrap] 模态框的类，直接显示（[show d-block]）：[JavaScript] 派生自 [Bootstrap] 是不必要的，因为 [Angular] 决定显示；
  • 第 24 行：点击紧邻对话框（灰色背景上）的区域，即视为回答“否”。[$event.target === $event.currentTarget]：点击发生在[.modal]元素本身，而不是其某个子元素上；
  • 第 35–36 行：两种响应。“否”按钮带有模板变量[#noButton]；
  • 第 46 行：[viewChild] （示例 13）以信号的形式返回标记为[#noButton] 的元素：只要窗口处于关闭状态，它就等于[undefined] ；
  • 第 50 行：一个依赖于该信号的 effect：每次打开窗口时，“否”按钮出现，信号随之变化，按钮获得焦点。我们选择“否”这一最安全的响应：误按 Enter 键不会删除任何内容。

docs.title: 3.7.3. 用法
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 16-confirmation/src/app/app.ts - using the confirmation dialog
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Same page as example 21 of the NestJS course (links, buttons, confirmation),
// but without any round trip to a server.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { ConfirmationService } from './confirmation/confirmation.service';
import { ConfirmDialog } from './confirmation/confirm-dialog';

interface Contact {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [ConfirmDialog],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  private readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);
  protected readonly contacts = signal<Contact[]>([
    { id: 1, name: 'Jean MARTIN' },
    { id: 2, name: 'Alice DURAND' },
    { id: 3, name: 'Luc GERMAN' },
  ]);
  protected readonly message = signal('');

  // an async method: it "waits" for the answer of the user
  protected async remove(c: Contact): Promise<void> {
    if (!(await this.confirmation.confirm(`Delete the contact ${c.name}?`))) {
      this.message.set('Deletion cancelled.');
      return;
    }
    this.contacts.update((list) => list.filter((x) => x.id !== c.id));
    this.message.set(`${c.name} has been deleted.`);
  }

  protected async removeAll(): Promise<void> {
    if (await this.confirmation.confirm(`Delete the ${this.contacts().length} contacts?`)) {
      this.contacts.set([]);
      this.message.set('All the contacts have been deleted.');
    }
  }
}
  • 第 19 行：根组件导入该窗口，并将其放置在自己的模板中；
  • 第 23 行：它请求该服务；
  • 第 32–39 行：一个名为[async]的方法。在第 33 行，[await] 会挂起执行，直到用户作出响应；在此期间，应用程序保持活动状态。只有当响应为“是”时，方法的其余部分才会执行；
  • 第 41–46 行：同样的原理也适用于删除所有联系人。
<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 640px">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 16 - a confirmation dialog</h1>
  <ul class="list-group mb-3">
    @for (c of contacts(); track c.id) {
      <li class="list-group-item d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
        {{ c.name }}
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" (click)="remove(c)">Delete</button>
      </li>
    } @empty {
      <li class="list-group-item text-muted">No contact.</li>
    }
  </ul>
  <button class="btn btn-danger" [disabled]="contacts().length === 0" (click)="removeAll()">Delete all</button>
  @if (message()) {
    <p class="alert alert-info mt-3">{{ message() }}</p>
  }
</div>
<!-- the dialog, ONCE for the whole application -->
<app-confirm-dialog />
  • 第 4–11 行：[@for] 后面可以跟一个[@empty]块，在列表为空时显示；
  • 第 13 行：当没有可删除的内容时，该按钮被禁用；
  • 第 19 行：整个应用程序只放置一次的窗口。之后任何组件只需调用该服务即可打开它。

[npm start 16-confirmation]；点击 Alice DURAND 的 [Delete] 按钮：

在 [Vue.js]中，窗口及其状态由“组合式函数”提供；在 [Angular]中，则由服务提供。原理是相同的：一个共享状态，存放在信号中，由多个组件读取和修改。

docs.title: 6.1. 示例 21：双语应用
docs.text:
[RdvMedecins]应用提供法语和英语两种语言。在[NestJS]课程中，服务器在发送页面之前负责翻译页面。现在，页面在浏览器中生成：由客户端翻译页面，切换语言不再需要与服务器进行任何交互。

[Angular] 有自己的翻译系统[@angular/localize]，它会为每种语言生成一个编译后的应用：因此切换语言只需加载另一个应用。我们将改用[ngx-translate]库，它是与[Angular]搭配使用最广泛的库，它在运行时进行翻译：只需点击一下，就能重新翻译整个页面。

21-i18n/src/app/
├── i18n/
│   ├── fr.json          the French dictionary
│   ├── en.json          the English dictionary
│   ├── i18n.ts          the configuration of ngx-translate
│   └── plural.pipe.ts   the choice of the plural
├── app.ts
└── app.html

该库在工作区的[package.json]文件中声明：

        "@ngx-translate/core": "^18.0.0",
