docs.title: 6.1.2. 配置
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 21-i18n/src/app/i18n/i18n.ts - the configuration of ngx-translate
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ngx-translate is the most widely used translation library with
// Angular. We provide it with:
//   - a DICTIONARY per language (fr.json, en.json), where each text has a
//     KEY ("HOME.HELLO"); the parameters are written {{name}};
//   - a LOADER (TranslateLoader), which returns the dictionary of a
//     language. Ours takes them from the code of the application (import of
//     JSON files); another one could download them;
//   - the starting language (the one stored in localStorage, otherwise that
//     of the browser, otherwise English) and the fallback language.
// In the templates, {{ 'HOME.HELLO' | translate: { name: 'Marie' } }}
// displays the text of the CURRENT language; changing the language updates
// the whole page.
//
// It is, on the client side, the same principle as the NestJS course (dictionaries
// i18n/*.json + helper {{t}}) - but the translation is now done in
// the browser, and changing the language no longer asks anything of the server.
//
// (Angular also has its own system, @angular/localize, which builds ONE
// compiled application per language: the language can then only be changed
// by changing page. ngx-translate, on the other hand, translates at runtime.)
// =========================================================================

import { Provider } from '@angular/core';
import { provideTranslateLoader, provideTranslateService, TranslateLoader, TranslationObject } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { Observable, of } from 'rxjs';
import fr from './fr.json';
import en from './en.json';

export type Language = 'fr' | 'en';
export const LANGUAGES: Language[] = ['fr', 'en'];
export const LANGUAGE_KEY = 'example21.language';

// the loader of the dictionaries
class DictionariesLoader implements TranslateLoader {
  getTranslation(language: string): Observable<TranslationObject> {
    return of(language === 'en' ? en : fr);
  }
}

function initialLanguage(): Language {
  const stored = localStorage.getItem(LANGUAGE_KEY);
  if (stored === 'fr' || stored === 'en') {
    return stored;
  }
  return navigator.language.startsWith('fr') ? 'fr' : 'en';
}

export function provideI18n(): Provider[] {
  return provideTranslateService({
    loader: provideTranslateLoader(DictionariesLoader),
    fallbackLang: 'en', // a key missing in French: the English one is used
    lang: initialLanguage(),
  });
}
  • 第 29–30 行：字典作为模块导入；它们是应用代码的一部分。这得益于[resolveJsonModule]选项，该选项位于[tsconfig.json]文件中；
  • 第 34 行：所选语言在[localStorage] 中存储时使用的键（示例 20）；
  • 第 37–41 行：字典加载器：[ngx-translate] 调用它，以可观察对象的形式获取某种语言的字典。我们的加载器从代码中获取字典；另一种加载器也可以从服务器下载字典；
  • 第 43–49 行：源语言：用户上次选择的语言；否则，如果浏览器语言为法语，则为法语；否则为英语；
  • 第 51–57 行：[provideTranslateService] 使[ngx-translate] 的服务在整个应用中可用。[fallbackLang]：当当前字典中缺少某个键时所使用的语言。
// =========================================================================
// 21-i18n/src/main.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// provideI18n(): ngx-translate (see app/i18n/i18n.ts).
// registerLocaleData(localeFr): the French rules of the date,
// currency... pipes (English is always available).
// =========================================================================

import { registerLocaleData } from '@angular/common';
import localeFr from '@angular/common/locales/fr';
import { bootstrapApplication } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { App } from './app/app';
import { provideI18n } from './app/i18n/i18n';

registerLocaleData(localeFr);

bootstrapApplication(App, { providers: [provideI18n()] }).catch((error) => console.error(error));
  • 第 15 行：管道[date] 和[currency] （示例 09）了解英语的规则；法语的规则必须进行注册；
  • 第 17 行：[ngx-translate] 的服务被添加到应用中。

docs.title: 6.1.3. 复数
docs.text:
[ngx-translate] 不支持复数。一个小型管道负责选择正确的形式：

// =========================================================================
// 21-i18n/src/app/i18n/plural.pipe.ts - choosing the plural form
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ngx-translate does not handle plurals. The dictionary gives the
// forms under one same key ("APPOINTMENTS": { "zero", "one", "other" }) and
// this pipe chooses the right one, depending on the number and the language:
//     {{ 'HOME.APPOINTMENTS' | plural: n : language | translate: { n } }}
// Intl.PluralRules knows the rules of each language ("one" or "other" in
// English as in French, but other forms in Polish, in Arabic...).
// =========================================================================

import { Pipe, PipeTransform } from '@angular/core';

@Pipe({ name: 'plural' })
export class PluralPipe implements PipeTransform {
  transform(key: string, n: number, language: string | null): string {
    if (n === 0) {
      return `${key}.zero`;
    }
    return `${key}.${new Intl.PluralRules(language ?? 'en').select(n)}`;
  }
}
  • 第 16–21 行：该管道接收一个键（[HOME.APPOINTMENTS]）、一个数字和一种语言；它返回正确形式的键（例如[HOME.APPOINTMENTS.one]）；
  • 第 18 行：零有自己的格式（“没有预约”）；
  • 第 20 行：由浏览器提供的[Intl.PluralRules]遵循每种语言的规则：法语和英语使用[one] 或[other] ，而波兰语或阿拉伯语则有其他形式。（注意：在法语中，1.5 是单数；在英语中，它是复数。）

docs.title: 6.1.4. 翻译后的页面
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 21-i18n/src/app/app.ts - a translated page
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//   - 'KEY' | translate                    a text;
//   - 'KEY' | translate: { name: ... }     a text with parameters;
//   - date / currency with the language    a date, an amount, in the format
//                                          of the current language;
//   - translate.use('fr')                  changes the language: the whole
//                                          page is translated again.
// TranslateService.currentLang is a SIGNAL: the current language.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, effect, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { CurrencyPipe, DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { TranslatePipe, TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { LANGUAGE_KEY, Language, LANGUAGES } from './i18n/i18n';
import { PluralPipe } from './i18n/plural.pipe';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [CurrencyPipe, DatePipe, TranslatePipe, PluralPipe],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  private readonly translate = inject(TranslateService);
  protected readonly language = this.translate.currentLang;
  protected readonly languages = LANGUAGES;
  protected readonly count = signal(2);
  protected readonly today = new Date();

  // what the RdvMedecins server would return (see the chapter on the black box)
  protected readonly serverResponses = [
    { statusCode: 409, key: 'ERRORS.LOGIN_TAKEN', params: {} },
    { statusCode: 429, key: 'ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS', params: { minutes: '15' } },
  ];

  // translate.translate(key): a SIGNAL that follows the current language
  private readonly title = this.translate.translate('APP.TITLE');

  constructor() {
    // on each change of language: we store it, and we update
    // the lang attribute of the page (useful to screen readers, spell checkers)
    effect(() => {
      const language = this.language();
      if (language) {
        localStorage.setItem(LANGUAGE_KEY, language);
        document.documentElement.lang = language;
      }
      document.title = String(this.title());
    });
  }

  protected choose(language: Language): void {
    this.translate.use(language);
  }
}
  • 第 21 行：[TranslatePipe]：管道[translate]；
  • 第 25 行：[TranslateService]：[ngx-translate]的主服务；
  • 第 26 行：[currentLang]：当前语言，以信号的形式提供；
  • 第 32–35 行：两个错误响应，与服务器返回的形式一致：一个键和若干参数；
  • 第 38 行：[translate.translate(key)] 返回一个信号 ，其值等于该键的翻译，并随当前语言变化；
  • 第 43–50 行：每当语言改变时执行的动作：保存语言（第 46 行），更新页面的[lang]属性（第 47 行；屏幕阅读器和拼写检查器会用到它），以及标签页标题（第 49 行）；
  • 第 54 行：[use] 更改当前语言：整个页面被重新翻译。
<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 720px">
  <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">
    <h1 class="h3 mb-0">{{ 'APP.TITLE' | translate }}</h1>
    <div class="btn-group btn-group-sm" role="group" [attr.aria-label]="'APP.LANGUAGE' | translate">
      @for (l of languages; track l) {
        <button class="btn" [class]="language() === l ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline-primary'" (click)="choose(l)">
          {{ l.toUpperCase() }}
        </button>
      }
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card p-3 mb-3">
    <p>{{ 'HOME.HELLO' | translate: { name: 'Marie' } }}</p>
    <!-- a parameter computed by another pipe, in the current language -->
    <p>{{ 'HOME.TODAY' | translate: { date: (today | date: 'fullDate' : '' : language() ?? 'en') } }}</p>
    <p>{{ 'HOME.PRICE' | translate: { price: (1234.5 | currency: 'EUR' : 'symbol' : '1.2-2' : language() ?? 'en') } }}</p>
    <!-- plural chooses the key (zero, one, other), translate translates it -->
    <p class="fw-bold">{{ 'HOME.APPOINTMENTS' | plural: count() : language() | translate: { n: count() } }}</p>
    <div class="d-flex gap-2">
      <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success" (click)="count.set(count() + 1)">{{ 'HOME.ADD' | translate }}</button>
      <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" [disabled]="count() === 0" (click)="count.set(count() - 1)">
        {{ 'HOME.REMOVE' | translate }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card p-3">
    <h2 class="h6">{{ 'SERVER.TITLE' | translate }}</h2>
    <p>{{ 'SERVER.EXPLANATION' | translate }}</p>
    <ul class="mb-0">
      @for (r of serverResponses; track r.key) {
        <!-- the key of the server IS a key of the dictionary; params provides its parameters -->
        <li><code>{{ r.statusCode }} {{ r.key }}</code><br>→ {{ r.key | translate: r.params }}</li>
      }
    </ul>
  </div>
</div>
  • 第 3 行：['APP.TITLE' | translate]：该键在当前语言中的翻译；
  • 第 6 行：当前语言的按钮高亮显示；
  • 第 14 行：带参数的文本：管道接收一个对象，该对象提供每个参数的值；
  • 第 16–17 行：参数的值可以由另一个管道计算得出。[date] 和[currency] 的最后一个参数是语言：日期和金额按法语或英语的风格书写；
  • 第 19 行：两个链式管道：[plural] 选择键，[translate] 翻译该键；
  • 第 34 行：服务器返回的键连同其参数一起被翻译。

[npm start 21-i18n]；当浏览器设置为法语时，页面显示为法语：

点击[EN]，然后点击“Remove one”：

重新加载页面：它仍然是英语；语言已被保存。

docs.title: 4.1. 示例 17：路由器
docs.text:
[Angular]应用程序是一个单页应用：浏览器只加载一个 HTML 页面。然而，[RdvMedecins]应用程序有多个页面（/login、/schedule、/doctors……），每个页面都有自己的 URL，可以加入书签或重新加载。这正是[Angular] 路由器的作用：它将每个 URL 与一个组件（即“页面”）关联起来，并在 URL 变化时显示该组件，而无需向服务器发出任何请求。

17-router/src/
├── app/
│   ├── pages/
│   │   ├── home.ts
│   │   ├── doctor-list.ts
│   │   ├── doctor-detail.ts
│   │   ├── search.ts
│   │   ├── about.ts
│   │   └── not-found-page.ts
│   ├── data.ts             three "hard-coded" doctors
│   ├── app.routes.ts       the routes
│   ├── app.config.ts       the configuration of the application
│   ├── app.ts
│   └── app.html
├── index.html
└── main.ts

docs.title: 4.1.1. 路由配置
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 17-router/src/app/app.routes.ts - the ROUTES of the application
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// An Angular application is a single-page application (SPA: Single
// Page Application): the browser loads only ONE HTML page. When an
// internal link is clicked, no request is sent to the server: the
// router changes the address displayed by the browser, and replaces the
// component displayed in <router-outlet>.
//
// A route associates a PATH with a COMPONENT (a "page"):
//   'doctors/:id'    :id is a parameter (/doctors/2 -> id = "2");
//   '**'             any path: the "not found" page. The
//                    routes are tried in order: it comes LAST.
// title: the title of the browser tab when the page is displayed.
// =========================================================================

import { Routes } from '@angular/router';
import { Home } from './pages/home';
import { DoctorList } from './pages/doctor-list';
import { DoctorDetail } from './pages/doctor-detail';
import { Search } from './pages/search';
import { NotFoundPage } from './pages/not-found-page';

export const routes: Routes = [
  { path: '', component: Home, title: 'Home' },
  { path: 'doctors', component: DoctorList, title: 'Doctors' },
  { path: 'doctors/:id', component: DoctorDetail, title: 'A doctor' },
  { path: 'search', component: Search, title: 'Search' },
  // DEFERRED loading: the code of this page is only downloaded on the
  // first visit (the compiler makes it a separate file)
  { path: 'about', loadComponent: () => import('./pages/about'), title: 'About' },
  // a redirection: the old address leads to the new one
  { path: 'physicians', redirectTo: 'doctors' },
  { path: '**', component: NotFoundPage, title: 'Page not found' },
];
  • 第 24 行：路由构成一个类型为[Routes]的对象数组；
  • 第 25 行：空路径：主页，地址为 /。路径开头永远不要放置 /；
  • 第 27 行：[:id] 是一个参数：/doctors/1、/doctors/2……都显示[DoctorDetail]组件，该组件接收[id]的值；
  • 第 31 行：[loadComponent] 取代[component]：组件仅在首次访问该页面时才加载。编译器将其代码存放在单独的文件中，该文件在此时才下载；这加快了应用程序的加载速度。在案例研究中，我们将对所有页面这样做；
  • 第 33 行：一个重定向：/physicians 指向 /doctors；
  • 第 34 行：[**]：任意路径。由于路径按顺序依次尝试，只有在其他路径都不匹配时才会使用这一条：这就是“页面未找到”页面；
  • [title]：显示该页面时的浏览器标签页标题。

docs.title: 4.1.2. 应用程序配置
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 17-router/src/app/app.config.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// provideRouter(routes): we add the router to the application, with its
// routes (app.routes.ts). withComponentInputBinding(): the parameters of
// the address (/doctors/:id, ?q=...) are passed to the components of the pages
// as INPUTS (input()) - see pages/doctor-detail.ts.
// =========================================================================

import { ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';
import { provideRouter, withComponentInputBinding } from '@angular/router';
import { routes } from './app.routes';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [provideRouter(routes, withComponentInputBinding())],
};

到目前为止，应用程序配置都放在文件[main.ts]中。现在它被单独存放在[app.config.ts]中，就像由命令[ng new]创建的项目那样：

  • 第 15 行：[provideRouter] 将路由器及其路由添加到应用程序中。[withComponentInputBinding()] 将地址参数作为输入传递给页面组件（[input()]，示例 10）：这是读取它们的最简单方式。
// =========================================================================
// 17-router/src/main.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The configuration of the application (its "providers") is stored separately,
// in app.config.ts: it is the usual layout of an Angular project.
// =========================================================================

import { bootstrapApplication } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { appConfig } from './app/app.config';
import { App } from './app/app';

bootstrapApplication(App, appConfig).catch((error) => console.error(error));
  • 第 12 行：[bootstrapApplication] 接收该配置。
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Example 17 - the router</title>
  <base href="/">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
</head>
<body>
  <app-root></app-root>
</body>
</html>
  • 第 6 行：[<base href="/">]：路由器据以计算路径的地址。没有它，多级地址（/doctors/2）将无法工作。

docs.title: 4.1.3. 应用程序外壳
docs.text:
根组件成为一个外壳：它包含所有页面共有的元素（此处为标题和链接），以及一个用于显示当前页面的区域。

// =========================================================================
// 17-router/src/app/app.ts - the "shell" of the application
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//   - routerLink="...": an internal link. On an <a> tag, it produces a
//     real href, but a click does not reload the page: the router
//     acts. routerLinkActive="active" sets the "active" class (that of
//     Bootstrap) on the link of the displayed page;
//   - <router-outlet />: the place where the component of the
//     current route is displayed.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { toSignal } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { NavigationEnd, Router, RouterLink, RouterLinkActive, RouterOutlet } from '@angular/router';
import { filter, map } from 'rxjs';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [RouterLink, RouterLinkActive, RouterOutlet],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  // the current address, as a signal: router.events is a stream
  // (Observable, see example 19) of navigation events; we keep the
  // end of each navigation, and toSignal makes it a signal
  protected readonly address = toSignal(
    this.router.events.pipe(
      filter((e) => e instanceof NavigationEnd),
      // decodeURIComponent: %20 becomes a space again
      map((e) => decodeURIComponent(e.urlAfterRedirects)),
    ),
    { initialValue: '' },
  );
}
  • 第 19 行：模板所使用的路由器指令；
  • 第 28–35 行：当前 URL，显示在链接下方。[router.events] 是一个可观察对象 （事件流，如示例 19 所示），用于标示导航的每个步骤。我们只保留导航的终点（第 30 行），从中提取地址（包括任何重定向，第 32 行），然后由[toSignal] 将该流转换为可在模板中使用的信号。
<div class="container py-4">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 17 - the router</h1>
  <nav class="nav nav-pills mb-3">
    <!-- routerLinkActiveOptions exact: "/" must not be active on /doctors -->
    <a class="nav-link" routerLink="/" routerLinkActive="active" [routerLinkActiveOptions]="{ exact: true }">Home</a>
    <a class="nav-link" routerLink="/doctors" routerLinkActive="active">Doctors</a>
    <!-- [queryParams]: the parameters after the ? (/search?q=general practitioner);
         queryParams: 'ignored': the link stays active whatever the search -->
    <a class="nav-link" routerLink="/search" [queryParams]="{ q: 'general practitioner' }" routerLinkActive="active"
       [routerLinkActiveOptions]="{ paths: 'exact', queryParams: 'ignored', fragment: 'ignored', matrixParams: 'ignored' }">Search</a>
    <a class="nav-link" routerLink="/about" routerLinkActive="active">About</a>
    <a class="nav-link" routerLink="/physicians">/physicians (redirection)</a>
    <a class="nav-link" routerLink="/unknown-page">Broken link</a>
  </nav>
  <p class="small text-muted">current address: <code>{{ address() }}</code></p>
  <div class="card p-3">
    <router-outlet />
  </div>
</div>
  • 第 5 行：[routerLink]：内部链接。对于[<a>]标签，它会生成有效的[href]属性（链接可以在新标签页中打开），但点击它不会重新加载页面：改变地址和显示内容的是路由器。[routerLinkActive="active"] 会将[active]类（源自[Bootstrap]）应用到当前所显示页面的链接上。如果没有[exact]选项，/ 链接在所有页面上都会处于激活状态，因为所有地址都以 / 开头；
  • 第 9–10 行：[[queryParams]]：位于 URL 中[?] 之后的参数（/search?q=general practitioner）。[queryParams: 'ignored']选项使链接无论搜索内容如何都保持激活状态；
  • 第 12–13 行：一个指向重定向的链接，以及一个指向不存在地址的链接；
  • 第 17 行：[<router-outlet />]：显示当前路由组件的位置。

docs.title: 4.1.4. 页面
docs.text:
// "hard-coded" data, so as not to depend on a server in this example
export interface Doctor {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  specialty: string;
}

export const DOCTORS: Doctor[] = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Mme', firstName: 'Marie', lastName: 'PELISSIER', specialty: 'general practitioner' },
  { id: 2, title: 'Mr', firstName: 'Paul', lastName: 'TATOU', specialty: 'pediatrician' },
  { id: 3, title: 'Melle', firstName: 'Sophie', lastName: 'DUPONT', specialty: 'general practitioner' },
];

import { Component } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-home',
  template: `
    <p class="mb-0">Welcome. Click on the links: the address of the browser changes, the page is never
      reloaded (open the Network tab of the developer tools to check it). The Back and
      Forward buttons of the browser work, as well as reloading (F5) any page.</p>
  `,
})
export class Home {}

页面就是普通组件，没有任何特别之处。

// 17-router/src/app/pages/doctor-list.ts - links with a parameter
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { DOCTORS } from '../data';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-doctor-list',
  imports: [RouterLink],
  template: `
    <ul class="mb-0">
      @for (m of doctors; track m.id) {
        <!-- [routerLink] with an array: the router assembles the address /doctors/2 -->
        <li><a [routerLink]="['/doctors', m.id]">{{ m.title }} {{ m.firstName }} {{ m.lastName }}</a></li>
      }
    </ul>
  `,
})
export class DoctorList {
  protected readonly doctors = DOCTORS;
}
  • 第 13 行：[[routerLink]] 在此接收一个数组：路由器根据数组元素拼装出地址（/doctors/2）。
// =========================================================================
// 17-router/src/app/pages/doctor-detail.ts - a page with a parameter
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The :id parameter arrives as an INPUT (thanks to withComponentInputBinding,
// see app.config.ts), as a string: it is enough to declare an
// input that has the same name. The component then no longer depends on the
// router: it could also be used as <app-doctor-detail id="2">.
// Router.navigate(...): navigating BY CODE; Location.back(): going back
// to the previous page, like the Back button of the browser.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, input } from '@angular/core';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { DOCTORS } from '../data';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-doctor-detail',
  template: `
    @if (doctor(); as m) {
      <h2 class="h5">{{ m.title }} {{ m.firstName }} {{ m.lastName }}</h2>
      <p>Specialty: {{ m.specialty }}</p>
      <div class="d-flex gap-2">
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" (click)="back()">Back</button>
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" (click)="next()">Next doctor</button>
      </div>
    } @else {
      <p class="text-danger mb-0">Doctor no. {{ id() }} does not exist.</p>
    }
  `,
})
export class DoctorDetail {
  readonly id = input.required<string>();
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly location = inject(Location);

  // computed: going from /doctors/1 to /doctors/2, Angular REUSES
  // the same component and only changes the id input - the computed follows
  protected readonly doctor = computed(() => DOCTORS.find((m) => m.id === Number(this.id())) ?? null);

  protected back(): void {
    this.location.back();
  }

  protected next(): void {
    const id = (Number(this.id()) % DOCTORS.length) + 1;
    this.router.navigate(['/doctors', id]);
  }
}
  • 第 33 行：路由参数[:id] 被传递给同名的输入。与所有来自地址的内容一样，它是一个字符串；
  • 第 39 行：所显示的医生由输入计算得出。从 /doctors/1 切换到 /doctors/2 时，[Angular] 不会重新创建组件：它只更改输入的值，而 [computed] 会随之更新；
  • 第 27–29 行：对未知标识符（/doctors/9）给出提示；
  • 第 42 行：[Location.back()]：返回上一页，就像浏览器的“后退”按钮一样；
  • 第 47 行：[Router.navigate]：由代码触发的导航，使用与[[routerLink]]相同的数组。
// =========================================================================
// 17-router/src/app/pages/search.ts - a page driven by the URL
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// /search?q=pediatrician: as with the GET form of the NestJS course, the
// page is entirely described by its address: it can be bookmarked,
// reloaded, navigated back to. The q parameter also arrives
// as an input of the component.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, input, linkedSignal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { DOCTORS } from '../data';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-search',
  imports: [FormsModule],
  template: `
    <form class="d-flex gap-2 mb-3" (ngSubmit)="search()">
      <input name="input" class="form-control" placeholder="name or specialty" [(ngModel)]="input">
      <button class="btn btn-primary">Search</button>
    </form>
    <ul class="mb-0">
      @for (m of results(); track m.id) {
        <li>{{ m.firstName }} {{ m.lastName }} ({{ m.specialty }})</li>
      } @empty {
        <li class="text-muted">No result.</li>
      }
    </ul>
  `,
})
export class Search {
  readonly q = input<string>(); // ?q=... (undefined if absent)
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  // the field starts with the value of the URL, and follows it if it changes
  // (Back button), while remaining editable: a linkedSignal
  protected readonly input = linkedSignal(() => this.q() ?? '');

  protected readonly results = computed(() => {
    const q = (this.q() ?? '').toLowerCase();
    return DOCTORS.filter((m) => `${m.firstName} ${m.lastName} ${m.specialty}`.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  });

  protected search(): void {
    // we change the URL; the display follows the URL (q input)
    this.router.navigate(['/search'], { queryParams: { q: this.input() } });
  }
}

该页面完全由其地址描述，就像 GET 表单的页面一样：你可以将它加入书签、重新加载，或使用“后退”按钮返回到它。

  • 第 33 行：地址中的参数[q] 也作为输入传递；如果缺失，其值为[undefined]；
  • 第 38 行：输入字段是一个[linkedSignal]：它取地址中的值，在地址变化时（使用“后退”按钮）相应更新，但仍可由用户编辑；
  • 第 40–43 行：结果取决于地址，而不是输入：它们只在提交表单时才会变化；
  • 第 47 行：提交表单会改变地址，地址改变了输入 [q]，输入 [q] 的变化又改变了结果。
// 17-router/src/app/pages/about.ts - a page loaded on demand
// "export default": loadComponent: () => import('./pages/about') finds
// the component without having to name it
import { Component } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-about',
  template: `<p class="mb-0">This page was downloaded on the first visit (Network tab: a file
    chunk-XXXX.js). Its tab title comes from the route.</p>`,
})
export default class About {}
  • 第 11 行：[export default]：路由中的[loadComponent]函数（[import('./pages/about')]）无需指定组件名称即可找到该组件。
import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-not-found-page',
  template: `<p class="text-danger mb-0">No page at the address <code>{{ address }}</code>.</p>`,
})
export class NotFoundPage {
  protected readonly address = inject(Router).url;
}
  • 第 9 行：[Router.url]：所请求的地址。

docs.title: 4.1.5. 执行
docs.text:
[npm start 17-router]；点击“Doctors”，然后点击“Paul”TATOU：

点击“Search”，输入“pediatrician”，然后按 Enter 键：地址随之改变。

失效的链接会导致“页面未找到”错误：

你可以在浏览器开发者工具的 Network 选项卡中验证，点击时不会向服务器请求任何页面，只有首次访问“About”页面时除外（一个名为[chunk-XXXX.js]的文件）。你也可以重新加载任意页面（F5）：开发服务器始终返回[index.html]，由路由器显示与该地址对应的页面。生产服务器必须做到同样的事情：这正是 JSON 服务器在部署时将要做的。

docs.title: 4.2. 示例 18：导航守卫页面
docs.text:
[RdvMedecins]应用程序中的某些页面是受限的：日程需要登录，医生管理需要 ADMIN 角色。在服务器端，[NestJS]课程使用了访问控制（[JwtAuthGuard]、[RolesGuard]）。[Angular]路由器也有自己的机制：在显示路由之前调用的函数，它们可以允许导航，也可以将导航重定向到另一个地址。

本示例在没有服务器的情况下模拟登录：三个账户是硬编码的。

18-guards/src/app/
├── pages/
│   ├── home.ts             public page
│   ├── login.ts            public page
│   ├── schedule.ts         requires being logged in
│   └── administration.ts   requires the ADMIN role
├── session.service.ts      the logged-in user
├── guards.ts               the guards
├── app.routes.ts
├── app.config.ts
├── app.ts
└── app.html

docs.title: 4.2.1. 会话
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 18-guards/src/app/session.service.ts - a SIMULATED session (no server)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The logged-in user, in a root service: all the components and
// all the guards that inject it share the same one. (Example 23 will do the
// same thing with a real server.)
// =========================================================================

import { Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

export type Role = 'ADMIN' | 'DOCTOR' | 'USER';

export interface User {
  login: string;
  role: Role;
}

// three "hard-coded" accounts (password = login)
const ACCOUNTS: Record<string, Role> = { admin: 'ADMIN', pelissier: 'DOCTOR', martin: 'USER' };

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SessionService {
  private readonly _user = signal<User | null>(null);
  readonly user = this._user.asReadonly();

  logIn(login: string, password: string): boolean {
    const role = Object.hasOwn(ACCOUNTS, login) ? ACCOUNTS[login] : undefined;
    if (role === undefined || password !== login) {
      return false;
    }
    this._user.set({ login, role });
    return true;
  }

  logOut(): void {
    this._user.set(null);
  }
}
  • 第 11 行：[RdvMedecins]应用程序的三种角色；
  • 第 19 行：三个账户，每个账户的密码都等于用户名；
  • 第 23–24 行：已登录的用户（若没有则为[null] ），存放在一个只有服务可以修改的信号中。由于只有一个服务，注入它的组件和守卫看到的都是同一个用户；
  • 第 27 行：[Object.hasOwn]：只保留[ACCOUNTS]对象自身的键。如果没有这一预防措施，登录名“constructor”会找到一个从所有[JavaScript]对象继承而来的属性；
  • 第 26–33 行：如果账户存在且密码正确，则登录成功。

docs.title: 4.2.2. 守卫
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 18-guards/src/app/guards.ts - navigation GUARDS
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A guard (CanActivateFn) is a function that the router calls BEFORE
// displaying a route that declares it (canActivate: [...]). It returns:
//   - true      : the navigation continues;
//   - a UrlTree (an address, built by router.createUrlTree): the
//     navigation is replaced by a redirection to this address.
// A guard can inject services (inject): it runs in the
// injection context of the application.
//
// It is the client-side equivalent of the NestJS guards (JwtAuthGuard,
// RolesGuard) - with a FUNDAMENTAL difference: a client guard is
// only a convenience. The code of the client is in the hands of the user, who
// can modify it at will. The real protection of the data remains that
// of the SERVER (see the chapter on the black box).
// =========================================================================

import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { CanActivateFn, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Role, SessionService } from './session.service';

// the page requires being logged in
export const loginRequired: CanActivateFn = (_route, state) => {
  if (inject(SessionService).user() !== null) {
    return true;
  }
  // not logged in: to the login page, remembering where we wanted to go
  return inject(Router).createUrlTree(['/login'], { queryParams: { redirect: state.url } });
};

// the page requires one of the roles listed in the data of the route (data.roles)
export const roleRequired: CanActivateFn = (route, state) => {
  const roles = route.data['roles'] as Role[];
  const user = inject(SessionService).user();
  if (user !== null && roles.includes(user.role)) {
    return true;
  }
  // logged in, but not with the right role: back to the home page, with a reason
  return inject(Router).createUrlTree(['/'], { queryParams: { denied: state.url } });
};
  • 第 24 行：守卫是类型为[CanActivateFn]的函数。路由器向它传递要激活的路由和导航状态（其中包含所请求的地址，[state.url]）；
  • 第 25 行：守卫可以像组件一样，使用[inject]注入服务；
  • 第 26 行：[true]：导航继续；
  • 第 29 行：否则，守卫返回另一个地址，由[createUrlTree]生成：导航被替换为重定向到登录页面。参数[redirect] 保留所请求的页面，以便登录后返回；
  • 第 34 行：[route.data]：路由声明的自由数据（此处为授权角色）。因此同一个守卫可用于所有受限页面，而不论它们的角色如何；
  • 第 40 行：已登录但角色不合适的用户会被重定向到主页，并附带拒绝的原因。

第 12–16 行的注释至关重要：客户端守卫只是为用户提供的一种便利，使其免于打开可能无法正常工作的页面。客户端代码在浏览器中运行；用户可以读取和修改它。数据保护仍然由服务器负责，服务器会在每次请求时验证权限。

docs.title: 4.2.3. 受保护的路由
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 18-guards/src/app/app.routes.ts - PROTECTED routes
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//   - canActivate: the guards to pass, in order;
//   - data       : free information attached to the route (here, the
//                  authorized roles), which the guard reads.
// =========================================================================

import { Routes } from '@angular/router';
import { loginRequired, roleRequired } from './guards';
import { Home } from './pages/home';
import { Login } from './pages/login';
import { Schedule } from './pages/schedule';

export const routes: Routes = [
  { path: '', component: Home },
  { path: 'login', component: Login },
  { path: 'schedule', component: Schedule, canActivate: [loginRequired] },
  {
    path: 'administration',
    // deferred loading: the code is only downloaded once the guards are passed
    loadComponent: () => import('./pages/administration'),
    canActivate: [loginRequired, roleRequired],
    data: { roles: ['ADMIN'] },
  },
  { path: '**', redirectTo: '' },
];
  • 第 18 行：[canActivate]：路由守卫列表；
  • 第 22 行：管理页面按需加载：只有在守卫授权后才会下载其代码；
  • 第 23 行：两个守卫，按顺序调用：首先，必须已登录；其次，必须具有正确的角色；
  • 第 24 行：授权角色，由守卫[roleRequired]读取；
  • 第 26 行：任何未知地址都会重定向到主页。
import { ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';
import { provideRouter, withComponentInputBinding } from '@angular/router';
import { routes } from './app.routes';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [provideRouter(routes, withComponentInputBinding())],
};

配置与上一个示例相同。

docs.title: 4.2.4. 页面
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 18-guards/src/app/pages/login.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// After logging in, the user is sent back to the page they wanted to
// open (?redirect=... parameter set by the guard), or to the home page.
// router.navigateByUrl: navigating to a complete address (/schedule?x=1).
// =========================================================================

import { Component, inject, input, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { SessionService } from '../session.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-login',
  imports: [FormsModule],
  template: `
    @if (redirect()) {
      <p class="alert alert-warning">Log in to open {{ redirect() }}.</p>
    }
    <form class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2" (ngSubmit)="submit()">
      <input name="login" class="form-control w-auto" placeholder="login" autocomplete="username" [(ngModel)]="login">
      <input name="password" type="password" class="form-control w-auto" placeholder="password"
             autocomplete="current-password" [(ngModel)]="password">
      <button class="btn btn-primary">Log in</button>
    </form>
    @if (error()) {
      <p class="text-danger mt-2 mb-0">Incorrect login or password.</p>
    }
  `,
})
export class Login {
  readonly redirect = input<string>();
  private readonly session = inject(SessionService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  protected readonly login = signal('');
  protected readonly password = signal('');
  protected readonly error = signal(false);

  protected submit(): void {
    this.error.set(!this.session.logIn(this.login().trim(), this.password()));
    if (!this.error()) {
      const redirect = this.redirect();
      // we only accept an INTERNAL path: it starts with /, but not with //
      // (//site.com/... designates ANOTHER site) - no redirection to another site
      const internal = redirect !== undefined && redirect.startsWith('/') && !redirect.startsWith('//');
      this.router.navigateByUrl(internal ? redirect : '/');
    }
  }
}
  • 第 33 行：接收守卫放入地址中的参数[redirect]；
  • 第 18–20 行：向用户显示该参数；
  • 第 41 行：登录；
  • 第 43–47 行：如果成功，用户将被重定向到所请求的页面（[navigateByUrl] 接受包含参数在内的完整 URL）或主页。参数[redirect] 来自 URL：任何人都可以创建指向 /login?redirect=//malicious-site.com 的链接。因此第 46 行只接受属于应用程序内部的路径。
import { Component, input } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-home',
  template: `
    <!-- ?denied=...: set by the roleRequired guard when the role does not fit -->
    @if (denied()) {
      <p class="alert alert-danger">Your role does not allow you to open {{ denied() }}.</p>
    }
    <p class="mb-0">Public page. Try the two other links, logged in or not (admin, pelissier, martin -
      password = login).</p>
  `,
})
export class Home {
  readonly denied = input<string>();
}
  • 第 15 行：拒绝的原因，由守卫[roleRequired]提交。
import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { SessionService } from '../session.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-schedule',
  template: `<p class="mb-0">The schedule of <strong>{{ session.user()?.login }}</strong>: this page requires being logged in.</p>`,
})
export class Schedule {
  protected readonly session = inject(SessionService);
}

import { Component } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-administration',
  template: `<p class="mb-0">Administration: page reserved for the ADMIN role, loaded on demand (Network tab:
    its chunk-XXXX.js file is only downloaded on the first visit).</p>`,
})

docs.title: 4.2.6. 执行
docs.text:
[npm start 18-guards]；在未登录的情况下，点击 Administration：守卫[loginRequired] 会重定向到登录页面，同时保留所请求的页面。

以拥有 USER 角色的 martin 身份登录：登录后，你会被重定向到 /administration；这一次，守卫[roleRequired] 拒绝了导航。

以 admin 身份登录时，同一链接会打开管理页面。

docs.title: 13.1. 安装 Node.js
docs.text:
[Node.js] 可从 nodejs.org 下载：选择 LTS（长期支持）24 版本，或从 22.22.3 开始的 22 版本：这些是 [Angular] 22 所要求的版本。[Windows] 安装程序也会安装 [npm]。在控制台中验证安装：

node --version
npm --version

要在同一台机器上运行多个版本的 [Node.js] ，可以使用 [nvm-windows] （在 [Windows] 下）或 [nvm]（在 [Linux] 和 [macOS]下）。

示例和案例研究不需要安装任何全局工具：[Angular CLI] （[ng] 命令）、[Angular] 编译器、[TypeScript] （以及服务器端的 [nest] 工具）都是每个项目依赖项的一部分，由 [npm install] 安装。[package.json] 中的脚本（[npm start]、[npm run build]）会在 [node_modules] 文件夹中找到这些工具。 如果要自己创建新项目，可以使用 [npx @angular/cli new my-project] ，无需安装任何东西。

docs.title: 13.2. 安装 Visual Studio Code
docs.text:
[Visual Studio Code] 可从 code.visualstudio.com 下载。对于 [Angular]，请从扩展面板（Ctrl+Shift+X）安装 Angular Language Service 扩展（Angular 编辑器）：提供模板中的代码补全和类型检查、从选择器（[<app-input-field>]）到组件类的导航、从 [templateUrl] 到模板文件的导航，以及在输入时实时高亮显示 [Angular] 编译器错误。

通过 File / Open Folder 菜单打开项目（例如 [examples-angular] 文件夹），并通过 Terminal / New Terminal 菜单在其中打开控制台。

docs.title: 13.3. Angular DevTools 扩展
docs.text:
Angular DevTools 扩展可以安装，从 [Chrome]、[Edge] 或 [Firefox] 的扩展商店获取。它会在浏览器的开发者工具（F12）中添加一个“Angular”标签页，对于以开发模式运行的应用程序，它会显示以下内容：

  • 页面的组件树，以及每个组件的输入、输出和属性（信号及其值）；
  • 组件的信号图：哪个 [computed] 依赖于哪个信号；
  • 已注入的服务和注入器树；
  • 路由器的路由；
  • 分析器，用于测量更新每个组件所花费的时间。

你可以在那里修改某项数据并观察页面更新：这是理解响应性的绝佳方式。

docs.title: 13.4. 使用 Laragon 安装 MySQL
docs.text:
JSON 服务器需要 [MySQL] （或 [MariaDB]）。[Laragon] （laragon.org）在 [Windows] 下安装其中一个，开箱即用，并附带 [HeidiSQL] 管理工具。安装之后：

  • “Start All”按钮会在 3306 端口上启动 [MySQL] 服务器；
  • 用户 [root] 没有密码：这些是服务器 [.env.example] 文件中的默认值；
  • 在 [HeidiSQL] 中（“Database”按钮），File / Run SQL 菜单项会运行 [database/dbrdvmedecins2.sql] 脚本。

在 [Linux] 或 [macOS] 中，使用系统的包管理器安装 [MySQL] 或 [MariaDB] ，并使用命令行客户端运行该脚本：[mysql -u root -p < database/dbrdvmedecins2.sql]。

docs.title: 13.5. 安装 curl
docs.text:
[curl] 包含在 [Windows] 10 和 11 版本、[macOS] 以及大多数 [Linux] 发行版中。检查其版本：

curl --version

本文档中使用的 [--json] 选项自 7.82 版本（2022 年）起可用。如果你使用的是较旧的版本，请将 [--json @file] 替换为 [-H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @file]，或从 curl.se 安装较新的版本。

在 [PowerShell] 中，必须输入 [curl.exe]，而不是 [curl]：在 [PowerShell] 中，[curl] 是另一个命令（[Invoke-WebRequest]）的别名，该命令不包含 [curl] 的选项。命令提示符（[cmd]）则没有这个问题。

docs.title: 8. 与服务器通信
docs.text: 本章的示例会查询 JSON 服务器 [RdvMedecins]：它必须处于运行状态（在 [npm run start:dev] 文件夹 [rdvmedecins-nestjs-json] 中，端口 8080），并与端口 4200 上的 [Angular] 开发服务器同时运行。

docs.title: 8.1. 示例 22：第一个 HTTP 请求
8.1.1. 开发服务器的代理
docs.text:
示例页面来自 http://localhost:4200（[Angular] 开发服务器，由 [ng serve] 启动）；API 位于 http://localhost:8080。对浏览器而言，这是两个不同的 源 （端口是源的一部分）。然而，出于安全原因，除非服务器明确允许（即所谓的 CORS 机制），浏览器不允许页面读取来自另一个源的响应。并且发往另一个源的请求不会携带 Cookie（因此也不会携带令牌），除非代码请求这样做（[withCredentials: true]）并且服务器也接受，这同样要通过 CORS 实现。

我们不向其他源开放服务器，而是让 API 请求经由 [Angular] 开发服务器转发。这就是 代理 ，声明于工作区文件 [proxy.conf.json]：

{
  "/api": {
    "target": "http://localhost:8080",
    "secure": false
  }
}
  • 第 2 行：路径以 /api 开头的请求……
  • 第 3 行：……会被转发到 JSON 服务器。

对于每个示例，该文件都在 [ng serve] 命令的选项中指定，位于 [angular.json] 文件里：

        "serve": {
          "builder": "@angular/build:dev-server",
          "options": {
            "proxyConfig": "proxy.conf.json"
          },

浏览器发送 [GET http://localhost:4200/api/captcha]；开发服务器将请求转发到 [http://localhost:8080/api/captcha]，然后把响应返回给浏览器。对浏览器来说，页面和 API 具有同一个源：

在生产环境中，将不再有开发服务器：JSON 服务器本身会提供编译后的客户端文件（见“部署”一章）。页面和 API 仍然共享同一个源。

docs.title: 8.1.2. 请求
docs.text:
[Angular] 提供了自己的 HTTP 客户端，即服务 [HttpClient]。它在任何应用中都自动可用：只需注入即可。

// =========================================================================
// 22-httpclient/src/app/app.ts - a first HTTP request to the server
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The RdvMedecins JSON server must be running (port 8080). We ask it for
// a captcha: GET /api/captcha -> { "id": "...", "svg": "<svg ...>" }.
//
//   - HttpClient: the HTTP client of Angular (provided by default to the whole
//     application). http.get<T>(url) returns an OBSERVABLE (see example
//     19): the request is only sent when we SUBSCRIBE to it (subscribe);
//     the JSON response arrives already converted into an object, of the announced type T;
//   - the address is RELATIVE (/api/captcha): the request goes to the
//     server of the page, that of Angular (port 4200), which forwards it to the
//     JSON server (port 8080) thanks to its proxy (see proxy.conf.json);
//   - three states to display: loading, success, error.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';
import { DomSanitizer, SafeHtml } from '@angular/platform-browser';

// what GET /api/captcha returns
interface Captcha {
  id: string;
  svg: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  templateUrl: './app.html',
  styles: `
    .captcha {
      display: inline-block;
      border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
      border-radius: 0.375rem;
    }
  `,
})
export class App {
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);
  private readonly sanitizer = inject(DomSanitizer);

  protected readonly captcha = signal<Captcha | null>(null);
  protected readonly loading = signal(false);
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly requestCount = signal(0);

  // [innerHTML] inserts a string as HTML. For security, Angular
  // CLEANS this HTML ("sanitization"): it removes the scripts... and the
  // <svg> tags. bypassSecurityTrustHtml tells Angular: "this HTML is
  // safe, do not clean it". To be used ONLY for safe content: this SVG
  // is built by OUR server. With user input, it would be
  // opening the door to script injection ({{ }}, on the other hand, escapes everything).
  protected readonly svg = computed<SafeHtml | null>(() => {
    const c = this.captcha();
    return c ? this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustHtml(c.svg) : null;
  });

  constructor() {
    this.load(); // at startup, we load a captcha
  }

  protected load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.http.get<Captcha>('/api/captcha').subscribe({
      // next: the response (2xx code), already converted from JSON
      next: (captcha) => {
        this.captcha.set(captcha);
        this.requestCount.update((n) => n + 1);
        this.loading.set(false);
      },
      // error: a 4xx / 5xx response, or no response at all (status 0)
      error: (e: HttpErrorResponse) => {
        this.error.set(`the server answered ${e.status} ${e.statusText}`);
        this.captcha.set(null);
        this.loading.set(false);
      },
    });
  }
}
  • 第 22 行：来自 [GET /api/captcha] 的响应格式；
  • 第 39 行：注入 HTTP 客户端；
  • 第 42–45 行：请求的三种状态：进行中、成功（得到验证码）和错误；
  • 第 65 行：[http.get<Captcha>(url)] 准备一个 GET 请求。它返回一个可观察对象 （示例 19）：只有在被订阅（[subscribe]）时才会发送请求。该地址是相对地址：请求被发送到页面所在的服务器，再由它转发给 JSON 服务器；
  • 第 67–71 行：[next] 接收已从 JSON 转换好的响应。[<Captcha>] 向 [TypeScript] 说明对象的格式：编译器无法验证服务器将发送什么；
  • 第 73–77 行：[error] 会在收到任何 4xx 或 5xx 响应时接收一个 [HttpErrorResponse] ，在没有收到响应时（服务器宕机、网络断开：此时 [status] 为 0）也是如此。如果 JSON 服务器宕机，代理会以 5xx 错误响应；
  • 第 59 行：启动时加载一个验证码（CAPTCHA）；
  • 第 53–56 行：来自验证码（CAPTCHA）的 SVG 图像是一个字符串，必须作为 HTML 插入（模板中的 [[innerHTML]] ）。出于安全原因，[Angular] 会清理以这种方式插入的任何 HTML：它会移除脚本……以及 [<svg>] 标签。[bypassSecurityTrustHtml] 表明这段 HTML 是安全的。我们只对安全内容使用它：这个 SVG 由我们自己的服务器生成。对于用户输入的数据，这会允许脚本被注入页面；而双花括号 [{{ }}] 则会对一切进行转义。
<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 640px">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 22 - a first HTTP request</h1>
  <div class="card p-3">
    @if (loading()) {
      <p class="text-muted">Loading...</p>
    } @else if (error()) {
      <div class="alert alert-danger mb-3">
        Unable to get a captcha: {{ error() }}.<br>
        Is the RdvMedecins JSON server running (port 8080)?
      </div>
    } @else if (captcha(); as c) {
      <div class="mb-2"><div class="captcha" [innerHTML]="svg()"></div></div>
      <p class="small text-muted">id: <code>{{ c.id }}</code></p>
    }
    <button class="btn btn-primary align-self-start" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">Another image</button>
    <p class="small text-muted mt-2 mb-0">{{ requestCount() }} successful request(s) - open the Network tab of the developer tools (F12).</p>
  </div>
</div>
  • 第 4–14 行：状态显示；
  • 第 12 行：验证码（CAPTCHA）图像。

[npm start 22-httpclient]；点击 [Another image]：

在浏览器的开发者工具（F12）中，“网络”选项卡显示请求 [captcha]，它被发送到 [localhost:4200]，以及它的 JSON 响应。

docs.title: 8.2. 示例 23：登录、Cookie 和会话
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 23-login/src/app/app.ts - logging in to the RdvMedecins server
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//   1. at startup: GET /api/auth/me - are we already logged in?
//      (after an F5, the client has forgotten everything; the server reads the cookie);
//   2. login: POST /api/auth/login, JSON body { login, password,
//      captchaId, captcha }. On success, the server sets the
//      httpOnly cookie of the JWT token: our code NEVER sees it (try
//      document.cookie in the console: it is not there);
//   3. protected request: GET /api/doctors. The browser attaches the cookie
//      to it by itself (same origin);
//   4. logout: POST /api/auth/logout - the server deletes the cookie.
//
// firstValueFrom(observable): a PROMISE of the first value of the stream.
// Chains of requests can then be written with async / await,
// more readable than a cascade of subscribe. An error response rejects
// the promise with an HttpErrorResponse: a simple try / catch.
//
// A cookie belongs to a machine (localhost) and to a path (/api): it
// is therefore common to ALL the examples. Once logged in here, examples
// 24 and 25 are logged in too.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';
import { DomSanitizer } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';

interface User {
  login: string;
  name: string;
  role: 'ADMIN' | 'DOCTOR' | 'USER';
}
interface Doctor {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
}
interface Captcha {
  id: string;
  svg: string;
}
// the shape of ALL the errors of the API
interface ApiError {
  statusCode: number;
  key: string;
  params?: Record<string, string>;
}

// the few messages this example needs (example 25 will use ngx-translate)
const MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  'LOGIN.ERROR': 'Incorrect login or password.',
  'ERRORS.WRONG_CAPTCHA': 'The characters you typed do not match the image.',
  'ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS': 'Too many failed attempts. Try again later.',
};

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);
  private readonly sanitizer = inject(DomSanitizer);

  protected readonly user = signal<User | null>(null);
  protected readonly doctors = signal<Doctor[]>([]);
  protected readonly captcha = signal<Captcha | null>(null);
  protected readonly svg = computed(() => this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustHtml(this.captcha()?.svg ?? ''));
  protected readonly login = signal('admin');
  protected readonly password = signal('');
  protected readonly captchaAnswer = signal('');
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly ready = signal(false); // is the initial check finished?

  constructor() {
    this.checkSession().catch(() => {
      this.error.set('Is the RdvMedecins JSON server running (port 8080)?');
      this.ready.set(true);
    });
  }

  protected async loadCaptcha(): Promise<void> {
    this.captcha.set(await firstValueFrom(this.http.get<Captcha>('/api/captcha')));
    this.captchaAnswer.set('');
  }

  // 1. who is logged in? 200 -> the user; 401 -> nobody
  private async checkSession(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.user.set(await firstValueFrom(this.http.get<User>('/api/auth/me')));
      await this.loadDoctors();
    } catch (e) {
      if (!(e instanceof HttpErrorResponse) || e.status !== 401) {
        throw e; // not a 401: the server does not respond
      }
      await this.loadCaptcha();
    }
    this.ready.set(true);
  }

  // 2. the login; post(url, body): the body is sent as JSON
  protected async logIn(): Promise<void> {
    this.error.set(null);
    try {
      const u = await firstValueFrom(
        this.http.post<User>('/api/auth/login', {
          login: this.login(),
          password: this.password(),
          captchaId: this.captcha()?.id,
          captcha: this.captchaAnswer(),
        }),
      );
      this.user.set(u);
      this.password.set('');
      await this.loadDoctors();
    } catch (e) {
      // e.error: the JSON body of the error response
      const apiError = (e as HttpErrorResponse).error as ApiError | null;
      const key = apiError?.key ?? 'ERRORS.SERVER_UNREACHABLE';
      this.error.set(`${(e as HttpErrorResponse).status} - ${MESSAGES[key] ?? key}`);
      await this.loadCaptcha(); // each image is only used once
    }
  }

  // 3. a protected request
  private async loadDoctors(): Promise<void> {
    this.doctors.set(await firstValueFrom(this.http.get<Doctor[]>('/api/doctors')));
  }

  // 4. the logout
  protected async logOut(): Promise<void> {
    await firstValueFrom(this.http.post('/api/auth/logout', {}));
    this.user.set(null);
    this.doctors.set([]);
    await this.loadCaptcha();
  }
}
  • 第 30–50 行：与服务器交换的数据格式，包括 API 所有错误的格式（第 46–50 行）；
  • 第 53–57 行：本示例所需的少量消息，使用英文；示例 25 将使用 [ngx-translate]；
  • 第 28 行：[firstValueFrom(observable)] 返回一个关于流中第一个值的 Promise 。HTTP 请求只产生一个值——响应：这样我们就可以使用 [async] / [await] 编写请求链，这比层层嵌套的 [subscribe] 更易读。错误响应会使 Promise 被拒绝（rejected）：一个简单的 [try / catch] 就能捕获它；
  • 第 91–102 行：启动时执行 [GET /api/auth/me]：我们是否已经登录？重新加载页面（F5）之后，[Angular] 应用忘记了一切；然而服务器会读取 Cookie。200：返回用户；401：无人登录——这种情况下会显示登录表单及其验证码（CAPTCHA）（第 99 行）；
  • 第 96 行：任何其他错误都表示服务器没有响应；它会被报告给开发者（第 79–82 行）；
  • 第 105–126 行：登录：
    • 第 109 行：[http.post(url, body)]：对象 [body] 以 JSON 形式发送，并带有请求头 [Content-Type: application/json]；
    • 第 116 行：如果成功，服务器已经设置了令牌 Cookie。我们的代码绝对看不到它：在浏览器控制台中输入 [document.cookie] ，它不在其中（[HttpOnly]）；
    • 第 121 行：如果请求失败，[error] 包含 JSON 响应体，其中解释了原因。我们显示该消息（第 123 行），并请求一张新图像（第 124 行）：每张图像只能使用一次；
  • 第 129–131 行：受保护的请求。无需任何操作来进行身份验证：浏览器会自动带上 Cookie，因为该请求发往与页面相同的源；
  • 第 134–139 行：注销——服务器删除 Cookie。请求体 [{}] 的加入使该请求成为一个 JSON POST 请求。

Cookie 属于一台机器（localhost）和一个路径（/api）；因此它被所有示例共享。在这里登录一次之后，示例 24 和 25 也处于登录状态。

登录表单：

<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 640px">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 23 - logging in to the server</h1>
  @if (!ready()) {

  } @else if (user(); as u) {
    <!-- logged in -->
    <div class="card p-3">
      <p>Logged in: <strong>{{ u.name }}</strong> ({{ u.login }}), role <span class="badge text-bg-primary">{{ u.role }}</span></p>

  } @else {
    <!-- not logged in: the form -->
    <form class="card p-3" (ngSubmit)="logIn()">
      <div class="mb-2">

        <input id="login" name="login" class="form-control" autocomplete="username" [(ngModel)]="login">
      </div>

        <input id="password" name="password" type="password" class="form-control" autocomplete="current-password"
               [(ngModel)]="password">
      </div>

        <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mb-2">

  • 第 3 行：在初始验证完成之前，我们不知道该显示什么；
  • 第 5–17 行：已登录：显示用户和医生列表；
  • 第 20–40 行：未登录：显示表单，使用 [ngModel] （示例 05）；
  • 第 34 行：[$event.preventDefault()] 阻止链接跳转到其地址（#）。

[npm start 23-login]。输入错误的密码时（服务器处于测试模式：任何验证码（CAPTCHA）都接受响应 [test]）：

输入正确的密码，然后刷新页面（F5）：你仍保持登录状态。

docs.title: 8.3. 示例 24：API 的访问层
docs.text:
在示例 23 中，每个请求都重复相同的步骤：/api 前缀、[firstValueFrom]、读取错误响应体，以及选择消息。本示例把它们归并到几个文件中，这些文件位于工作区的 [common] 文件夹 中，因为示例 25 也会用到它们：

examples-angular/common/
├── types.ts                the JSON objects of the API
├── api-error.ts            a class for all the API errors
├── errors.interceptor.ts   an HTTP interceptor
├── api.service.ts          one-line requests
└── login-bar.ts            the login, in a bar

示例中的 [tsconfig.app.json] 文件把该文件夹加入要编译的文件中：

{
  "extends": "../tsconfig.json",
  "include": ["src/**/*.ts", "../common/**/*.ts"]
}

docs.title: 8.3.1. 类型
docs.text:
API 中 JSON 对象的类型，已在上一章中描述：

// =========================================================================
// common/types.ts - the JSON objects exchanged with the RdvMedecins API
// (see the chapter on the black box, which describes each route)
// =========================================================================

export type Role = 'ADMIN' | 'DOCTOR' | 'USER';

// POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/auth/me
export interface User {
  login: string;
  name: string;
  role: Role;
}

// GET /api/captcha
export interface Captcha {
  id: string;
  svg: string;
}

// a doctor or a client (GET /api/doctors, GET /api/clients...)
export interface Person {
  id: number;
  version: number;
  title: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  login?: string; // only for the ADMIN
}

export interface Identity {
  title: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
}

// a row of GET /api/schedule
export interface ScheduleSlot {
  id: number;
  startHour: number;
  startMinute: number;
  endHour: number;
  endMinute: number;
  free: boolean;
  patient: Identity | null;
  mine: boolean;
  bookable: boolean;
  appointmentId: number | null;
}

// GET /api/schedule?doctorId=...&day=...
export interface Schedule {
  doctor: Person;
  day: string;
  slots: ScheduleSlot[];
  info: string | null;
}

docs.title: 8.3.2. 错误
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// common/api-error.ts - ONE class for all the errors of the API
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// All the error responses of the RdvMedecins server have the same shape:
//   { "statusCode": 409, "key": "ERRORS.LOGIN_TAKEN", "params": {...}, "fields": {...} }
// HttpClient reports them with an HttpErrorResponse, whose error property
// contains this JSON body... or something else: null (no response), text
// (an error page of the proxy when the JSON server is stopped). We
// convert all of this into ONE class, ApiError, which carries the translation
// key sent by the server (and, if any, its parameters and
// the error of each field).
// =========================================================================

import { HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';

export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public readonly statusCode: number, // 0: the server did not respond
    public readonly key: string, // e.g.: 'ERRORS.LOGIN_TAKEN'
    public readonly params: Record<string, string> = {},
    public readonly fields: Record<string, string> = {},
  ) {
    super(key);
    this.name = 'ApiError';
  }
}

// any error -> an ApiError
export function toApiError(e: unknown): ApiError {
  if (e instanceof ApiError) {
    return e;
  }
  if (!(e instanceof HttpErrorResponse)) {
    return new ApiError(0, 'ERRORS.SERVER_ERROR');
  }
  // the JSON body of the error, if it exists and has the right shape
  const body = (typeof e.error === 'object' && e.error !== null ? e.error : {}) as {
    key?: string;
    params?: Record<string, string>;
    fields?: Record<string, string>;
  };
  // no key: it is not our server that responded (proxy, network)
  const key = body.key ?? (e.status === 0 || e.status >= 500 ? 'ERRORS.SERVER_UNREACHABLE' : 'ERRORS.SERVER_ERROR');
  return new ApiError(e.status, key, body.params, body.fields);
}
  • 第 16–26 行：一个包含服务器响应的错误类：HTTP 状态码、消息键、其参数，以及每个字段的错误。状态码 0 表示“没有响应”；
  • 第 29–45 行：将任何错误转换为 [ApiError]：
    • 第 37 行：只有当响应体是对象时才使用它。当 JSON 服务器宕机时，代理会以文本响应；
    • 第 43 行：没有键，说明响应的不是我们的服务器。

docs.title: 8.3.3. 拦截器
docs.text:
拦截器 是一个函数，[HttpClient] 的请求及其响应都会经过它。它可以在请求发送之前修改请求（例如添加请求头），或在响应返回时修改响应。

// =========================================================================
// common/errors.interceptor.ts - an HTTP INTERCEPTOR
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// An interceptor is a function through which ALL the requests
// of HttpClient (and their responses) go. It receives the request (req) and the rest
// of the chain (next):
//   - next(req) sends the request and returns the observable of the response;
//   - the request can be modified before (req.clone({...})), or the response
//     after (RxJS operators on the observable).
// This one converts any error into an ApiError (catchError): the rest of
// the application never deals with HttpErrorResponse again.
// It is declared in the configuration of the application:
//     provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([errorsInterceptor]))
// =========================================================================

import { HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';
import { catchError, throwError } from 'rxjs';
import { toApiError } from './api-error';

export const errorsInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (req, next) =>
  next(req).pipe(catchError((e: unknown) => throwError(() => toApiError(e))));
  • 第 20 行：拦截器接收请求（[req]）和链的其余部分（[next]）。[next(req)] 发送请求并返回响应的可观察对象；
  • 第 21 行：[catchError] 操作符将流中的任何错误替换为一个 [ApiError]。应用的其余部分再也不必处理 [HttpErrorResponse] 了。

docs.title: 8.3.4. ApiService 服务
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// common/api.service.ts - requests to the API, in one line
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// In example 23, each request repeated the same steps: /api
// prefix, firstValueFrom, reading of the error body... We group them here:
//
//   const doctors = await this.api.get<Person[]>('/doctors');
//   await this.api.post('/appointments', { day, slotId, clientId });
//
//   - on success, the promise returns the JSON body, TYPED;
//   - on failure, it is REJECTED with an ApiError (thanks to the
//     errors.interceptor.ts interceptor).
// Used by examples 24 and 25; the case study takes up its principle.
// =========================================================================

import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ApiService {
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);

  get<T>(url: string): Promise<T> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.get<T>(`/api${url}`));
  }

  // a POST always has a JSON body (the server rejects a POST that does not)
  post<T>(url: string, body: unknown = {}): Promise<T> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.post<T>(`/api${url}`, body));
  }

  put<T>(url: string, body: unknown): Promise<T> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.put<T>(`/api${url}`, body));
  }

  delete<T>(url: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.delete<T>(`/api${url}`, { body: body }));
  }
}
  • 第 24–39 行：每个 HTTP 动词对应一个方法。每个方法都会添加 /api 前缀，并返回响应体的 Promise ，其类型为：[api.get<Person[]>('/doctors')] 返回一个 [Promise<Person[]>]。失败时，该 Promise 会以 [ApiError] 被拒绝；
  • 第 29 行：[post] 默认发送请求体 [{}]：服务器会拒绝不是 JSON 的 POST 请求。

docs.title: 8.3.5. API 访问层
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 24-api-service/src/app/rdvmedecins.service.ts - the API access layer
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// One typed method per route of the API. The components know neither
// the URLs, nor HttpClient, nor the JSON format: they call methods.
// It is the client-side equivalent of the DAO layer on the server side: if the API
// changes (a URL, a field name), only this file is modified.
// =========================================================================

import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpResourceRequest } from '@angular/common/http';
import { ApiService } from '../../../common/api.service';
import { Person } from '../../../common/types';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class RdvMedecinsService {
  private readonly api = inject(ApiService);

  getDoctors(): Promise<Person[]> {
    return this.api.get<Person[]>('/doctors');
  }

  getClients(): Promise<Person[]> {
    return this.api.get<Person[]>('/clients');
  }

  // the DESCRIPTION of the request of the schedule, for httpResource (see app.ts);
  // params builds "?doctorId=1&day=2030-01-15", encoding what needs to be
  scheduleRequest(doctorId: number, day: string): HttpResourceRequest {
    return { url: '/api/schedule', params: { doctorId, day } };
  }

  book(day: string, slotId: number, clientId?: number): Promise<{ id: number }> {
    return this.api.post<{ id: number }>('/appointments', { day, slotId, clientId });
  }

  cancelAppointment(appointmentId: number): Promise<Record<string, never>> {
    return this.api.delete<Record<string, never>>(`/appointments/${appointmentId}`);
  }
}

API 的每条路由对应一个方法。组件不再知道地址、[HttpClient]或 JSON 格式：它们只调用方法。这相当于服务器端数据访问层在客户端的对应物：如果 API 发生变化，只需修改这个文件。

  • 第 29–31 行：日程请求的描述 ，而不是请求本身：它将由 [httpResource] 使用（见下文）。[params] 通过对需要编码的字符进行编码，生成字符串 [?doctorId=1&day=2030-01-15] 。

docs.title: 8.3.6. 登录栏
docs.text:
示例 23 中的表单，缩减为一个栏，并使用 [ApiService] 重写：

// =========================================================================
// common/login-bar.ts - login / logout, in one bar
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The form of example 23, reduced to a bar and rewritten with
// ApiService. The component emits userChange with the logged-in
// user (or null) each time it changes - including at
// startup, after having queried GET /api/auth/me.
//
// ViewEncapsulation.None: the styles of the component apply to the WHOLE
// page. Necessary here: the <svg> of the captcha, inserted by [innerHTML], does not
// carry the attributes that the "encapsulated" style of Angular requires.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, output, signal, ViewEncapsulation } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { DomSanitizer } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { ApiError } from './api-error';
import { Captcha, User } from './types';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-login-bar',
  imports: [FormsModule],
  encapsulation: ViewEncapsulation.None,
  styles: `
    .login-bar-captcha svg {
      display: block;
      height: 32px;
      width: auto;
    }
  `,
  template: `
    <div class="alert alert-secondary d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2 py-2">
      @if (user(); as u) {
        <span>Logged in: <strong>{{ u.name }}</strong> <span class="badge text-bg-primary ms-1">{{ u.role }}</span></span>
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary ms-auto" (click)="logOut()">Log out</button>
      } @else {
        <form class="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2 w-100" (ngSubmit)="logIn()">
          <input name="login" class="form-control form-control-sm w-auto" placeholder="login" autocomplete="username"
                 [(ngModel)]="login">
          <input name="password" type="password" class="form-control form-control-sm w-auto" placeholder="password"
                 autocomplete="current-password" [(ngModel)]="password">
          <div class="login-bar-captcha" [innerHTML]="svg()"></div>
          <input name="captcha" class="form-control form-control-sm w-auto" placeholder="captcha" autocomplete="off" size="8"
                 [(ngModel)]="captchaAnswer">
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">Log in</button>
          @if (error()) {
            <span class="text-danger small">{{ error() }}</span>
          }
        </form>
      }
    </div>
  `,
})
export class LoginBar {
  readonly userChange = output<User | null>();

  private readonly api = inject(ApiService);
  private readonly sanitizer = inject(DomSanitizer);
  protected readonly user = signal<User | null>(null);
  private readonly captcha = signal<Captcha | null>(null);
  protected readonly svg = computed(() => this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustHtml(this.captcha()?.svg ?? ''));
  protected readonly login = signal('admin');
  protected readonly password = signal('');
  protected readonly captchaAnswer = signal('');
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);

  constructor() {
    this.start();
  }

  private async start(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.change(await this.api.get<User>('/auth/me'));
    } catch {
      this.change(null); // 401: nobody is logged in
      await this.newCaptcha().catch(() => this.error.set('Is the JSON server running (port 8080)?'));
    }
  }

  private async newCaptcha(): Promise<void> {
    this.captcha.set(await this.api.get<Captcha>('/captcha'));
    this.captchaAnswer.set('');
  }

  private change(u: User | null): void {
    this.user.set(u);
    this.userChange.emit(u);
  }

  protected async logIn(): Promise<void> {
    this.error.set(null);
    try {
      const u = await this.api.post<User>('/auth/login', {
        login: this.login(),
        password: this.password(),
        captchaId: this.captcha()?.id,
        captcha: this.captchaAnswer(),
      });
      this.password.set('');
      this.change(u);
    } catch (e) {
      this.error.set(e instanceof ApiError ? `${e.statusCode} ${e.key}` : String(e));
      await this.newCaptcha();
    }
  }

  protected async logOut(): Promise<void> {
    await this.api.post('/auth/logout');
    this.change(null);
    await this.newCaptcha();
  }
}
  • 第 56 行：每当已登录用户发生变化（包括启动时），组件都会发出 [userChange] 事件，携带该用户（或 [null]）；
  • 第 74 行：有了 [ApiService]，一个请求只需一行；失败（401）时，会转入 [catch]；
  • 第 103 行：[instanceof] 用于区分 API 错误和其他异常；
  • 第 24 行：[ViewEncapsulation.None]：组件的样式应用于整个页面。默认情况下，[Angular] 通过给组件的元素添加特定属性，把组件的样式限制在其模板内。由 [<svg>] 通过 [[innerHTML]] 插入的元素没有这些属性：没有这个选项，第 26–30 行的规则就不会应用到它。

docs.title: 8.3.7. 配置
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 24-api-service/src/app/app.config.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([...])): HttpClient is provided by default
// to any application; it is only declared to CONFIGURE it, here by
// adding the interceptor that converts the errors into ApiError.
// =========================================================================

import { ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';
import { provideHttpClient, withInterceptors } from '@angular/common/http';
import { errorsInterceptor } from '../../../common/errors.interceptor';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([errorsInterceptor]))],
};
  • 第 14 行：[HttpClient] 默认已提供；声明它只是为了配置它，此处是添加拦截器。

docs.title: 8.3.8. 页面
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 24-api-service/src/app/app.ts - a schedule, with the API access layer
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Log in (top bar), choose a doctor and a day: the schedule
// is displayed. ADMIN and DOCTOR can book for a patient and cancel;
// a patient (martin...) books for themselves. Each action ends with
// a reload of the schedule: it is the SERVER that is authoritative.
//
// httpResource: a GET request described by a function that reads
// signals (here doctorId and day). Angular sends it at startup, then
// SENDS IT AGAIN each time one of these signals changes. The result is an
// object of signals: value() (the response), isLoading(), error()... and
// reload() to send it again on demand.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, effect, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { httpResource } from '@angular/common/http';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { LoginBar } from '../../../common/login-bar';
import { ApiError } from '../../../common/api-error';
import { Schedule, ScheduleSlot, Person, User } from '../../../common/types';
import { RdvMedecinsService } from './rdvmedecins.service';

function tomorrow(): string {
  const d = new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3600 * 1000);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [FormsModule, LoginBar],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  private readonly rdv = inject(RdvMedecinsService);

  protected readonly user = signal<User | null>(null);
  protected readonly doctors = signal<Person[]>([]);
  protected readonly clients = signal<Person[]>([]);
  protected readonly doctorId = signal<number | null>(null);
  protected readonly day = signal(tomorrow());
  protected readonly clientId = signal<number | null>(null);
  protected readonly message = signal<{ type: 'success' | 'danger'; text: string } | null>(null);

  protected readonly isManager = computed(() => this.user() !== null && this.user()?.role !== 'USER');

  // undefined: no request (no doctor chosen, or nobody logged in)
  protected readonly schedule = httpResource<Schedule>(() => {
    const id = this.doctorId();
    return id === null || this.user() === null ? undefined : this.rdv.scheduleRequest(id, this.day());
  });

  // the error of the last request of the schedule, as an ApiError
  protected readonly scheduleError = computed(() => {
    const e = this.schedule.error();
    return e instanceof ApiError ? `${e.statusCode} ${e.key}` : null;
  });

  constructor() {
    // a new choice of doctor or day clears the previous message
    effect(() => {
      this.doctorId();
      this.day();
      this.message.set(null);
    });
  }

  protected timeRange(c: ScheduleSlot): string {
    const hm = (h: number, m: number) => `${h}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    return `${hm(c.startHour, c.startMinute)} - ${hm(c.endHour, c.endMinute)}`;
  }

  // an API error becomes a message (its key, for lack of a dictionary here)
  private report(e: unknown): void {
    this.message.set({ type: 'danger', text: e instanceof ApiError ? `${e.statusCode} ${e.key}` : String(e) });
  }

  // login / logout: we (re)load what this role is allowed to see
  protected async onUserChange(u: User | null): Promise<void> {
    this.user.set(u);
    this.doctors.set([]);
    this.clients.set([]);
    if (u === null) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      this.doctors.set(await this.rdv.getDoctors());
      // the list of patients: only for ADMIN and DOCTOR (a USER would receive 403)
      this.clients.set(this.isManager() ? await this.rdv.getClients() : []);
    } catch (e) {
      this.report(e);
    }
  }

  protected async book(c: ScheduleSlot): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.rdv.book(this.day(), c.id, this.isManager() ? (this.clientId() ?? undefined) : undefined);
      this.message.set({ type: 'success', text: `Slot ${this.timeRange(c)} booked.` });
    } catch (e) {
      this.report(e);
    }
    this.schedule.reload();
  }

  protected async cancel(c: ScheduleSlot): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.rdv.cancelAppointment(c.appointmentId as number);
      this.message.set({ type: 'success', text: `Appointment of ${this.timeRange(c)} cancelled.` });
    } catch (e) {
      this.report(e);
    }
    this.schedule.reload();
  }
}
  • 第 45 行：ADMIN 或 DOCTOR；
  • 第 48–51 行：[httpResource] 通过一个读取信号的函数来描述 GET 请求（此处为 [doctorId]、[day] 和 [user]）。[Angular] 先发送请求，之后每当其中一个信号变化时就重新发送它。当没有请求可发送时，该函数返回 [undefined] 。结果是一组信号：[value()] （响应）、[isLoading()]、[error()]、[hasValue()]……以及一个方法 [reload()]，用于按需重新发送请求。如果信号变化时某个请求仍在进行中，它会被放弃，就像 [switchMap] （示例 19）一样；
  • 第 54–57 行：最近一次日程请求的错误。来自 [httpResource] 的请求同样会经过拦截器：该错误是一个 [ApiError]；
  • 第 61–65 行：一个在医生或日期变化时清除先前消息的函数；
  • 第 79–93 行：每当用户登录或注销，系统就（重新）加载该角色有权查看的内容。患者在请求客户列表时会收到 403 错误：我们甚至不会去请求它；
  • 第 95–103 行：进行预订，随后无论发生什么，都会重新加载日程（第 102 行）。服务器的记录才是最终结果：如果该时间段在此期间被别人占用，刷新后的日程会显示出来；
  • 第 97 行：管理员为所选患者进行预订；患者则为自己预订。
<div class="container py-4">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Example 24 - an API access layer</h1>
  <app-login-bar (userChange)="onUserChange($event)" />

  @if (user()) {
    <div class="row g-2 mb-3">
      <div class="col-sm-5">
        <select class="form-select" [(ngModel)]="doctorId">
          <option [ngValue]="null" disabled>-- choose a doctor --</option>
          @for (m of doctors(); track m.id) {
            <option [ngValue]="m.id">{{ m.title }} {{ m.firstName }} {{ m.lastName }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="col-sm-3"><input type="date" class="form-control" [(ngModel)]="day"></div>
      @if (isManager()) {
        <div class="col-sm-4">
          <select class="form-select" [(ngModel)]="clientId">
            <option [ngValue]="null">-- patient to book for --</option>
            @for (c of clients(); track c.id) {
              <option [ngValue]="c.id">{{ c.title }} {{ c.firstName }} {{ c.lastName }}</option>
            }
          </select>
        </div>
      }
    </div>

    @if (message(); as m) {
      <div class="alert" [class]="'alert-' + m.type">{{ m.text }}</div>
    }
    @if (scheduleError()) {
      <div class="alert alert-danger">{{ scheduleError() }}</div>
    }
    @if (schedule.isLoading()) {
      <p class="small text-muted">loading the schedule...</p>
    }

    <!-- hasValue(): a response is available (value() is not undefined) -->
    @if (schedule.hasValue()) {
      @let a = schedule.value();
      <!-- info: the key sent by the server when a patient already has an upcoming appointment -->
      @if (a.info) {
        <div class="alert alert-info">{{ a.info }}</div>
      }
      <table class="table table-sm align-middle">
        <caption class="caption-top">Schedule of {{ a.day }} - {{ a.doctor.title }} {{ a.doctor.firstName }} {{ a.doctor.lastName }}</caption>
        <tbody>
          @for (c of a.slots; track c.id) {
            <tr>
              <td>{{ timeRange(c) }}</td>
              <td>
                @if (c.free) {
                  <span class="badge text-bg-success">Free</span>
                } @else if (c.patient; as p) {
                  <span class="badge" [class]="c.mine ? 'text-bg-primary' : 'text-bg-secondary'">{{ p.title }} {{ p.firstName }} {{ p.lastName }}</span>
                } @else {
                  <span class="badge text-bg-secondary">Booked</span>
                }
              </td>
              <td class="text-end">
                <!-- the buttons follow the rights computed by the server -->
                @if (c.bookable) {
                  <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success" (click)="book(c)">Book</button>
                }
                @if (c.appointmentId !== null) {
                  <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" (click)="cancel(c)">Cancel</button>
                }
              </td>
            </tr>
          }
        </tbody>
      </table>
    }
  }
</div>
  • 第 3 行：登录栏；
  • 第 34 行：[isLoading()]：有请求正在进行；
  • 第 39 行：[hasValue()]：有可用的响应；
  • 第 40 行：[@let] 避免[schedule.value()] 被重复书写；
  • 第 57 行：一个被占用的时间段，服务器没有为其发送患者信息（患者视角）；
  • 第 62–67 行：按钮遵循服务器计算出的权限。

[npm start 24-api-service]。管理员为 Alice DURAND 预订 8:40 的时间段：

患者 Martin 看到的同一份日程：该时间段已被预订，但没有列出患者姓名。

docs.title: 8.4. 示例 25：服务器返回的错误
docs.text:
本示例演示管理员对客户的管理。表单在浏览器中不做任何验证：所有内容都发送给服务器，服务器在拒绝时会以错误作出响应：

400 { "key": "ERRORS.INVALID_FORM", "fields": { "lastName": "ERRORS.LASTNAME_REQUIRED" } }
409 { "key": "ERRORS.PATIENT_ALREADY_EXISTS", "fields": { "firstName": "...", "lastName": "..." } }
409 { "key": "ERRORS.CONCURRENT_UPDATE" }

然后必须显示总体消息，并以用户的语言，把每个字段的错误显示在该字段下方。
