// =========================================================================
// 25-server-errors/src/app/i18n/i18n.ts - ngx-translate, as in example 21
// =========================================================================

import { Provider } from '@angular/core';
import { provideTranslateLoader, provideTranslateService, TranslateLoader, TranslationObject } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { Observable, of } from 'rxjs';
import fr from './fr.json';
import en from './en.json';

class DictionariesLoader implements TranslateLoader {
  getTranslation(language: string): Observable<TranslationObject> {
    return of(language === 'en' ? en : fr);
  }
}

export function provideI18n(): Provider[] {
  return provideTranslateService({ loader: provideTranslateLoader(DictionariesLoader), fallbackLang: 'en', lang: 'en' });
}

应用配置整合了前面示例中介绍的各个元素：

// =========================================================================
// 25-server-errors/src/app/app.config.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//   - HttpClient and the errors interceptor (see example 24);
//   - ngx-translate (see example 21);
//   - the Bootstrap classes of the fields (see example 07). Here, no
//     "touched": a field gets a red border as soon as it carries an error,
//     that is to say as soon as the SERVER has reported one.
// =========================================================================

import { ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';
import { provideHttpClient, withInterceptors } from '@angular/common/http';
import { provideSignalFormsConfig } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { errorsInterceptor } from '../../../common/errors.interceptor';
import { provideI18n } from './i18n/i18n';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([errorsInterceptor])),
    provideI18n(),
    provideSignalFormsConfig({ classes: { 'is-invalid': (field) => field.state().invalid() } }),
  ],
};
  • 第 19 行：HTTP 客户端及其拦截器（示例 24）；
  • 第 20 行：[ngx-translate] （示例 21）；
  • 第 21 行：[Bootstrap] 字段类（示例 07）。在这里，字段一旦包含错误（也就是服务器一旦报告了错误）就会以红色突出显示。

页面：

// =========================================================================
// 25-server-errors/src/app/app.ts - displaying the errors of the SERVER
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The management of the clients (admin account). This form
// DELIBERATELY does no validation in the browser: its schema is empty.
// Everything is sent to the server, which answers, in case of refusal, with a JSON
// error (converted into an ApiError by the interceptor):
//
//   400 { key: 'ERRORS.INVALID_FORM', fields: { lastName: 'ERRORS.LASTNAME_REQUIRED' } }
//   409 { key: 'ERRORS.PATIENT_ALREADY_EXISTS', fields: { firstName: ..., lastName: ... } }
//   409 { key: 'ERRORS.CONCURRENT_UPDATE' }         (optimistic lock)
//
// submit(form, action): the action sends the model to the server. If it
// returns ERRORS (an array), the signal forms attach them
// to the designated fields (fieldTree): they appear in f.lastName().errors(),
// like the errors of a validator. Their message is here the KEY sent by
// the server, which the template translates (ngx-translate). Try: an empty
// last name, a "Dr" title, a namesake (Alice DURAND), a login already taken
// (martin), the same record modified in two tabs...
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormField, form, submit, ValidationError } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { TranslatePipe, TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { ApiService } from '../../../common/api.service';
import { LoginBar } from '../../../common/login-bar';
import { ApiError } from '../../../common/api-error';
import { Person, User } from '../../../common/types';
// the confirmation dialog of example 16, reused as is
import { ConfirmationService } from '../../../16-confirmation/src/app/confirmation/confirmation.service';
import { ConfirmDialog } from '../../../16-confirmation/src/app/confirmation/confirm-dialog';

interface ClientInput {
  title: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  login: string;
  password: string;
  version: number;
}

const EMPTY: ClientInput = { title: 'Mr', firstName: '', lastName: '', login: '', password: '', version: 0 };

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [FormField, TranslatePipe, LoginBar, ConfirmDialog],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  private readonly api = inject(ApiService);
  private readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);
  protected readonly translate = inject(TranslateService);

  protected readonly user = signal<User | null>(null);
  protected readonly clients = signal<Person[]>([]);
  protected readonly isAdmin = computed(() => this.user()?.role === 'ADMIN');

  // the form: editedId === null -> creation, otherwise update
  protected readonly editedId = signal<number | null>(null);
  protected readonly model = signal<ClientInput>({ ...EMPTY });
  protected readonly f = form(this.model); // no validator: the server validates
  // the general message of the last error, and that of a success
  protected readonly pageError = signal<ApiError | null>(null);
  protected readonly success = signal<{ key: string; params: Record<string, string> } | null>(null);

  protected async onUserChange(u: User | null): Promise<void> {
    this.user.set(u);
    this.clients.set([]);
    if (u?.role === 'ADMIN') {
      await this.reload();
    }
  }

  private async reload(): Promise<void> {
    this.clients.set(await this.api.get<Person[]>('/clients'));
  }

  protected newForm(): void {
    this.editedId.set(null);
    this.model.set({ ...EMPTY });
    this.f().reset(); // the state of the fields (and their errors) starts from zero
    this.clearMessages();
  }

  protected edit(c: Person): void {
    this.editedId.set(c.id);
    // the VERSION read with the record goes back with the update: if someone
    // has modified the record in the meantime, the server will answer 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE
    this.model.set({ title: c.title, firstName: c.firstName, lastName: c.lastName, login: c.login ?? '', password: '', version: c.version });
    this.f().reset();
    this.clearMessages();
  }

  private clearMessages(): void {
    this.pageError.set(null);
    this.success.set(null);
  }

  // the error of EACH field, returned by the server -> an error of the form
  private fieldErrors(e: ApiError): ValidationError.WithOptionalFieldTree[] {
    const fields = Object.keys(this.model()) as (keyof ClientInput)[];
    return Object.entries(e.fields)
      .filter(([field]) => fields.includes(field as keyof ClientInput))
      .map(([field, key]) => ({ kind: 'server', message: key, fieldTree: this.f[field as keyof ClientInput] }));
  }

  protected async save(event: SubmitEvent): Promise<void> {
    event.preventDefault();
    this.clearMessages();
    const id = this.editedId();
    await submit(this.f, async () => {
      try {
        const body = this.model();
        const client =
          id === null
            ? await this.api.post<Person>('/clients', body)
            : await this.api.put<Person>(`/clients/${id}`, body);
        this.newForm(); // form cleared, messages cleared...
        // ... except this one
        this.success.set({
          key: id === null ? 'FORM.ADDED' : 'FORM.UPDATED',
          params: { name: `${client.firstName} ${client.lastName}`, login: client.login ?? '' },
        });
        await this.reload();
        return null;
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof ApiError)) {
          throw e;
        }
        this.pageError.set(e); // the general message
        return this.fieldErrors(e); // the error of each field
      }
    });
  }

  protected async remove(c: Person): Promise<void> {
    const name = `${c.firstName} ${c.lastName}`;
    if (!(await this.confirmation.confirm(this.translate.instant('FORM.DELETE_CONFIRM', { name })))) {
      return;
    }
    this.clearMessages();
    try {
      await this.api.delete(`/clients/${c.id}`);
      this.success.set({ key: 'FORM.DELETED', params: { name } });
    } catch (e) {
      this.pageError.set(e instanceof ApiError ? e : null);
    }
    await this.reload();
  }
}
  • 第 30–31 行：示例 16 中的确认窗口，原样复用：设计良好的组件是可复用的；
  • 第 61 行：一个信号表单（示例 06），没有模式（schema）：没有验证器；
  • 第 63–64 行：针对最后一个错误的通用消息，以及成功消息；
  • 第 85–92 行：要编辑一条记录，需将其值复制到表单中，包括版本号：记录将随该变更一并更新（乐观锁）。[reset()] 重置各字段的状态及其错误；
  • 第 107–134 行：保存记录。[submit(form, action)] 执行该 action，将表单发送到服务器：创建时使用 POST（第 116 行），修改时使用 PUT（第 117 行）。在其执行期间，[f().submitting()] 为 true；
  • 第 125 行：[null]：没有错误；
  • 第 130–131 行：如果被拒绝，则保留通用消息，字段错误则被返回。表单验证系统随后将它们附加到指定的字段上：它们出现在[f.lastName().errors()]中，与验证器错误完全一样；一旦用户修改该字段，它们就会消失；
  • 第 100–105 行：转换。每个错误都标明其所属字段（[fieldTree]，第 104 行）；其消息是服务器发送的键。第 103 行忽略表单中不存在的未知字段；
  • 第 138 行：[translate.instant(key, params)]：在代码中翻译一个键；
  • 第 146 行：删除客户也可能被拒绝。
<div class="container py-4">
  <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">
    <h1 class="h3 mb-0">Example 25 - the errors returned by the server</h1>
    <select #language class="form-select form-select-sm w-auto" (change)="translate.use(language.value)">
      <option value="fr">FR</option>
      <option value="en" selected>EN</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <app-login-bar (userChange)="onUserChange($event)" />
  @if (user() && !isAdmin()) {
    <p class="alert alert-warning">{{ 'FORM.ADMIN_ONLY' | translate }}</p>
  }

  @if (isAdmin()) {
    <div class="row g-4">
      <div class="col-lg-6">
        <table class="table table-sm align-middle">
          <tbody>
            @for (c of clients(); track c.id) {
              <tr>
                <td>{{ c.title }} {{ c.firstName }} {{ c.lastName }}</td>
                <td><code>{{ c.login }}</code></td>
                <td class="text-end text-nowrap">
                  <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary me-1" (click)="edit(c)">{{ 'FORM.EDIT' | translate }}</button>
                  <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" (click)="remove(c)">{{ 'FORM.DELETE' | translate }}</button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <div class="col-lg-6">
        <form class="card p-3" novalidate (submit)="save($event)">
          <h2 class="h5">{{ (editedId() === null ? 'FORM.TITLE_ADD' : 'FORM.TITLE_EDIT') | translate }}</h2>
          <div class="mb-2">
            <label class="form-label" for="title">{{ 'FORM.TITLE' | translate }}</label>
            <!-- a "Dr" option that the server will reject: to see ERRORS.INVALID_TITLE -->
            <select id="title" class="form-select" [formField]="f.title">
              <option>Mr</option><option>Mme</option><option>Melle</option><option>Dr</option>
            </select>
            <!-- the message of a server error is a KEY: we translate it -->
            <div class="invalid-feedback">{{ f.title().errors()[0]?.message ?? '' | translate }}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="row g-2 mb-2">
            <div class="col-sm-6">
              <label class="form-label" for="firstName">{{ 'FORM.FIRSTNAME' | translate }}</label>
              <input id="firstName" class="form-control" [formField]="f.firstName">
              <div class="invalid-feedback">{{ f.firstName().errors()[0]?.message ?? '' | translate }}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="col-sm-6">
              <label class="form-label" for="lastName">{{ 'FORM.LASTNAME' | translate }}</label>
              <input id="lastName" class="form-control" [formField]="f.lastName">
              <div class="invalid-feedback">{{ f.lastName().errors()[0]?.message ?? '' | translate }}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="row g-2 mb-3">
            <div class="col-sm-6">
              <label class="form-label" for="login">{{ 'FORM.LOGIN' | translate }}</label>
              <input id="login" class="form-control" [formField]="f.login">
              <div class="invalid-feedback">{{ f.login().errors()[0]?.message ?? '' | translate }}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="col-sm-6">
              <label class="form-label" for="password">{{ 'FORM.PASSWORD' | translate }}</label>
              <input id="password" type="password" class="form-control" autocomplete="new-password" [formField]="f.password">
              <div class="invalid-feedback">{{ f.password().errors()[0]?.message ?? '' | translate }}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="d-flex gap-2">
            <!-- submitting(): true while the action of submit() runs -->
            <button class="btn btn-primary" [disabled]="f().submitting()">{{ 'FORM.SAVE' | translate }}</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" (click)="newForm()">{{ 'FORM.CANCEL' | translate }}</button>
          </div>
          @if (success(); as s) {
            <div class="alert alert-success mt-3 mb-0">{{ s.key | translate: s.params }}</div>
          }
          <!-- the general message, and the HTTP status, to understand -->
          @if (pageError(); as e) {
            <div class="alert alert-danger mt-3 mb-0">
              {{ e.key | translate: e.params }} <span class="small text-muted">({{ e.statusCode }} {{ e.key }})</span>
            </div>
          }
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  }
</div>
